sanskrit: arcanāṅgaṃ ca naivedyavidhiḥ kuṇḍasya lakṣaṇambhūparīkṣā praveśārthabalirgrāmādilakṣaṇampadavinyāsabhedaśca sūtramarmādilakṣaṇamvistārāyāma āyādilakṣyaṃ nakṣatracakrakamgrāmādidevatāsthānaṃ dvijasaṃkhyāvidhānakamaṅgopajīvināṃ sthānaṃ garbhanyāsasya lakṣaṇamvāstuśāntiśca śālāyā vidhānaṃ ca tataḥ paramvardhamānaṃ khastikaṃ ca rūcakāravyamataḥ paramlāṅgalākhyaṃ maulikaṃ ca mālikāpadmakaṃ paramādyeṣṭakopapīṭhaṃ ca pādānāṃ mānalakṣaṇamkaṇṭhasya śikharasyāpi sthūpikāyāśca lakṣaṇammūrdheṣṭakāvidhānaṃ ca liṅgalakṣmāṅkurārpaṇamśūlasaṃsthāpanaṃ paścād devasthāpanasaṃjñakamlakṣaṇaṃ maṇṭapānāṃ ca prākārāṇāṃ ca lakṣaṇamvṛṣabhasthāpanaṃ cānte gopurasthāpanaṃ paramarcanaṃ sakalānāṃ ca mahāsnapanalakṣaṇamnīrājanakriyā pūrvā phalgunīpūjanaṃ paramdīpāvalividhānaṃ ca ghṛtakambalapūjanamvasantejyā śītakumbhaṃ phalapūjā pavitrakamsthālīpākavidhiḥsvapnādhyāyo nirvāṇasaṃskṛtiḥśatābhiṣekaścāntyeṣṭiḥ pitṛyajñavidhistataḥnityanaimittikaprāyaścittamutsavaniṣkṛtiḥsaṃprokṣaṇaṃ ca pīṭhasya sthāpanaṃ ca tataḥ paramprāsādalakṣaṇaṃ liṅgavaśātprāsādalakṣaṇamaṅgaliṅgapratiṣṭhā ca sadeśasthāpanaṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: somāskandasya candrārdhamaulestripuravairiṇaḥbhikṣāṭanasya kaṅkālamūrteḥ pāśupatasya caśivabhaktāyudhānāṃ ca siṃhāsanavidhistathāvyādhināśo rājarakṣā durgāpūjāvidhistathābandhaḥ pratisarasyāpi tulābhāravidhānakamsuvarṇabhūmidānaṃ ca kalpavṛkṣapradānakamtiladhenusahasraṃ ca gavāṃ dānasahasrakam (hemāśvadānakam?)lokapālāṣṭakaṃ caiva sarvadānottamaṃ tathāpravṛddhavaṭavṛkṣotthacchāyācchanne'tivistṛtedevadānavagandharvasiddhavidyādharādibhiḥkauśikaḥ kāśyapo'gastyo gautamo nāradastathābhṛguścātribharadvājavasiṣṭhādyā maharṣayaḥpraṇamya caraṇau tasya prāhurīśamumāpatimsṛṣṭisthititirobhāvalayānugrahakārakasahajānandasandohasvasaṃvillakṣaṇātmakadigdeśakālanirmukta jagadāhlādakāraṇatadarthaṃ sārabhūtaṃ tu śāstraṃ śivamukhodbhavamityevaṃ ṛṣibhiḥ pṛṣṭo bhagavān vṛṣabhadhvajaḥsādhu pṛṣṭaṃ hi yuṣmābhiśśṛṇudhvaṃ saṃśitavratāḥavatīrṇamidaṃ merau praṇavādyavatārakaiḥityevamuktā ṛṣayaḥ praṇemurdaṇḍavatkṣitauādāvabhūd dvidhā jñānamadhikārivibhedataḥśivaprakāśakaṃ jñānaṃ śivajñānaṃ paraṃ smṛtamyathā vilakṣaṇaṃ cakṣuḥ kṣapāyāṃ nṛbiḍālayoḥlaukikaṃ vaidikaṃ caiva tathādhyātmikameva ca

sanskrit: sadyovāmamahāghorapuruṣeśānamūrtayaḥpañcaviṃśatibhedena srotobhedaḥ prakīrtitaḥteṣveva mantratantrākhyaṃ sadāśivamukhodgatamūrdhvapūrvakuberāsyayāmyavaktrādyathākramamdaśāṣṭādaśabhedena śivarudrāvatārakaiḥtadeva yugabhedena sadyojātādimūrtibhiḥsaṃkhyayā gāruḍaṃ tadvat pūrvavaktrādvinirgatamnayasūtrādibhedena vāmaṃ vāmādvinirgatamkaulādiviṃśatsaṃkhyātaṃ bhūtatantraṃ tu sadyataḥasitāṅgādibhirbhūmau kathitaṃ tadanekadhāatha siddhāntatantrāṇāmavatāro nigadyatetrāṇaṃ ca kurute yasmāttantramityabhidhīyatepraṇavāt trikalaḥ prāptaḥ trikalācca tato haraḥnārasiṃhaṃ ca viprendrāḥ kathyate kāmikatrayamsudhākhyādbhasma saṃprāptastataḥ prāpto vibhuḥ kramātātmayogaṃ ca pañcaite yogatantrasya bhedakāḥdīptācca gopatiḥ prāptastataḥ prāptā tu cāmbikāamṛtaṃ cintyantantrasya ṣaḍvidhaṃ tu prakīrtitamkāraṇāccharvarudrastu śarvātprāptaḥ prajāpatiḥtatastu māraṇaṃ dveṣṭaṃ saptadhā kāraṇaṃ tathāsuśivākhyācchivaḥ prāptastacchivādacyutastataḥcaturbhedamidaṃ tantraṃ cāsmin tantre prakīrtitamīśānamūrtiḥ saṃprāptastataḥ prāpto hutāśanaḥānandaṃ mādhayodbhūtamadbhūtaṃ cākṣataṃ tathāsūkṣmaṃ sūkṣmasya saṃproktaṃ tadūgranthaṃ padmasaṃkhyayā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatsūkṣmamekabhedaṃ syātsūkṣmamityabhidhīyatekālādbhīmastataḥ prāpto bhīmāddharmo yathā tathāprabuddhaṃ vibudhaṃ hastamalaṅkāraṃ subodhakamaṃśumānambusaṃjñasya pañcalakṣeṇa kīrtitaḥvidyāpurāṇatantraṃ ca vāsavaṃ nīlalohitamkāśyapaṃ gautamaṃ caindraṃ brāhmaṃ vāsiṣṭhameva casuprabhedaṃ māhāśāstraṃ daśeśasya prakīrtitamtrikoṭisaṃkhyayā prokto bhedaścātra na vidyateśivabhedamiti prokto rudrabhedastathocyateparameśastataḥ prāptastrikoṭigranthasaṃkhyayākuberaṃ ca māghoraṃ vimalaṃ vijayāṣṭakamdaśārṇāt śailajā prāptā cāṣṭabhedena bheditamniḥśvāsanayanaṃ caiva tathā niḥśvāsakārikānidhanasya svayaṃbhūtaṃ trikoṭyardhena kīrtitamprajāpatimataṃ padmaṃ svāyambhuvamiti tridhāāgneyaṃ tantramekaṃ tu tasmātprāpto hutāśanaḥprajāpatistataḥ prāptastrayodaśavibhedakamamohaṃ mohasamayaṃ hākaṭaṃ śākaṭādhikamrauravaṃ brāhmaṇeśasya cārbudāṣṭakasaṃkhyayākālaghnaṃ ca kalātītaṃ rauravaṃ rauravottarammakuṭaṃ tu śivākhyasya śatasāhasrasaṃkhyayāmakuṭottaraṃ ca makuṭaṃ dvividhena vidhīyatevīrabhadrastataḥ prāpto bhedāḥ ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyayāvṛṣādbhutaṃ sudantaṃ ca raudraṃ bhadravidhaṃ tathāarcitaṃ dhāraṇaṃ tantraṃ vimalaṃ ṣoḍaśaiva tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bṛhaspatistataḥ prāpto bhedāścātra caturdaśaekapādapurāṇaṃ ca śaṅkaraṃ nīlarudrakamśivaśekharamākhyātaṃ devyā mataṃ tathaiva camukhabimbaṃ praśāntasya śatasāhasrasaṃkhyayācaturmukhamalāyogaṃ saṃstobhaṃ pratibimbakamkalātyayaṃ tulāyogaṃ kuṭṭimaṃ paṭṭaśekharamprodgītaṃ śūlinaḥ proktaṃ lakṣatritayasaṃkhyayākavacaṃ caiva vārāhaṃ piṅgalāmatameva caśivajñānaṃ ca vijñānaṃ śrīkālajñānameva cagītaṃ bharatamātodyaṃ prodgītaṃ ṣoḍaśaiva tuālayāllālitaḥ (bhairavaḥ?) prāpto lalitaṃ lalitottarambindoḥ siddhamidaṃ tantraṃ koṭikoṭyardhasaṃkhyayāsārottaramathānyattu auśanottarameva casantānaṃ śivaniṣṭhasya ṣaṭ sahasraṃ tu saṃkhyayāliṅgādhyakṣaṃ surādhyakṣaṃ śaṅkaraṃ tvamaleśvaramsomadevasya śarvoktaṃ dvilakṣeṇaiva saṃkhyayāśivadharmottaraṃ caiva vāyuproktaṃ tathaivacaśrīdevyāstu samākhyātaṃ pārameśvaramuttamamuśanomunisaṃprāptaḥ śrīdevyāśca yathākramātpuṣkaraṃ suprayogaṃ ca haṃsaṃ sāmānyameva hisaṃvartakastataḥ prāpto bhedāstu navasaṃkhyayāprabuddhaṃ buddhakālākhye navadhā kiraṇo bhavetmahākālastataḥ prāpto bhedā vai dvādaśaiva tusarvaṃ dharmātmakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ nityaṃ śuddhaṃ mahānanamaṣṭāviṃśatitantrāṇāṃ mūlabhedāḥ prakīrtitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cintyaṃ pādāṅguliḥ proktaḥ kāraṇaṃ jaṅghikā bhavetsūkṣmantu guhyamevaṃ syātsahasraṃ kaṭideśakamvijayaṃ kukṣideśaṃ syānniḥśvāsaṃ hṛdayaṃ bhavetvīraṃ kaṇṭhapradeśastu rauravaṃ śrotrameva cabāhū tu vimalaṃ proktaṃ candrajñānamuraḥsthalamlalitaṃ syātkapolaṃ tu siddhaṃ caiva lalāṭakampārameśena hāraṃ tu kiraṇaṃ ratnabhūṣaṇamkalpañcaiva tu saṃyoge śivadharmānulepanetantrātmakaśarīreṇa mantramūrtimayena tuśivarudrātmakaṃ tantramaṣṭāviṃśatisaṃkhyakamyadyapyeko bhavedvaktā śrotṛbhedādanekadhākṛtañcedupabhedena kartā bhartā vinaśyatipratiṣṭhādyaṃ tu mūlaiścet aṣṭāviṃśatibhirvaramtena sarvaṃ prakartavyaṃ na kuryādanyatantrataḥuktāni pratiṣiddhāni punaḥ saṃbhāṣitāni cacatuṣpādayutānyeva bhuktimuktyarthasādhanamsaṃkṣepato'pi kathitaṃ sarveṣāmanukampayāavyāpanaṃ ca kartavyaṃ na kāryamitarairnaraiḥsavarṇādyanulomāśca śilpinaḥ kārukādayaḥacireṇa vināśaḥ syāttasmādrājā nivārayetna kuryādanyaśāstreṇa kuryāccettantrasaṃkaraḥgāruḍaṃ bhūtatantraṃ ca bhairavaṃ vāmatantrakamtantraṃ pāśupataṃ cānyat purāṇaṃ dharmaśāstrakamatharvaṇaṃ tathā bauddhamārhataṃ matameva cakāmikādi śivajñānaṃ mūrdhā bhagavataḥ sadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvapakṣatayā tāni kathitānīha śambhunātatsarvamadharīkṛtya śaivasiddhānta īritaḥśāstrāntaraistu saṃsthāpya liṅgaṃ tadubhayārthakamśaivaḥ sarvādhikārī syātsvakīye ca paratra cayāmale mātṛtantre ca kāpāle pāñcarātrakeanyeṣvapi ca mārgeṣu tattacchāstraiḥ svaśāstrataḥmukhyatvādiha śaivasya mukhamāhātmyato'pi catasmātparārthamātmārthaṃ sthāpanaṃ yajanaṃ tathāparārthamapi kuryāccellopena nṛpatestathāmantraṃ vinā kriyā nāsti karṣaṇādyarcanāntakammananatrāṇadharmitvānmantra ityabhidhīyatevāgrūpo vācakaḥ prokto vācyastvarthātmakaḥ smṛtaḥnādo mantra iti proktaḥ sa nādo jāyate parāttasmātsvaradvayaṃ dvau dvau teṣāṃ bhedāstrayodaśasaṃkhyayā te catustriṃśatta eva vyañjanāni tutaireva racitaṃ śāstraṃ parāparavibheditamvikārabhūtabhūtākhyavedavedendusaṃkhyayāsa nādaḥ kathyate viprāḥ paryāyaiśśivanāmabhiḥśabdabodhānubhūtātmā sarvaprāṇihṛdi sthitiḥsaṃsthitā mātṛkā jñeyāḥ sādhakaistattvadarśibhiḥbhagavan prāṇino loke kṣīṇasatvācirāyuṣaḥbahudhā mantrasadbhāvo vaktavyaḥ karuṇānidhetena tena prakāreṇa kathayāmi samāsataḥjīvādyaṃ pañcamaṃ vāyupūrvaṃ kāraṇakāryayukcintāmaṇiriti khyāto mantro'yaṃ śivavācakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yugmaṃ agnibījasamanvitam)bhedo dvitīyabījasthaṃ dhātupūrvaṃ yathākramamsadyojātādayo vāpi tatsthāne hyubhayaṃ tu vāpāṭhaḥ)athavā'nyaprakāreṇa mantralakṣaṇamucyatehṛccūḍāsyatanutrāṇamūrdhvamūladṛgastrakānyadvānalāsanārūḍho varṇavyomendubhāskaraiḥmantro'yaṃ mūlabhūtastu prāgvadasyāṅgakalpanākhabījānala bījasthaṃ kāraṇoktaṃ sitārṇakamtatra brahmāṅgasaṃkḷptiranulomavilomataḥsanāmi padmaṃ saṃlikhya prāgdalādyakṣarānnyasetevaṃ pradakṣiṇaṃ nyāso mantroddhāro dalakramātye nipātāśca viśveśa svarādyo nāsvarādikammanetātāśca siddhaṃ yā dīpako kathayopakṛtdhyāśiyaśca yakāraśca vakāro yaśca vā tataḥjñārvāvanto dvidhā dhūk ca niyautat tadvisargataḥvarau dvarādyau tuścaiva nadāvante tathā ca nenirgarhāsī prasā prāścai svakuśāmī plako tataḥvaśca svaśca tathā dīṃścastisṛ dhūthamate tathāśāgīndra iguścaiva yoravyamavarāṭikāḥsavisarge makārastu vyontāśca na bhavau tathātaśaśca darśikāronte mayaṣkā syāścave tathāmaśca dīpotha rāgārvā sūrūpū pagvasūpavate svarādyātha bhūrāmodhiśakhādyarpitaṃ kṣathāhyātā svarādyo bījādyo jakāraḥ savisargakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dik dhūpadīpako yaśca dhāgarāyāstathaścavaudete bhandaratāścaiva pīṭhaśca kṣmaśca eva casvarādyaḥ savisargopa śivau mucavasau tathādṛśca svarādyo maścaiva dīpako śādṛmū tathācarvāstathā nākṣipaṃśca viṃśca vaḥ savisargakaḥdeśaśca śadbhāmuraścaiva kāraḥ sārcisāgaśāḥcakraṃ tu gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ samabhyarcya ca darśayetgurvājñāpūrvakaṃ caivaṃ gṛhṇīyānmantramuttamamśivādyavaniparyantaṃ bhūtabhāvādikaṃ kramātcaitryādi dinamārabhya phālgunyantadināntakamnābhipadmadaleṣvaṣṭau varṇā dīpakapūrvakāḥekena vā yajedahnā cakresmin savyavasthitamvyomatatvapadānāṃ tu kanyakāṅgagaṇo davaḥdīpakovyo yadāpyā ca dīkṣarvā ca tathā ca nāsadvayañcāyatañcaiva svarādyovyānayeṣṭadedyākālatadhanāsyāṃśca saṃllikhedādyapaṃktiketvamānālaṃ ca bhāśiśca bhuvaṃ dadhacito tathāpraśca saśca dvitīyānte netavā viśvadīpakaḥdagusāśca tathā ṇeru vivilāma tathaiva catrepapūstrastuścaiva nityaṃ nātre tṛtīyakerephapūrvopetāyau yavayāpyamastathaiva canantaśca adbhyavyāpī ca vilikhedvedapaṅktikeṣṭālitrayagakāraśca ādadaśceyayau tathāpunadrahe tapaścaiva vyokāraśca anevajāḥyāśiyāne vidhābhiśca yāgāyā yūśca vī tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tuḥ saviḥ sargo maṃ vā vyodakāśca rūḍhī ca vibhoyācayavāvyodaka barūddhisvapihocāgarorupādacamūḥmāyāmaśca mīśca tathācanarabāhye saśca tathārū rū samādyo yaśca ṇe tathātathā brāhmyo kadāścarau vinayetaśca sāye carūnakyārāstathāpetu miśca bījādikaśca kaḥtisisarūlita jīnāśca śāstiyā vavacāśca yeguhyāpyānāṃ ca pārvaṃ ca śakārāntārameva carephapūrvo vakāraśca pākināṣṭatathaiva cayaśca tāya mayā mayāsyathaiva camavipitṛ tathā momaḥ vyānāyādāsta thaiva saḥkhakāraśca rukāraśca paṅktau ekādaśe kṣipetraśca diśca tathājyopi viśca ṇeṇe tathaiva cadevaviśca tathā śaktidrikā raśca napūrvakaḥnaṭyanāttathā kyannāme ca viśca viśaṣmaṇevaurepi pūrve vaścaiva bījādyonāvivāstathāṇāñca sargasakāraśca likhetāstaṃtrayodaśebhakāre rephapūrvaśca svarādyopiśca mā tathāṣāṃścasapasau saṃrepādyevau vakāro dīpakontakaḥṇeyā śidhāśvarātadyā viviṇīyu rūlīnegaśca śivauvaśca rāyāyā yayāgāstathāno nāśca vidyaśca hrīṃ svādyā laśca bhācayedhāpavāntā ca vadhvāśca dvaidvintoyāsare poharū caḥpuno bhapaurikā lolāścaiva nana yābhāśca vaitakāraśca yayo bhūśca kāca niśca kapūrvaśaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etaddaṇḍakamuddiṣṭaṃ śālānāṃ syuḥ ṣaḍaṃśakāḥgehatāro dvibhāgaḥ syāddvyaṃśaṃ ca kramaṇaṃ bhavettribhāgo gehavistāro dviguṇaṃ dairghyamiṣyatekulyābhadvārasaṃyuktaṃ śeṣaṃ sarvaṃ tu pūrvavatsarvatra paritaḥ kuḍyaṃ raṅgaṃ pādasamanvitamprāsādavadalaṅkuryāttṛtīyaṃ daṇḍakaṃ matamśeṣaṃ pūrvavaduddiṣṭaṃ caturthaṃ daṇḍakaṃ matambhāgena parito'lindaśālāvyāso dvibhāgataḥpārśvayordvitribhāgena tārāyāmau vivāsakaupañcamaṃ daṇḍakaṃ proktaṃ pūrvavaccheṣamācaretcaturbhiḥ purato'lindaṃ syādekadvitriśālaketadeva purato bhadraṃ caturdvyaṃśe tu sammatamaśaṃke'lindakaṃ kuryādvyāse netratrayānvitamtadeva pṛṣṭhato bhadrayuktaṃ yadvatpuro bhavetadhiṣṭhānādivārgāḍhyaṃ prāsādavadalaṅkṛtamcaturmukhamidaṃ nāmnā kramājjātyādināmabhāksvāmicittavaśānnyastaṃ sthānavinyāsasaṃyutamsadvicūlītricūlyaṅgaṃ sugrīvaṃ savitalpakamdaṇḍakaṃ maulikaṃ vāpi yatheṣṭadiśi vāraṇambahirbhāgena vāraḥ syāddvyaṃśaśālāviśālataḥtadāvṛtyaikakālindaṃ śeṣaṃ ca kramaṇaṃ bhavetcaturmukhasamāyuktaṃ dviśālamiha kīrtitamalindenānvitaṃ vāpi dviśālaṃ parikalpayetdvāraṃ pūrvavaduddiṣṭaṃ sarvālaṅkāraśobhitamnetratrayasamāyuktaṃ svastikaṃ tvabhidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sāvakāśāntaropetaṃ maṇ.ḍapena vināpi vāsavāraṃ vā vivāraṃ vā ekānekatalānvitamcaturaṃśe tribhāgaṃ vā dvyaṃśaṃ pañcatribhāgakamsaptāṃśe pañcabhāgādidvibhāgāntamathāpi vārudrabhāgāddvibhāgāntaṃ bhāgān kṛtvā tribhāgataḥekadvitricatuḥ śālāsāmānyamidamīritammaulikasya tu vistāraṃ vasubhāgairvibhājayetśālāvyāso dvibhāgena prāsādavadalaṅkṛtamekānekatalopetamadhiṣṭhānādiśobhitammerukāntamidaṃ proktaṃ sarveṣāmapi yogyakamvāramekāṃśataḥ kuryāddvyaṃśastu gṛhavistaraḥdvyaṅkaṇaṃ vāramekāṃśamarkāṃśe parikalpayetmaulibhadramidaṃ nāmnā śeṣaṃ pūrvavadīritamsālindamanalindaṃ vā triśālaṃ parikalpayetaṣṭādidvādaśāntaṃ tu nīce tu parikalpayetādityamanvorekāṃśaṃ bhāgaṃ madhye tu kalpayetbījabhāgaḥ samākhyāto jātirdvyaṃśādhikā yataḥaṣṭāṃśādhikamābhāsaṃ sarvatobhadrasaṃjñakebījajātyādisaṃbhūtā saṃkhyā ṣaṣṭiriti smṛtāsamantānmārga ekāṃśo dvibhāgo gehavistaraḥbhadramadhye sabhāsyaṃ syāccatuṣkaṃ karṇakūṭakampūrvasminnaparasmin vā svāmyāvāsaḥ praśasyatebahirjālakakuḍyāḍhyamantaraṃ lūtapādakamsamastambhaṃ samadvāraṃ samavaṃśaṃ tu kārayetkarkarīvaṃśajālāgraṃ kūṭahīnaṃ tu vā nayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sālindaṃ vā'nalindaṃ vā sāvakāśāntaraṃ tu vājātyākhyaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ bhūpatīnāmihoditamkarkarīvaṃśajālākhyaṃ kūṭahīnaṃ tu vā nayetaṣṭāsyamukhapaṭyaṅganīvrāṅgakasamāvṛtamcitraṃ tu sarvatobhadraṃ bhūpatīnāṃ praśasyatecatasṛṇāṃ tu śālānāṃ śikharaṃ tu sabhākṛtiekadvitritalopataṃ sarvālaṅkāraśobhitamśikharasthūpikānāsāvedikājālakānvitamubhayaṃ viparītaṃ vā harmyaṃ syānmadhyamaṇḍapamnikṛṣṭaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ caturvidhamudāhṛtamsamantādaṃśataḥ panthā dvyaṃśaḥ śālā dviśālakemasūrikāṅghrikocce tu prastarordhvagaṇānvitamtadeba cāṅkaṇaṃ kuryādantarvārasamanvitamtadeva ca bahidvaryaṃśavāradvayasamanvitamvikalpamiti nirdiṣṭaṃ niṣkrāntādi puroktavatyatheṣṭadiśi vāraḥ syādyatheṣṭadiśi bhadrakamvikalpamiti nirdiṣṭamābhāsaṃ sarvayogataḥābhāsaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ devadvijamahībhṛtāmmadhyamaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ caturaṃśāṅkaṇānvitambahistvalindamekāṃśaṃ prāgvadeva prakalpayetvārayuktaṃ dvibhāgena pṛthuvārayutaṃ tu vādvibhāgamaṅkaṇañcāntarvārahīnaṃ tu vā nayetṣoḍaśāṃśaviśālaṃ tu vikalpamiti nirdiśetdvyaṃśaḥ śālāvibhāgaḥ syādantarvāraṃ tu caikataḥvikalpamiti nidirṣṭamābhāsaṃ tatra miśritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: utkṛṣṭaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ caturaṃśāṅkaṇānvitamśālāvyāso dvibhāgaḥ syādbāhyālindamathaikataḥantarvāraṃ parityajya bāhye vā tatra kalpayetsabhadraṃ vā vibhadraṃ vāpyaṅkaṇāṃśena vāraṇamtameva parito mārgayukto vā pṛthuvārakaḥtadeva paritoṃ'śena bahirvāraṃ tu kalpayetjāticchandavikalpānāṃ miśramābhāsanāmabhāketadābhāsamākhyātaṃ rājñāmāvāsayogyakamutkṛṣṭaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ caturvidhamudāhṛtamnikṛṣṭabhāginī cāṣṭadaśadvādaśabhāgikādviṣaṭsaptāṣṭabhāge tu śreṣṭhā tu parikīrtitāchandādayastathādvyaṃśavardhitāyāmasaṃyutāḥjātyādyābhāsakāntā yā uktā mūlasamanvitāutkṛṣṭā cātra yā jātirvikalpādyantadīrghikānikṛṣṭe vardhamāne tu dvibhāgaṃ madhyamāṅkaṇammadhyabhittisamāśliṣṭakulyābhadvārasaṃyutamalpanimnā bhavetprācī śālādīrghā dvinetrakābāhye bhittisamāyuktamantaḥ pādaiḥ samanvitamdvibhāgakṛtaniṣkrāntaṃ caturdiṅmadhyavāraṇammukhyagehasya mūle tu snānagehaṃ dvibhāgataḥvāstūnāṃ tu caturmadhye catuḥ sūtraṃ prayojayetnāsikātoraṇastambhajālakādivicitritamnikṛṣṭaṃ vardhamānaṃ syādrājñāmāvāsayogyakamyatheṣṭadiśi bhadrāṅgaṃ yatheṣṭadiśi vāsakamtadeva pṛthuvāraṃ tu daṇḍikāvārasaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jātyāditrayasaṃyuktamābhāsamiti kīrtitamaṃśena parito'lindaṃ śālāvyāso dvibhāgataḥprāguktavadalaṅkuryānnīce jātiḥ prakīrtitāchandanāmnā samuddiṣṭaṃ viśvamanyatpuroktavatkarkarīmukhavaṃśāgraṃ mukhapaṭṭisamāyutamvikalpamiti nirdiṣṭamābhāsaṃ tatra miśritamsamantānmārgaekāṃśaḥ śālāvyāso dvibhāgataḥdaṇḍikāvārasaṃyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutammukhapaṭyaṅganetrāṅgaṃ vistāre cāyatau kramātvikalpaṃ pṛthuvāreṇa bāhyavāreṇa saṃyutamuttamavyāsabhāge tu dvibhāgaṃ madhyamāṅkaṇamśālāvyāso dvibhāgena parito'lindavārakepūrvavadbhadrasaṃyuktaṃ pūrvavatkarkarīkṛtamjātyākhyaṃ vardhamānaṃ syādviprabhūmīndrayogyakamchandaṃ syātparito mārgayuktaṃ vaikalpasaṃjñitamviśiṣṭaṃ vardhamānākhyaṃ sālaṅkāramathocyatebrahmāṅkaṇaṃ dvibhāgaṃ syādāyāme caturaṃśakambhāgadvayena tadbāhye alindaṃ parikalpayetvihāya pṛṣṭhadeśe tu racanā miśradeśakemadhyasūtrānusāreṇa pūrvasmin pārśvayordvayoḥtritale vāḥ sthalaṃ cāntarnetraśālā catuḥ sthalesvāmivāsāgraśālānusāreṇobhayapārśvayoḥalindasya catuṣkoṇe karṇakūṭacatuṣṭayamcaturbhāgasamāyāmadvibhāgavistṛtānvitāalindapārśvayoḥ karṇakūṭānāṃ madhyadeśataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pārśvaṃ vāḥ sthalasaṃyuktaṃ vārayuktadvibhāgikampṛṣṭhavārasabhāṃ kuryāt ṣaṭtale tu dvijottamāḥaṅkaṇaṃ maṇṭapākāraṃ sabhākāramathāpi vāvāmasopānasaṃyuktaṃ netrayugdvārasaṃyutamvāḥ sthalaṃ ca viśiṣṭaṃ syātsaptabhaumamidaṃ smṛtamathavā tvaṣṭabhāgena pṛṣṭhabhadrayutaṃ bhavetmadhyaśālāsamāyuktaṃ koṭihīnaṃ tu vā bhavetevaṃ ṣoḍaśadhā proktaṃ vardhamānamihāgamenikṛṣṭaṃ vasudigbhānubhāgaṃ nīcamiti smṛtamādityamanvorekāṃśaṃ bhāgaṃ jyeṣṭhamiti smṛtamchandāḥ syurvedabhāgāḍhyā vikalpāḥ ṣaḍvivardhitāṃcatvāriṃśadbhavantyatra saṃkhyā pañcasamanvitāmilite saptapañcāśatsaṅkhyātra parikīrtitādvyaṃśaśālāviśālā syātsarvālaṅkārasaṃyutādvāraṃ catuṣṭayaṃ vāpi yatheṣṭadiśi vā bhavetsarvataḥ kuḍyasaṃyuktaṃ mukhyadhāmātra kīrtitamcaturdikṣu viniṣkrāntamardhakūṭaṃ prayojayettadevāṃśāvṛtālindaṃ caturṇāṃ chandamiṣyatevikalpaṃ bahubhaumaṃ syādābhāsaṃ tatra miśritamnīcaiḥ syādaṅkaṇaṃ dvyaṃśaṃ vāramekāṃśamiṣyatesarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ bhadrakarma yatheṣṭataḥbahirabhyantare kuḍyaṃ mukhyagehaṃ vidhīyatejātirūpamidaṃ viprā bhūbhujāmeva bhāvitamdvibhāgamaṅkaṇaṃ madhye mārgamaṃśena kalpayetcatuṣṭayānāṃ śālānāṃ madhyamadhyordhvamastakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturnetrasamāyuktaṃ chandamānaṃ prakīrtitamsālindacūlīharmyaṃ vā yathāśakti yathāruciūrdhvordhvamaṅkaṇaṃ kāryaṃ pakṣaśālāsamoparicaturṇāmuditaṃ dhāma viśeṣādrājayogyakammuṇḍaprāsādasaṃyuktaṃ harmyāṅgaṃ mālikaṃ bhavetaṅkaṇaṃ tu dvibhāgaṃ syānmārgamekena kārayetdaṇḍikāvārasaṃyuktaṃ caturānanasaṃyutamdvādaśāsyasamāyuktamūrdhvādhastāddvitīyataḥjātirūpamidaṃ na?ndyāvartaṃ kṣoṇibhṛtāṃ gṛhamtadvāhye vāramekaṃ vā pṛthuvārayutaṃ tu vātasyopari gatāḥ śālāścatuṣkaśikharānvitāḥtattadviniścitaṃ kuryānmuṇḍaprāsādasaṃjñikamābhāsaṃ nandikāvartaṃ caturṇāmapi kīrtitamantarvāramathaikāṃśaṃ śālāvyāso dvibhāgataḥmadhyaśālāśirastambhāścaiva nimnāstathāparejātistu parito dvyaṃśaṃ mahāvārasamanvitamsālindaṃ khaṇḍaharmyaṃ vā kūṭakoṣṭhakabhārakamnadyāvartaṃ vikalpaṃ syātprāsādavadalaṅkṛtamvasudigdvādaśāṃśaṃ tu nīcaṃ vai svastikaṃ bhavetādityamanvorekāṃśamuttamaṃ bhāgamiṣyatejātirūpaṃ bhavecchandaṃ caturaṃśādhikāyatamābhāsamaṣṭavṛttaṃ yaccatvāriṃśattu pañcayuktritridīrghāni nīcāḥ syuḥ pañcāśatsaptasaṃkhyayāśālāvyāso dvibhāgena sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutaḥbāhyaśālādvayaṃ netraṃ yuktaṃ tu karkarīyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadevāṃśāvṛtālindaṃ chandaṃ śāstre prakīrtitamdaṇḍikāvārasaṃyuktaṃ bhadrāṅgaṃ parikīrtitamvikalpaṃ svastikaṃ jñeyamābhāsaṃ tatra miśritamanekabhūmisaṃyuktaṃ prāsādavadalaṅkṛtamhīne dvyaṃśāṅkaṇaṃ madhye mārgastu paritoṃ'śataḥtatra madhye catuḥ śālāścordhvagānekasaṃyutāḥsthūpikādisamāyuktā sabhā bhadrānanānvitādaṇḍikāvārasaṃyuktaṃ svastikaṃ jātirūpakamaṃśenāvṛtavāraṃ vā pṛthuvārayutaṃ tu vājātyādīnāṃ tu saṃyogādābhāsamiti kīrtitammadhyame tvaṅgaṇaṃ prāgvanmārgamekāṃśato bhavetdaṇḍikāvārasaṃyuktaṃ ṣaṇṇetrasamavaṃśakamūrdhvordhvamaṇṭapākāraharmyasthalamathāṅkaṇamtadevāṃśābhito dvāraṃ chandamityabhidhīyateābhāsaṃ tatra miśraṃ yanmuṇḍaprāsādaśobhitamutkṛṣṭe tvaṅkaṇaṃ dvyaṃśaṃ mārgastu paritoṃ'śataḥaṃśena parito'lindaṃ nīvravāraḥ śiraḥkriyājālakastambhakuḍyāṅganāsikātoraṇānvitampādottaraṃ tulādyaṅgaṃ bhittisaṃśliṣṭaviṣṭaramtadeva parito mārgaṃ vārabhadrasabhāmukhamekacchandamiti proktaṃ pṛthuvāraṃ vikalpakamābhāsaṃ tatra miśraṃ syānmuṇḍaprāsādaśobhitambhūmīndravaiśyayoreva bhāṣitaṃ syādihāgamenikṛṣṭā rucakā jñeyā devapāṣaṇḍayogyakāantarvāraṃ ca mārgaṃ ca parityajya bahistu vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tathaiva pṛthuvāraṃ tu yojanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥdānādau yojanīyā sā pañcāṃśādinavāṃśakamśālāvyāsaṃ tu śeṣeṇa vāramaṅkaṇamiṣyatebhittimadhyaṃ tu vā mānaṃ pādamadhyamathāpi vāprāsādamālikāyānaprabhṛtīnāṃ tu mānakampiṇḍahīnaṃ catuḥ śālaṃ sarvavarṇeṣu yogyakamgehaṃ tu sarvavarṇānāmaniṣṭamiti ca smṛtampañcaśālāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathāvadanupūrvaśaḥdvibhāgena tathā madhye cāṅkaṇadvayasaṃyutammadhyame dvyaṃśavistāraḥ ṣaḍaṃśāyāmasaṃyutaḥmūlaśālādisaṃyuktā pañcaśālā divaukasāmtatpārśvayostu śāle dve dvidvibhāge viśālakesaptaśālāsamāśraṃ tu navadhā parikalpayettatpārśvayostathā śālā pārśvayoraṅkaṇaṃ bhavetevaṃ tu saptaśālaṃ syāddevadvijamahībhṛtāmvistāre pañcabhāgāḥ syurāyāme rudrasaṃkhyayākintvaṅkaṇaṃ tu bhāgena vardhitāyāmasaṃyutamdvibhāgena samantācca madhye śālāṃ prakalpayetvistāre tvaṣṭabhāgāḥ syurāyāme syuścaturdaśaaṅkaṇaṃ dvitayaṃ kāryaṃ pañcabhiḥ saptabhiḥ padaiḥsaptaśālamidaṃ proktamaṣṭaśālamathocyatesamantādekabhāgena catuḥ śālāṃ prakalpayetaṣṭanetrayutaṃ vāpi ṣoḍaśāsyayutaṃ tu vādevānāṃ bhūsurāṇāṃ syādaṣṭaśālā dvijottamāḥsamantādekabhāgena catuḥ śālāṃ prakalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṅkaṇānāṃ catuṣkaṃ tu madhyabhāgadvayena tubhavanti vipule saptadaśadairghyadvayādhikamśālānāṃ pañcakaṃ madhye catuḥ śālāḥ prakīrtitāḥekonaviṃśadaṃśāḥ syurvistāre dairghyake punaḥmadhyame pañcaśālāḥ syurbhāgadvayavinirmitāḥnavaśālamidaṃ proktaṃ daśaśālamihocyateāyāme dviguṇaṃ kuryādathavāyāma ucyateathavāyāmakḷptistu pañcādīnāṃ krameṇa tuyathāyukti gṛhāṇāṃ ca aṅkaṇaṃ tatra kalpayetvihāraśālā kartavyā caikaśālā viśālakādviguṇādyāyasaṃyuktaṃ mānaṃ viṃśatisaṃkhyakampurataḥ pṛṣṭhato vāpi vārālindayutaṃ na vāekadvitritalopetaṃ kūṭakoṣṭhayutaṃ na vābauddhārhatādipāṣaṇḍayogyametadudīritamnavabhūmirdvijānāṃ syānnṛpāṇāṃ saptabhūrmatāvaiśyānāṃ ca caturbhūmiryodhaseneśayorapisāmantapramukhānāṃ tu pañcabhūmīrvidhīyaterājñāṃ strīṇāṃ ca devīnāṃ yugmaṃ vāyugmasaṃkhyakammṛṇmayaṃ tu tṛṇācchādyamekadvitritalānvitamtrikaraṃ tu samārabhya karārdhena tu vardhayethastiśālā vidheyā tu bhittimānena dhīmatācaturbhaktiviśālā vā saptabhittyā athāpi vāmukhaśālaikabhittiḥ syāt sārdhā vā dviguṇāpi vādakṣiṇe śayanasthānaṃ ceṣṭabhaktyā vidhīyatetintriṇī cārjunaḥ proktāḥ stabakaḥ pihitaḥ śamī
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rūkāro rūpikāṇesaniśadatāstathā ca vitsavīyaśca sargo makārakaḥsarvaśivaścaiva tegaśca hājñodaṣṭadiśo likhetnityāntase ye prathūśāye ṣākāra svañcavāk bhavaḥlasadaśca dhakāraśca viśca vaikonaviṃśakenadyobha dhṛtijaścaiva suyaṃraṇyaṃ ca viṃśakenavantāmodi vaścaiva savisargaśca tārakamnamarvarapravisargo marephayutaṃ vakārakammāca vaśca tathā tepi ṇeñca vāca ṣapūrvakammaṣabhāśceta - rvakṣaṃ naitmakuśca tārakamjñācarvaśca rabhautaśca dvāviṃśatpaṅktike nyesetpāca jaśca visargāśca dīpanaśca svarādyakaḥmaśca yā ca tathā vaśca saśca duśca tathā ca pausecayaca tathā lāca puśca toca varūcaṇeyastuśiśca prakārāśca makāraḥ savisargakaḥbhuñcabhāva tathāyacca caturviṃśatike kṣipetpacanti prasavirgaśca vabisarga mamocavāsānusvaraṃ ca saṃyukto pūrvaḥ saṃyogapaścimenārūpiśca viṇeścāvā vāntau sama sargakaḥpunarvasavaścaiva tathārdrāhrī digaṇājñāpañca ṇe ca vibhāścaiva moca vai tanamemamasavau masavisargañca pamavāśca śiścataḥyatau ca yatau ca bhadajyāṃ kāroyamaścapraśca tathā dyāca yāye vota ca śvavācakaiḥdevaṣacaretpīyut sthīścatāratathā tañca necaraśca sarau ca yaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navāṣṭasaptahastoccāḥ kākamānaṃ vihāya cadvādaśāṅgulamānaṃ tadavagāho yathā valamālānasya viśālaḥ syāddvādaśāṅgulamānataḥchatrābhāgraṃ suvistāramaṣṭāṃśaṃ pīnasaṃyutamnītvāreḥ ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ tu vāme'ṣṭāṃśaṃ vyapohya tuanuvātāḥ samantātsyustatra bhittiṃ prakalpayettadūrdhve chādanaṃ kuryātkūṭādyaistu samantataḥphalakāprastaraṃ kāryaṃ dṛḍhadārubhireva tumūtradvārasamopetaṃ sthūladvāraṃ prakalpayetparihṛtya vidheyā syādgajaśālā vicakṣaṇaiḥnagare rājaveśmādau kuryāddevālayādiṣudvihastaṃ tu samārabhya vistareṇāpi vardhayetetadvistāramākhyātaṃ tvāyāmastvadhunocyatedviguṇaṃ vātha vistārādāyāmaṃ parikalpyatesthānaṃ prakalpayecchreṇyāḥ pṛthu vā kartṛvāñchayāatrānuktaṃ tu sāmānyaśālāmānoktamācaretdvādaśāṅgulaparyantaṃ stambhamānamihoditammūtradvārasamāyuktaṃ sāradārumayaṃ dṛḍhamvistāraṃ tryaṅgulaṃ proktaṃ sūcikāgrasamanvitamaṣṭamaṃ dvādaśaṃ rāśiṃ parihṛtyānukūlataḥuṣṭrādīnāmanenaiva pramāṇena samācaretaśvaśāloktabhaktyā tu gośālāṃ parikalpayetcatuḥ śālāsamā vāpi āyāmena yutāpi vāgorāśeravirodhena sthānaṃ tāsāṃ prakalpayetpalālairodanādyaiśca nirmālyairvāpi poṣayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āyādisampatsaṃyuktaṃ gajādisthānamīritamcaturdhā mālikā śālā sabhā muṇḍajasaudhajesā śālā mālikā jñeyā śāstre'smin kāmikāhvayeūhapratyūhasaṃyuktā yā sabhā sā ca mālikāprāsādavyāsadīrghoccā proktā prāsādamālikāsarvatra muṇḍākāratvātkathitā muṇḍamālikāupasañcitamityevaṃ nāgaraṃ drāmiḍaṃ tathāśuddhaṃ miśraṃ ca saṅkīrṇaṃ bījamūlaṃ tathāṅkuramarpitaṃ saṃcitaṃ proktaṃ puṃliṅgaṃ taddhanīkṛtamrakṣogandharvayakṣāṇāṃ praśastānāṃ ca janmināmsarvavargasamāyuktaṃ manaḥprītisamanvitampañcavargayutaṃ miśramarpitānarpitāṅgakamsvavistāravāśācchannahastapūrṇāyatānvitamantaraprastaropetamūhapratyūhasaṃyutamdrāmiḍaṃ vakṣyate'thātastathā vistāradairghyakamhitvā tatra samībhūtaṃ bhadrālaṅkārasaṃyutamlabdhavyāsāyataṃ yattu nātiriktaṃ na hīnakammahāvāraṃ vimānordhve nirvyūhānanasaṃyutamyatīnāṃ gaṇikānāṃ ca jīvināṃ krūrakarmaṇāmkarṇamadhye'ntare kūṭakoṣṭhe pañjarasaṃyutamkarṇe śālāsabhāmadhye chandaṃ syācchandameva tatdrumeṇeṣṭakayā vāpi dṛṣadādyairathāpi vādravyadvayayutaṃ miśraṃ saṅkīrṇaṃ bahubhiryutamvistāre caturaṃśaṃ syādāyāme tu ṣaḍaṃśakāḥāyāmaṃ caturaśraṃ syācchālānāṃ ca viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nirgamastu dvibhāgena vistāro dvyaṃśamānataḥvistāre nirgame caiva vibhāgo maṇḍapasya tupṛṣṭhe ca maṇḍapasyāpi pārśvayoragradeśakesaṃśliṣṭavārasaṃyuktaṃ ṣaṭsu cārdhasabhāmukhametadeva sabhākāraśikharaṃ mantrapūrvakamsaṃpūrṇamiti vikhyātamanyatsarvaṃ tu pūrvavatmukhavatpṛṣṭhaśobhāḍhyaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutametadeva sabhākāraśikharaṃ kṣemamucyateagrabhaktisamāyuktaṃ śālāpṛṣṭhe ca pārśvayoḥtatraiva śālāpṛṣṭhe ca netrayorubhayorapitattadagre prakartavyaṃ vāre bhadrasya paścimeagre ca vāḥ sthalaṃ kuryāddvitryaṃśāyāmavistaramkarṇakūṭadvayaṃ kuryāccaturbhāgavinirmitamcaturmadhye catuṣkoṇe sabhākāraṃ prakalpayetetadeva ca karṇe tu karkarīkṛtakūṭakametadeva sabhākāraśikharaṃ harmyamiṣyatesarvamaṅgaṃ sabhākāraṃ karṇakūṭavivarjitamviśāle ṣaṭ tu bhāgaṃ syādāyāme daśabhāgakamtadbahirvāramekāṃśaṃ tadbāhye tu vṛṣasthalamcatasrastu sabhāḥ kāryāḥ koṇakūṭacatuṣṭayamnetrayorubhayoścaiva vārsthalāṃśe sabhe matecatuḥ ṣaḍaṃśavistāradairghyabhadraṃ mukhe mukhevārsthalaṃ caikabhāgena pārśvayorubhayorapiśālāmadhye ca kartavyā dvibhāgenaikabhāgataḥetadeva ca pṛṣṭhe tu bhadrayuktaṃ bhavedyadi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pūrvoktameva vijayaṃ bhadrayoragrapṛṣṭhayoḥsabhākāraśiroyuktaṃ pradhānāgāramīritametadevamukhaṃ bhadraṃ sabhākāraśiroyutampūrvoktameva vijayaṃ bhadrayoragrakūṭayoḥnāmnā cālpamiti proktamanyatpūrvoktavannayetvāsomadhye tu ṣaḍdvyaṃśe vāraṃ bāhye tu kārayetvārsthale tu catuṣkarṇe kūṭamekena kārayetvāsādyaṃśaviniṣkrāntaśālāmukhasamanvitampṛṣṭhe tu tadvadiṣṭaṃ syānnāmnedaṃ koṇasaṃjñakamagrataḥ pṛṣṭhataḥ śālāmukhāgatamiti smṛtamśālāmukhaṃ tu karṇe syātsāraṃ nāmnā prakīrtitampārāvṛtasya śālāsyaṃ puṣkaraṃ tviti kathyatemadhye śālānanopetaṃ bāhukoṣṭhānanānvitambhadradvyaṃ ca saṃtyaktaṃ śikharaṃ maṇṭapaṃ tu cetetadeva ca sarvatra sabhāgaṃ daṇḍamucyatevistāreṣṭāṃśakaṃ kuryādāyāme dvādaśāṃśakaḥśeṣaṃ harmyasthalaṃ kuryānmadhye vāraṇasaṃyutamkarṇe syāllāṅgalākārakūṭanirgamasaṃyutamtadeva vedanetraṃ cedviśvamityabhidhīyateādeyamiti vikhyātaṃ lāṅgalaṃ trividhaṃ bhavetvistāre daśabhāgāḥ syurāyāme dvādaśāṃśakamvedanetrasamāyuktamanyatsyātsalilasthalamkūṭaṃ ca maṇṭapaṃ caiva niṣkrameṇa samanvitamcaturaśrasamāyuktaṃ dhanamityabhidhīyatebahiḥ śālānanopetaṃ yadi syādraudramucyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ pañcavidhaṃ proktaṃ triśālāmaulikaṃ tu tataṣṭāṃśavyāsasaṃyuktaṃ daśāṃśāyāmasaṃyutamantaḥ śālādvibhāgena madhyāṅkaṇasamanvitāśālākāraṃ sabhākāraṃ maṇṭapaṃ vāṅkaṇaṃ bhavetpāśvayorbhadrasaṃyuktamaṅkaṇasyoktarūpavatnetrāṇi cārdhakūṭāni karṇāśliṣṭāni cāṣṭa camaṇṭapāgrajaśālā syātpakṣaśālā tu vārsthalemadhye śālā sabhā vā syānmadhye vāraṇamiṣyateśālāgrapṛṣṭhapārśveṣu dvibhāgenaikabhāgataḥhārāṅkālaṃkṛtaṃ kuryācchrīvardhanamidaṃ matamśikharaṃ tu sabhākāraṃ mukhe śālāsyameva cavistāre daśabhāgāḥ syurāyāme dvādaśāṃśakāḥantarvāraṃ bahirvāraṃ śālāyāstvekabhāgataḥcatasro'rdhasabhāyāstāḥ saktāvāraviśeṣataḥśālāsye vā sabhāsye vā bhadre vārāntare sthiremadhyaṃ vāraṇake kalpyaṃ savāre vāsabāhyataḥśeṣaṃ harmyasthalaṃ kāryamaṅkaṇaṃ tu viśeṣataḥetadeva sabhākāraṃ śiraścenmukhyavāsakamvistāre dvādaśāṃśaḥ syādāyāme navabhāgakamaṅkaṇaṃ bāhyato vāramekaśālādvibhāgataḥagraśālā ca tadvatsyāccheṣaṃ sarvaṃ tu vārsthalamhārāṅgaśobhitaṃ tacca maṇṭapaṃ pravidhīyatekarkarībandhayuktāstu vāsāśliṣṭāstvime matāḥbahuśālānusāreṇa sabhāśālānane matetadbāhye ca caturdikṣu pañcabhāgavinirgamāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatraiva ca caturdikṣu vedabhāgaviśālataḥtatpārśvayordvayoścaivāntarālā dvyaṃśavistarāḥmadhyavāraṇabāhye tu pārśvayordvyaṃśavistaredve śāle ca prakartavye dakṣiṇe cottare'pi caviparītāyasaṃyuktāścaikabhāgāntarālakāḥpurataḥ pṛṣṭhato vāpi madhyavāraṇapūrvakamathavā caturaṃśena śālā pūrvavadīritābhāgadvayāntarālaṃ tu dakṣiṇottarakūṭayoḥanyatsarvaṃ samānoktaṃ nāmnā caitatsumaṅgalamtadeva cāṅkaṇaṃ mukhyaṃ vāsaśālākhyamīritamahanyametaduddiṣṭamanyatsarvaṃ tu pūrvavatvistārāyāmatorkāṃśaṃ manvaṃśena samāyutamśālāvyāso dvibhāgena sarvatra parikīrtitaḥmukhyadhāmno mukhe pṛṣṭhe śālā syānnāsikādvayamagraśālāṃśake koṇe kūṭe dvyaṃśena nirmitebahirāvṛtavāraṃ syātpatākākuḍyasaṃyutamśālāsabhāmukhe pūrve pūrvakāryāgraśālakekhaṇḍaharmyasamāyuktaṃ samantātparikalpayetśālāyāmaviśālena pañcabhāgaviniṣkramātdakṣiṇe cottare vāpi bhadrayośca dvayorapitadagre maṇṭape madhye vedabhāgena nirmitampārśvayormaṇṭapaṃ vedabhāgenaiva tu vārsthalamtatpārśvayordvayorvedadvyaṃśenaiva tu nirmiteubhayoḥ pārśvayorvāre kāryā cārdhasabhāmukhāpṛṣṭhataḥ purato bhadradvaye tvevaṃ samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadagre maṇṭapaṃ vedabhāgenaiva tu nirmitampārśvayormaṇṭapasyaiva vedabhāgena vārsthalamtadagre vāramekāṃśaṃ kuḍyaṃ cāpi prayojayetmukhaśālā prakartavyā viśeṣeṇa vimānavatetattadvardhamānaṃ syādbhūpālānāṃ praśaṃsitammanoramyamiti khyātaṃ dvijātīnāṃ praśaṃsitamaṅkaṇaṃ tu sabhāraṃ syāt śrīkaraṃ caitadīritamaṅkaṇaṃ vedabhāgaṃ syācchālāvyāso dvibhāgataḥaṅkaṇaṃ tu sabhāraṃ syānmukhyāgāraṃ tu koṣṭhakamśālāvaktrasamāyuktaṃ tadbhadraṃ ca kramojjhitamvārsthale bāhuśāle dve mukhyāgārasya pārśvayoḥparito vāramekāṃśaṃ sabhāraṃ syājjalasthalampārśvayorubhayoścaiva śāle kārye vicakṣaṇaiḥkarṇakūṭacatuṣkaṃ tu tatra koṇeṣu kārayetcaturbhāgasamāyāmaṃ savāraṃ mukhapārśvakenīḍāṣṭakaṃ prakartavyaṃ diśāmukhamidaṃ matamaṅkaṇaṃ maṇṭapākāraṃ nāmnā vipulamucyatemaṇṭapaṃ cāgraśālāsthadvayaṃ hitvā tu kūṭakamvistāre daśabhāgāḥ syurāyāme dvādaśāṃśakamaṅkaṇasya puraḥ pṛṣṭhavāramekāṃśato bhavetbahirvarṣasthalaṃ caikabhāgaṃ bhāgena vārakambahirvarṣasthalādbhadradvayaṃ bhadrānvitaṃ bhavettayormadhye'nulomena śālāyāmamiheṣyateekabhāgāntarālena sarvāḥ śālā niveśitāḥmadhye vārāṇamiṣṭaṃ syāducchritaṃ svāmivāsakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jālakaistoraṇaiścaiva nāsikādyairalaṅkṛtamtadeva mukhyāgārasya śikharaṃ tu sabhākṛtipūrvaśālāgramūlasthaṃ karṇakūṭadvayaṃ bhavetmukhyāgāraṃ tu goṣṭhābhaṃ koṣṭhāgraṃ tvaṅkaṇaṃ bhavettatraiva pūrvabhāge tu koṣṭhakasya dvibhāgataḥṣaṇṇetraṃ syāditi brahmāṅkaṇaṃ koṣṭhānane'pi cajayantaṃ nāmataḥ proktaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutamaṅkaṇaṃ tu caturbhāgaṃ śālādvyaṃśena bāhyataḥkhaṇḍaharmyāṅgake bāhye vedabhāgena nirmitamtayormadhye caturdvyaṃśe catuḥ śālāḥ prakīrtitāḥhārabandhaṃ yathāsthānaṃ kāmāṅkaṇamudīritamtena vāraṃ prakartavyaṃ mukhyāgārasya cāgrataḥśālāsyamaṅkaṇaṃ ca syātkarkarīkṛtavaktrakambhadreṇa bhadrasaṃyuktaṃ sukhadaṃ svastikaṃ matamdvicaturbhāgasaṃyuktamaṅkaṇaṃ tasya bāhyataḥbahirvāramalindaṃ ca khaṇḍaharmyaṃ ca bhāgaśaḥcaturṇāmapi madhye tu kuryācchālācatuṣṭayamantarvinyāsavatkhaṇḍaharmyaṃ tu parikalpayetantare pañjarān kuryātkhaṇḍaharmye viśeṣataḥaṅkaṇāvṛtavāraṃ tu nandicchandaṃ pradakṣiṇamsamavaṃśaṃ yathākāryaṃ khaṇḍaharmye tu koṇakeśālācatuṣṭayaṃ kuryācchālāvyāsārdhanirgamamprāsādavadalaṃkuryānnandyāvartaṃ dvijottamāḥaṅkaṇaṃ maṇṭapaṃ kuryāducchritaṃ tatamīritamsarvaṃ tu maṇṭapākāraṃ śālānāṃ parikīrtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rucakaṃ cedamākhyātamanyatsarvaṃ tu pūrvavatśālāvyāso'pi tadvatsyādvārāditritayaṃ tataḥśeṣaṃ tu vārsthalaṃ kuryātsupratiṣṭhitamīritamanyadvarṣasthalaṃ sarvaṃ nāmato jayamaṅgalamkūṭākāraṃ caturdikṣu maṇṭapaṃ parikalpayetvistāre ṣoḍaśāṃśāḥ syurāyāme'ṣṭādaśāṃśakāḥtadbāhye dvāramekāṃśaṃ śālāvyāso dvibhāgataḥalindaṃ caikabhāgena khaṇḍaharmyaṃ tu caikataḥbāhuśālādvayaṃ kāryaṃ tatsaṃśliṣṭaṃ tathā bhavetmadhyavāraṃ ca bhadraiśca khaṇḍaharmyaiśca maṇḍitamagre śālāsamāyuktaṃ triśiromaṇṭapaṃ tu vāetatpadmakamityuktamanyatsarvaṃ tu pūrvavatvindhyāntaṃ caiva kṛṣṇāntaṃ kanyāntaṃ tu himācalātnāgaraṃ drāmiḍaṃ caiva vesaraṃ sārvadeśikamnāgaraṃ sātvike kṣetre vesaraṃ syāttamo'dhikekāliṅgaṃ ca varāṭaṃ ca grāhyaṃ satvarajodhi'keūrdhve cāmalasāreṇāṣṭavargaḥ kumbhaśūlayukrathaiḥ pratirathaiḥ koṇairanyonyādhikabhadrakaiḥsoṣṭrabhāvādibhirnīḍayuktopāntaiścaraṇḍakaiḥūhapratyūhasaṃyuktamojānojāṃśamuṇḍayukśukanāsikayopetaṃ pārśvayoḥ pramukhe mukheyathāyukti yathāśobhaṃ vidhātavyaṃ hi nāgaramprakṛtyupari janmordhve sopapīṭhamasūrakamjanmopapīṭhādhiṣṭhānastambhaprastarakandharaiḥmānasūtrādbahistiryaksamasūtrāṅgabhadrakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nālikāndhārikādhārahārorasyābhimaṇḍanamśukanāsikayopetaṃ yuktaṃ pramukhamaṇṭapamtathā ṣaṭsaptabhaumaṃ triḥpañcatriḥ saptabhāgabhāksaptadaśadviraṣṭāṃśanavāṣṭadaśakāṃśakammadhyakarṇavinirgacchatpramāṇabhavanānvitamyuktaṃ drāmiḍavinyāsaṃ nāgarakriyayānvitamsakhaṇḍākhaṇḍaharmyaṃ tu khaṇḍaharmyobhayātmakamevamādivicitrāṅgaṃ vimānaṃ nāma vesaramtaduparyucitagrīvaśikharasthūpikānvitamsādhāraṇatalāsaktakāyastambhaniveśanamevamādyaṅgavaicitryaṃ varāṭaṃ dhāma sammatamuttarādha upārohakriyāndhārikayānvitamcaturaśrāṣṭavṛttābhaṃ grīvāśikharasaurabhamnālikāndhārikādhārahārorasyābhimaṇḍanamṣaḍvidhākṛtiyuksadma sammataṃ sārvadeśikamhastacchedaparīhāranyūnādhikasamīkṛtamhastacchedeparīhṛtyairhṛtvā dhāmavidhānavitlabdhamātrāvihīnaṃ tu nātiriktaṃ savaktrakamtripañcasaptadvicatuḥ ṣaḍabhaktyaikatalakramātsākṣāddvitricatuṣpañcatalamaṣṭanavāṃśakamśreṣṭhaṃ trayodaśāṃśaṃ tu dvādaśāṃśamiti smṛtamtathā cāṣṭatalaṃ proktaṃ navabhaumaṃ niketanamvimānaṃ daśabhaumaṃ tu dvātriṃśatsaptabhāgayuktathā dvādaśabhaumaṃ tu catuḥ ṣaṭpañcabhāgabhāksaptatridvyaṃśakādaṃśāddaśāṣṭadaśabhāgikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: naścakaśca visargaḥ sadhī ca bahiścahina sathākuśca yaśca yakāraśca svarādyo raścamocaraḥākāraśca sabinduśca yenamenyaḥ pra eva caoṅkāraśca vimakāraśca kātapāśca tathā ca mopiśca naściṣitau caiva guśca paśca tathā ca naḥbuṃśca tathāsṛca īkāraśca sabindukāḥbhaśca saśca likāraśca vakāro rephapūrvakamyenaśca yanvo samato dakāraśca yayau tathāsavisargo takāraśca lācamaḥ savisargakaḥnaścaśiśa tathā paśca makāraśca sapūrvakaḥsavisargo makāraśca svarādyaśca tathā ravauhuṅkāraśca tathā rūmau makāraśca na pūrvakaḥlatomaḥ savisargaśca likāro bindusaṃyutaḥnaśca śiśca tathā tiśca yakārodyasvaroja caṣyeca jaśca mṛkāraśca vahanāsvāca maśca vaicakāre maparaṃ kiñcit tañca paśca papovahekarikāraśca tathā kāca liścānusvārasaṃyutamyakārarātabhāgāca dvātriṃśatpaṅktike nyasetniśavaśca tathā śiśca napūruśca tathā ca gautathā ca śibhe prāyāścaiva gāruḍātakāro vāgavastaśca nahuṃṣaṭsvāśca saśca vaiśiśca raśca sabinduśca japūrvaśca jñakārakaḥdāhāte lilanaścaiva ūnanāśca tathā calibhaśca vaḥ savisargaśca niśca taśca tathā ca ṣaṭgaśca teja tathā vece nagāmaśca tapūrvakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: daśadvādaśabhūmyantā saṃkhyā khyātā kramāgatāavirodhena vinyāsabhūṣaṇaṃ sārvadeśikamdvividhā bhaktayo grāhyā vesare sārvadeśikedrāmiḍe svāṅgaviśleṣe kṣetrabhāgocitaṃ kṣaṇāttricatuḥpañcamātrābhiḥ kapotaiḥ sthalaniścayaḥsaikatripañcabhaktyaṃśaṣaṇṇavaikādaśāṃśabhākśreṣṭhamadhyahīnasya bahiḥ śeṣeṇa bhittikādvitale nāgarasyoktā nālīgehaviśālatāaṣṭādaśāṃśe saptāṃśastritale nāgarasya tupañcasaptanavāṃśaiśca bahiḥ śeṣāstu bhittayaḥsaptatryekādaśāṃśe ca catuṣpañcaṣaḍaṃśakamgarbhe navadaśāṃśe tu bahiḥ śeṣāstu bhittayaḥtripañcasaptabhirnālī ṣaḍaṣṭādaśabhājitenavaikādaśaviśveṣu catuṣpañcaṣaḍaṃśakaḥdvitrivedāṃśake viṃśatyaṃśe navadigaṃśakaḥekadvitritalānāṃ tu garghastvevamudāhṛtaḥyathākramaṃ vā tadbāhyaṃ sarvaṃ vā sārvadeśikenāgarādiṣu sāmānyaviśeṣālaṅkṛtisthitiḥevaṃ garbhagṛhaṃ proktaṃ bhadrasya vidhirucyatetattāraikāṃśaniṣkrāntā madhye mūṣā kanīyasīmūle dvipañcaṣaṭsaptacatuṣpañcaṣaḍaṃśikāṣoḍaśāṃśe ṣaḍaṃśāṣṭādaśasaptāṃśavistarāḥkaniṣṭhe navapañcāṃśāḥ saptatryaṃśābdha madhyameniṣkrāntirāsāṃ pūrvoktarītyaivaṃ parikalpyatāmvyāsadviguṇa-utsedhāḥ kāmadādyāstu nāgare
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭāṃśeṣu viśāleṣu utsedhāḥ śāntikādikāḥnāgare samahastāḥ syurdrāmiḍādiṣu pūrvavatpañcādaśāṃśake pañcabhāgotsedhaṃ tu śāntikamnāgaraṃ pauṣṭikaṃ nāma saptāṃśoccaṃ śivādhikamjayadaṃ nāgaraṃ tasmāddaśāṃśādhikatuṅgakamevaṃ nāgaraliṅge tu saudhamojaḥpadena tuudayaṃ drāmiḍaṃ proktaṃ śāntipuṣṭijayāvahamadbhutaṃ cābhivāraṃ ca sārvakāmikamucyatepauṣṭikaṃ tuṅgajayadaṃ jayadaṃ vesaraṃ matamdrāmiḍe vesare liṅge samabhāgapramāṇataḥmānave labdhadairghyaṃ yat tadviraṣṭāṃśake kṛteardhārdhādhikahīnaṃ tu dvyantaraṃ tu viśālakamaṣṭādaśāṃśake tuṅge kauśikendriyavedikamvesare viṃśadaṃśe tu vasubhānurasāṃśakamliṅgāyāmasamo vyāsaḥ pūjāṃśoccadvayena vāvyāsārdhamucchrayaṃ kuryāddvātriṃśaddvyaṃśameva vāuttamo navabhirbhāgairdrāmiḍe pīṭhavistaraḥtasya cocce'ṣṭabhāge tu tyaktvaikaṃ dvitribhāgikamdrāmiḍe vihitaṃ hyevaṃ vesaraṃ tu nigadyatepīṭhasya saptanandāṃśairadhamottamamiṣyateviṣṇubhāgasamutsedhaḥ śeṣaṃ bhūgatamiṣyateviṣkambhatriguṇo vyāso'dhastādbrahmaśilāṃ nyasetyasya liṅgasya viṣkambhaścāṣṭabhāgaikameva vāeṣā nāgaraliṅge tu brahmākhyā kathitā śilāliṅgavyāsāṣṭabhāgaikaravātā drāmiḍabhūśilā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatpādāṃśakayopetā śilā vā vesare sthitāviparīte vipatyai syātkartuḥ kārayitustathāprāsāde'pi tathā liṅge niyamo neṣyate dvijāḥmukhyatvātsarvaliṅgebhyaḥ sarvatrāpi ca sammatamśāntikaṃ pauṣṭijayadamadbhutaṃ sārvakāmikamdvibhāgaścaraṇotsedhaḥ prastaro'ṣṭāṃśahīnakaḥsthūpikāṣṭāṃśahīnā syāddrāmiḍaṃ caikabhūmikamtāroccaprastaro bhāgo galaṃ bhāgavinirmitamdrāmiḍaṃ pauṣṭikaṃ proktaṃ daśāṃśe tu sapādakampādamānaṃ galaṃ proktaṃ sarvātmyāṃśaṃ śiro bhavetdvādaśāṃśe sapādāṃśaṃ masūraśca tribhāgabhākekāṃśaṃ galamityuktaṃ caturardhaṃ śiro bhavetsapādaḥ prastaraḥ proktastvekena galamiṣyatesārvakāmikasaṃjñaṃ tu drāmiḍaṃ parikīrtitamniṣkarṇakūṭaṃ vā kāryaṃ sanīḍaṃ vā satoraṇamgarbhāntargalaveśastu yadi syānmaraṇaṃ bhavetnāgare drāmiḍe dhāmni vesare tvadhipā matāḥkaṇṭhātprabhṛti vṛttaṃ yadvesaraṃ parikīrtitamsārvadeśikadhāmnyetannāgarādyaṃ prakīrtitamaṣṭāśraṃ ca ṣaḍaśraṃ ca tattadāyāmameva cavṛttaṃ vṛttāyataṃ cāśraṃ vṛttaṃ cānyatprakīrtitamliṅgādyaṃ kathitaṃ pūrvaṃ vapustatrāpi kathyateūrdhve ṣaḍbhūtavedāṃśaṃ tyaktvādho lakṣma kārayetpṛṣṭhe tayoryūtihīne vedāgninayanānyathajyeṣṭhe ṣaṭpañcavedāgnipādabhāgānadhastyajet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadardhaṃ pārśvasūtrāgraṃ tāraṃ proktaṃ munīśvarāḥhīne hīne bhavedaṣṭayavaiḥ śreṣṭhottame dvijāḥdrāmiḍe śivabhāge tu tripañcāṃśe kṛte kramātnavabhāgairdaśāṃśena hyekādaśavibhāgakaiḥsaptāṣṭanavabhāgebhyaḥ sūtre saṃlambayetkramātmadhyame bhūtavedāgniyūkaiścāpi yutirbhavetsvabhāgātsūtravistāraḥ pakṣasūtraṃ puroktavatcaturbhāgaṃ tadūrdhve'tha pṛṣṭhe dvyaṃśaṃ vihāya caathavātha trayāṃśaṃ tu tyaktvordhve rudrabhāgataḥevaṃ drāmiḍaliṅgasya brahmasūtraṃ prakalpitamnālāyāmaḥ samuddiṣṭastvaṣṭabhāgātprabhṛtyadhaḥdvaḥdaśāṃśārcanābhāge ṣoḍaśadvyaṃśamūrdhvataḥvyāse dvirasṭabhāge tu bhāgaḥ syātsūtravistaraḥevaṃ vesaraliṅgasya brahmasūtramudāhṛtamtathā pīṭhe tu pīṭhasya nāgarādyaṃ vidhīyatenāgare vesare yogyaṃ kāliṅge'pi varāṭakegarbhe dhiṣṇye masūre ca dvāre stambhe ca mastakecaturthyaṃśodayā hīnā ṣaḍviṃśatyantare'ntaramnāgare tritrisaṃkhyāni drāmiḍe navasaṃkhyayāsāttvikaṃ rājasaṃ caiva tāmasaṃ ca kramāttridhātāmasaṃ cānyarūpe tu yojanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥdhāmavāstvamarāṇāṃ tu nāgarādyaṃ paraṃ matamkheṭādau parameśasya brahmasthāne'ṣṭadikṣu vāeteṣāmantarāle vā prāsādaṃ kartumārabhetdakṣiṇe drāmiḍaṃ kuryādvahnau vā nairṛte'pi vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: somapārśvadvaye tadvadyamapārśve yamoktivatdhāmānyetāni sarvāṇi drāmiḍāni bhavanti hieteṣāmiṣṭakāmādyāmiṣṭadeśe samācaretnairṛtepyekadeśasthaṃ sabhāyā vāvirodhataḥpārvatībhavanaṃ sārvadeśe śarvoktavannayetvighneśvarasya madhye vā pūrvokte vā yathā śivesenānībhavanaṃ kāryaṃ yathā śarvasya sammatammadhyame ca caturdikṣu nairṛte'nyatra brahmaṇaḥvāruṇyāṃ vātha yāmyāgnimadhye vā grāmamadhyamegrāmādimadhyame'nyatra yathā vā brahmamandiramaṣṭadikṣviṣṭadeśeṣu kṣetreśe drāmiḍaṃ tataḥjeṣṭhādhāma yathā vācastvindrapāvakamadhyameśāsturdhāma vidhātavyaṃ yathā vighneśamandiramnāgaraṃ somavāyavye vāstuvaiśravaṇaṃ gṛhamkāmadhāma yathā viṣṇorathavānyatra deśataḥprāguktānāṃ ca devānāṃ devīnāṃ sārvadeśikamsārvadeśikasaṃjñasya prāsādasya ca lakṣaṇamlakṣaṇaṃ brahmaśailasya tadvadberādilakṣaṇamcaturaṃśādisaṃsthānaṃ bhūmilambamiti smṛtamhastānāṃ saptatistāre śataṃ tuṅge prakīrtitamtriṣaṣṭi vistṛtaṃ tatra navatyunnatamīritamcaturhastamaśītyuccaṃ daśabhaumaṃ dvijottamāḥpañcasaptatisaṃkhyātaṃ navabhaumaṃ prakīrtitamṣaṣṭyunnatasamāyuktamaṣṭabhaumaṃ prakīrtitametatsapta iti proktaṃ ekaviṃśatisaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tithihastaviśālaṃ yadekaviṃśatituṅgakamsaptatyantaṃ dviraṣṭādi vistāre vā prakalpyatāmvistāre cāpi cotsedhe dvitrihastakṣayeṇa tumahastritalasyeṣṭatribhedo naiva vidyateekādyekādaśāntānāṃ hastānāmantarakṣayātsaptaviṃśatimāne tu ṣaṭtriśatsaṃkhyakaṃ matamnavādirudrabhāgāntadhāmnāmuktaṃ pramāṇataḥetadantaramānaṃ syātkṣudramānamathocyateekabhūmipramāṇaṃ tu caturvidhamudāhṛtamdvitale tu caturmānaṃ rudrabhānukarāntakamtritale tu caturmānaṃ manuviśvakarāntakampakṣaṣoḍaśahastāntaṃ catuṣpañcatalaṃ bhavetyugmāyugmakaraṃ mānaṃ pādārdhakarasaṃyutamvimānaṃ yojitavyaṃ syātsarveṣāmapi śaṃsitamtathā bhaktyā vidheyāḥ syurāyāme dvijasattamāḥvistāre saptaṣaṭpañcacatustryaṃśe'dhikaṃ tribhiḥutsedhe dviguṇo vyāsaḥ pādādhikyaṃ ca sammatamkṣudrāṇāmevamuddiṣṭaṃ kaniṣṭhānāmathocyatevistārādadhikastuṅgo madhyamānamathocyatemadhyamānamidaṃ proktamuttamānāṃ trayāṃśakamekadvitrikarairyuktaṃ mānahīnaṃ tu vādhikamdevānāṃ sārvabhaumānāmādvādaśatalaṃ viduḥdvijānāṃ navabhaumaṃ syāddaśabhaumaṃ tu dhāma vānandādyekādaśatalaṃ ṣaṇṇāṃ vai cakravartināmrājñāṃ pañcatalaṃ vāpi mataṃ paṭṭabhṛtāṃ tu tat
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: neṣyate'dhikamānaṃ tu sarvathā tadvicakṣaṇaiḥprāsādavaśato liṅgaṃ liṅgātprāsāda eva vāsvāyaṃbhuvaṃ bāṇaliṅgaṃ daivikaṃ cārṣakaṃ tvitisvenaivodbhūtaliṅgaṃ tu svāyambhuvamudāhṛtamdevaiḥ saṃsthāpitaṃ daivamārṣaṃ ṛṣihitaṃ smṛtammānuṣaṃ manujaiḥ śiṣṭaiḥ śiṣṭaṃ ṣaṣṭhamihoditamanyeṣāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ liṅgātprasāda iṣyatemukhyataḥ siddhaye proktaṃ muktyarthamanuṣaṅgataḥmuktaye cānuṣaṅgeṇa bhavanti vidhiyogataḥdarśayedyadi mohena sarvadoṣakaraṃ nṛṇāmmānaveliṅgamānaṃ tu śiromānaṃ vinodayamkalpayedarcanābhāgaṃ tena pīṭhaṃ prakalpayettathā pañcaguṇo vāpi pīṭhavistara iṣyatekṛtvāṣṭadhā vā navakaṃ ekadvyaṃśatrayāṃśakampīṭhadviguṇamāno vā triguṇo vā caturguṇaḥgarbhagehatrayāṃśaṃ tu bhittiviṣkambha iṣyateeteṣāṃ karṇamāno vā bhittiviṣkambha iṣyatepīṭhavyāsena harmyasthanālīgehamayugmakamyugmaṃ cedyugmabhāgaṃ syātsammiśraṃ naiva kārayetyadi tatra karacchedo hīno vāpyadhiko bhavetaṅgulairgarbhamāne tu vibhakte liṅgadairghyakeāyādisampadarthaṃ ca ekadvitribhiraṅgulaiḥtriḥ saptabhāgatāre tu bhāgaṃ kṛtvā ṣaḍaṃśakamprāsādamadhyamiṣṭaṃ syātpaścime'pi tathaiva caevamādau parīkṣyaiva prāsādaṃ parikalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vistāraṃ dviguṇaṃ kṛtvā vasubhirbhājite satiudaye vasubhiḥ saptaviṃśadbhirbhamihoditamsakalaṃ triguṇaṃ kṛtvā triṃśadbhirbhājitā tithiḥpunarapyudayaṃ nandavasubhirvyaya ucyateparikṣyāyādiṣaṭkaṃ tu prāsādaṃ parikalpayetpūrvavadguṇitaṃ kṛtvā bhāgaṃ tāraṃ ca tatsamamyugmahastaiḥ svarodbhūtaiḥ śikhibhiryonirucyatetriṃśadbhaktaṃ tithiḥ syādgṛhadinatithiyogādayo yonibhedāḥāyamanyatarayoniṛkṣakaṃ vāramaṃśakaguṇakṣayakramātidaṃ liṅge ca sakale dvāre stambhādike matamparivārālaye tuṅgaharmye'nyasmin prakalpayettryaśaikāṃśo bhavedgarbhaḥ pañcāṃśāt tryaṃśameva vārudrabhāge ṣaḍaṃśaḥ syādviśvāṃśe saptabhāgakaḥvistārārdhapramāṇaṃ tu garbhavistāra iṣyateprāsādasya navāṣṭāṃśaḥ daśāṃśaḥ kūṭavistaraḥpañjaraścārdhabhāgo vā tripādo vātha bhāgikaḥbhāgārdhadvitribhāgaṃ vā pañcatriṃśamathāpi vāmahatāṃ ca vimānānāṃ racanātra vidhīyatebahirāndhārikāndhārahārabhāgena vistṛtāḥbhittyantasthaṃ pramāṇaṃ syādbhittibāhye tvabāhyataḥevamantasthavinyāso bāhyavinyāsa ucyateekaikabhāgaveśāttu kūṭaśādikaṃ nayettalamekaṃ bhavedgrāsaṃ khaṇḍaharmyaṃ tribhūmikesaptaviṃśatibhāge tu prāsādasyāya ucyatepañcālindaṃ saṣaṭkuḍyaṃ bahirāndhārikāvṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etanmaṇimaye liṅge bāṇādau vā prakalpayetpañcāśatkaraparyantaṃ navaliṅgeṣvanukramātliṅgavatpīṭhamanyena saikena trayamantaramliṅge śilāsu ca krodhe bhittipañcāṃśavarjitāḥtalastambhottarāḥ sarvasāmānyāḥ parikīrtitāḥācchāditā prapā nāma prastaraṃ cātra maṇḍapaḥanekabhūmiyuktā tu mālākārā tu mālikānāsikāmukhyapaṭyaṃśā śāleti parikīrtitāḥandhāryāndhārihāroktakhaṇḍaharmyaviśeṣitamhastipṛṣṭhayutaṃ cendraśālābhiśca samanvitambrahmadvārapatākādyairaṅgairyuktaṃ vimānakammūlakūṭasamāyuktā bālakūṭasamanvitāvividhaṃ vastumukhyaṃ syādgauṇamanyatprakīrtitamaindre vā cottare caiśe kūṭaṃ vā maṇṭapaṃ prapādarbhamālāsamāyuktaṃ diggajaiśca samanvitamekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā muṣṭimātrasamanvitampañcavācaikakuṇḍaṃ vā vṛttaṃ vā caturaśrakampañcagavyena saṃprokṣya hṛdayenānumantrataḥaṣṭatriṃśāṅgulāntāstu ceṣṭakā vistarā matāḥathavā vistarastāsāṃ pādavyāsaṃ mahālayeiṣṭakāyā iha proktaṃ vistārārdhaṃ tripādakamācārya ādiśaivastu śivadīkṣāsamanvitaḥsuśuklavastraḥ soṣṇīṣaḥ sottarīyaḥ subhūṣitaḥiṣṭakāḥ pañjagavyaiśca kṣālayedvarmaṇā guruḥsthaṇḍilaṃ kārayedvidvānaṣṭadroṇaiśca śālibhiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tilārdhaṃ lājasaṃyuktaṃ darbhaiścaiva samanvitamtadardhamadhamaṃ jñeyaṃ sarvatraiva vinirmitamsthaṇḍilaṃ pañcagavyena saṃprokṣya hṛdayena tupūrvabhāge tvakāraṃ tu yāmye tvākārameva caukāramūrdhvabhāge tu vastrairācchādya pūjayetadhidevā iha proktāḥ pūrvādīnāṃ yathākramampidhānasitavastrāḍhyān hemayuktān sakūrcakānlokapālādhipānaṣṭaśivakumbhasamāyutāntato homaḥ prakartavyastvagnikāryoktamārgataḥvahnyapāmārgakhadiravaṭāstvagnyādikoṇataḥtaṇḍulena samāyuktaṃ mūlabrahmāṅgasaṃyutamsahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śataṃ tasyārdhameva vāteṣāṃ homaṃ vidhātavyaṃ pūrṇāhutimathācaretsaṃpūjya ceṣṭakānkumbhānpūrṇāhutimathācaretgarbhavinyāsamārgoktasthāne tān vinyasetkramātmūlaṃ caiva krameṇaiva paṭhannetāṃśca vinyasetpṛṣṭhāgre tvanale vāyau jñātvā karma samācaretiṣṭakā prāgavāgekā prakṣepyādau krameṇa tupañcamītvīśavadanā śaivī prāgvadanā sureācāryaṃ prāk prapūjyātha tenaitatkārayetsudhīḥratnādīnvinyasenmadhye tvavaṭeṣu ca vinyasetgarbhanyāsoktamārgeṇa vinyaseddeśikottamaḥpuṣpaṃ nikṣipya tatraiva paścādratnāni vinyasetvāmāvarte tu saṃjāte śāntihomaṃ samācaretparivārālaye pīṭhe śālāyāṃ ca sabhāvidhau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: takārāpūrvajo maṃcaiva vaco deyānāga camakāraḥ savisargaśca mo cagā ca tathaiva caoṃkārodhaśca bhāścaiva ṣaṭ ca suśca tathā ca sāyaśca vaśca tathā hāśca makāraśca tapūrvakaḥvāśca pradīśca lāśca maścaḥ savisargakaḥśidvayośca tathā yaśca makāraḥ savisargikaḥevaṃ vinyasya cakre tu cakraṃ mantraṃ samuddharetjīvāntaṃ jīvasaṃyuktaṃ bindusṛṣṭiyutaṃ tu vāanyeṣāmapi devānāṃ nāmādvarṇaṃ sabindukamyakṣarakṣograhādīnāmevamevaṃ prayojayettāḥ śaktirudrasaṃyuktāḥ kevalaṃ vā samabhyasetmālāmantrakramaṃ vakṣye śrūyatāṃ munipuṅgavāḥsṛṣṭyādau bhidyate devi bahudhā śivaśaktikāmaheśasya bhavānī syāt śaktirevaṃ tridhā matāmanomanyā khavahnī ca māyābījasamanvitauanyāsāṃ sarvaśaktīnāṃ svanāmādyarṇamucyatehrīṃ bindurnādadhvaniparasame bindunādaṃ vimelādyān yān krāmayate nitāntamatulān kāmānavāpnotyasaudaśākṣarādhikā mantrāstannyūnā bījasaṃjñakāḥbhūtārṇādyadhikā bālye tannyūnaphaladāḥ sadāvaśyoccāṭaviṣādādau pumāṃsaḥ kṣudrakarmaṇivyomāgnikūṭadīpārṇairāgneyapracurastataḥnamaḥ phaṭkārayogābhyāṃ krūrasaumyau paraiḥ paraḥvāmadakṣamarudvāhakālayostau guṇau mataupuṭadvayapravāhe tu prabodhaḥ saumyaraudrayoḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anenaiva prakāreṇa karma caitatsamācaretekahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā trihastaṃ parito'dhikamtatra cikvaṇapāṣāṇamuṣṭimṛdvālukādibhiḥpañcāṃśadbyaṃśatryaṃśaṃ vā hīnaṃ vā parikalpayetjalena pūrite tatsthaṃ nirūnamudakaṃ yadipatite bhāramātre tu na nimnaṃ ca bhavedyadiādau prakṛtibhūmiḥ syāt triprakārā tu sā smṛtāaṣṭādaśāṅgulā madhye hīne syāddvādaśāṅgulāṣaḍaṅgulakṣayeṇādau caturardhaṃ dvitīyaketadupānamiti proktā saiva bhaumā prakīrtitāpādavistāramānena sādhyardhadvitridaṇḍakamupānopari padmaṃ vā sopānaṃ tu tadūrdhvataḥunnatārthaṃ ca śobhārthaṃ rakṣārthaṃ ca balārthakamupapīṭhaṃ vidhātavyamadhiṣṭhānodayārdhataḥpañcāṃśe tu trayāṃśena vahnyaṃśe tvaikabhāgataḥdvidaṇḍaṃ vā tridaṇḍaṃ vā nirgamaṃ pādabāhyataḥnavapaṅktyaṃśakaṃ kṛtvā tryaṃśoccopānabhiṣyateṣaḍaṃśaḥ karṇamiṣṭaḥ syāccheṣaṃ prāgvatprakīrtitamtadevordhvamadhastāccedambujena vihīnakamtadardhaṃ karaṇaṃ prāgvadaṃśenottaramiṣyatealindāntaritaṃ dvyaṃśaṃ pratyutsedhaṃ tu tatsamamuttare caikabhāgaṃ syādrudrabhāgena kīrtitāantarītaṃ tu bhāgena bhāgābhyāṃ prati iṣyatetriḥ saptāṃśata utsedho dvābhyāṃ janma tathāmbujamardhenābjaṃ tathā kampamaṣṭāṃśaṃ karṇamīrtitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhāgārdhamūrdhvakampaḥ syāt triḥ saptāṃśe tadunnatebāhyavājanamekena kampamaṣṭāṃśakairgalamsiṃhebhamakarairvyālairbhūtaiḥ patrailaṅkṛtamarpite nārpite matsyaiḥ sarvatra parikalpayetcatuḥpañcaṣaḍaṃśaṃ vā saptāṣṭāṃśamathāpi vāparilopya vidhātavyamādyaṅgaṃtvopapīṭhakamdvividhaṃ tadiha proktaṃ pratyaṅgaṃ paṭṭikāṅgakamjagatyaṣṭāṃśakenoktā kumudaṃ tatsamānakamkarṇastvaṃśena kampaṃ syāt tryaṃśaṃ vājanamiṣyatepadmamaṃśena kartavyaṃ śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretpadmamaṃśena kartavyaṃ kampamekāṃśato bhavetpadmamekāṃśato jñeyaṃ vājanaṃ dvyaṃśamiṣyatepañcāṃśā jagatī proktā padmamekāṃśato bhavetśeṣaṃ prāgvatsamuddiṣṭaṃ kampastambhodayāśritamkampamekāṃśato jñeyaṃ ṣaḍaṃśaṃ jagatirbhavettribhāgaṃ kumudaṃ padmamekāṃśaṃ parikīrtitamdalamaṃśena kartavyaṃ vājanaṃ dvyaṃśamīritamekabhāgena janma syātpañcāṃśā jagatirbhavetārtādhiṣṭhānatuṅgena dviguṇāpātatuṅgatāekāṃśaṃ jalajaṃ proktaṃ galamardhāṃśato bhavetardhena padmamardhena kampaṃ dvyardhāṃśakairgalamṣaḍaṃśā jagatī vedabhāgaṃ ca kumudaṃ bhavetkampamekena kartavyaṃ vājanaṃ dvyaṃśamiṣyateṣaḍviṃśatyaṃśakaṃ proktaṃ sarvasmin dhāmni yojayetekena kampakaṃ pañcabhāgena jagatī bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kampakarṇau dvibhāgena ekaṃ kampaṃ tathābjakamevaṃ syātpādabandhaṃ tu chedanīyaṃ yathocitampratibandhaṃ pravakṣyāmi trayoviṃśatibhājiteāliṅgamardhabhāgaṃ syāt dvāviṃśatyaṃśake kṛtetadevaṃ kumudaṃ proktaṃ vājanaṃ syātkapotakamdevadvijanarendrāṇāṃ praśastaṃ nānyajātiṣuambujaṃ kumudaṃ bhūtairekāṃśaṃ padmamiṣyatepratyutsedhaṃ tribhāgena sābjakṣepaṇamaṃśukamaṣṭabhāgaṃ mahāpadmaṃ dṛgekenāṃśato'mbujamkampamekena karṇastu tribhiraṃśena vājanamāliṅgāntarite dvābhyāṃ pratibhāgadvayena tuekaviṃśatibhāge tu janmabhāgena kīrtitamjagatī kumudaṃ ṣaḍbhirekenāliṅgagamaṃśukeekabhāgena kartavyaṃ latāpatrādiśobhitamvājanaṃ syānmahāpadmaṃ saptabhāgena kīrtitamabjamekena kampaṃ syādaṃśamagnyaṃśakairgalamāliṅgāntarite dvābhyāṃ pratibhāgadvayena tuekena janmaṣaḍbhāgairjagatī śarabhāgikamekena kampamaṃśena galaṃ tryaṃśaiḥ kapotakamtattadeva bhavedūrdhvaṃ bhāgenāntaritaṃ bhavetsārdhajaṃ vārdhajaṃ kampaṃ mahāpadmaṃ śarāṃśakampadmamaṃśaṃ bhavetkampamaṃśena parikīrtitamdvābhyāṃ janmāṃśataḥ padmaṃ kampamekena kīrtitamekāṃśaṃ padmamekena padmaṃ kaṇṭho dvibhāgataḥekena kampamaṃśena tryaśaṃ dvābhyāṃ pratirbhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tryaṃśaṃ pratiśca kampaṃ ca tyaktvānyairanyadiṣyatejagatī caturaṃśena kampaṃ padmaṃ dvibhāgakamekāṃśaṃ padmamāliṅgamaṃśamantaritaṃ tathāyavamekaṃ samārabhya caikaikayavavardhanātmasūrakamadhiṣṭhānaṃ vastvādhāraṃ dharātalamjagatyā niṣkramo yāvat tāvadeva ca kairavevetrāṇāmapi sarveṣāṃ caturbhāgaikanirgamaḥevaṃ nivṛttamevaṃ syāt śobhābalavaśena vāsvāyambhuvādiliṅgeṣu praticchando na doṣakṛtjanmādipañcavargeṣu tattadaṃśe'vasānaketadadhisṭhānamānaṃ ca śrūyatāṃ munipuṅgavāḥnṛpāṇāṃ trikaraṃ sārdhaṃ dvihastaṃ yauvarājakametajjātivaśād bhūmivaśādatraiva kathyatetritalasyottamasyeṣṭaṃ pādenonaṃ dvihastakammasūrakonnataṃ pañcahastairdvātriṃśadaṅgulamaṣṭatriṃśāṅgulaṃ cānte trayodaśaviśālataḥnavatriṃśāṅgulaṃ tatsyāccaturdaśakarasya tuārtotsedhāṃśamānaṃ vādhiṣṭhānasya vidhīyateadhiṣṭhānochrayo vā syāt pādatuṅgonameva vābhāgena vā prakartavyamaṅgulairvā yavaistu vāadhiṣṭhānādiṣaḍvargepyevameva samācaretpādaśca dvividho homastambhaḥ syātpratipādakaḥayaṃ dvādaśabhūmeḥ syāttalaṃ prati talaṃ pratianenaiva kramānneyaṃ ṣoḍaśakṣmāntameva hijātītarāṇāṃ kṣapaṇaṃ dvābhyāṃ vā tryaṅgulena vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvyaṅgulena kṣayo bhūmau bhūmāveva ṣaḍaṅgulādvyantarāṇāṃ ca sarveṣāṃ dvābhyāṃ vā tribhiraṅgulaiḥārtādhiṣṭhānatuṅgena dviguṇaḥ pādatuṅgakaḥārtotsedhāṃśamānaṃ tu ṣaṭsaptāṣṭanavāṃśakamathavā stambhatuṅge tu vasunandadaśāṃśaketadvyāsārdhaṃ ca pādena tridvyaṃśaṃ vā prakalpayetśilāstambhaviśālaṃ syādyatheṣṭaṃ vā prakalpayetbhāgaṃ kṛtvaikabhāgena vordhvordhvaṃ stambhatuṅgatādvitrivedacaturdaṇḍaḥ kuḍyavistāra iṣyateucyate caturaśraṃ ca vṛttaṃ vā tatprakīrtitambrahmakāntaṃ vijānīyādvyāsatriguṇamānataḥsarvatrāṣṭāśrasaṃyuktaṃ kumbhamaṇḍyādisaṃyutambhānukāntaṃ tadagraṃ syātkalāśraṃ candrakāntakampūrvoktākṛtisaṃyuktāḥ pūrvāśrā nanu kīrtitāḥsamatribhāgamānena caturaṣṭāśravṛttakamśuklabhedasamāyukta īśakāntaḥ prakīrtitaḥcaturaśraḥ tadūrdhve tu ṣoḍaśāśrādisaṃyutaḥvistṛtaṃ tu tadūrdhvoccaṃ mūle padmāsanaṃ bhavetdvitridaṇḍaviśālocco lūkhalo yadi mūlataḥudayaṃ tu caturbhāgaḥ siṃhavyālebhabhūtakaiḥupariṣṭācca tannāmnā pādāśca bahavo matāḥtribhāgaikaṃ ca vṛttānāṃ vedāśrāṇāṃ tu pādataḥpādonadviguṇaścaiva dviguṇastūnnatikramātbhānukānta iti proktaḥ taducce tu navāṃśakeāsyamaṃśamathāṃśena padmamardhena vṛttakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kumbhavistāra uddiṣṭaścādhyardhaṃ cāsyamīrtitamdṛkkaṇṭhau ca vidhātavyau pādavistāramānataḥkiñcidagraṃ vihīnaṃ syātkamalaṃ tadadho bhavetmūlasthānamadhastatsyāddaṇḍamānamathocyatemaṇḍitā pañcadhā kṛtvā sārdhena phalakāsanamdaṇḍākrārastu vetrāntaṃ pādākārasamo bhavettridhā maṇḍī samākhyāta pādordhve potikā bhavetstambhatriguṇamānā sā daṇḍodayasamāyutācaturdaṇḍasamāyāmā tripādodayasaṃyutāpañcadaṇḍasamāyāmā daṇḍamānasamodayāyatheṣṭaiḥ pārśvayoścaiva samudrormiriti smṛtātaduccastritribhāgena tasyāstvagre tu paṭṭikāchāyāyāmaṃ taduccārdhaṃ tridvyaṃśaṃ vātha kalpayetsanālikaṃ samatalaṃ siṃhavyālādimaṇḍitampūrvāśracaturaśrāṇāṃ nāgavṛttā prakīrtitāsamudrormistathānyeṣāṃ pādānāṃ phalakā matāhastādipañcahastāntaṃ ṣaṭṣaḍaṅgulavardhanātsamāḥ stambhāntarāḥ sarve prāsāde sārvadeśikesāyaṃ cāpi ca tatsarvaṃ tatprakāreṇa kārayetiṣṭakābhirdrumaiḥ sarve stambhāḥ kāryā vicakṣaṇaiḥuttaraṃ vājanaṃ caiva muṣṭibandhaṃ mṛṇālikamāliṅgāntaritā caiva pratyaṅgaṃ vājanaṃ kramāttribhāgenaikabhāgena uparyupari yojayetkhaṇḍottaraṃ patrabandhaṃ rūpottaramiha dvijāḥkhaṇḍottaramiti jñeyaṃ pādenotsedhasaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ardhoccaṃ pādavistāraṃ rūpottaramihoditamsvastikaṃ cārdhamānaṃ ca nandyāvartasamākṛtiprāguktotsedhasaṃyuktaṃ tatpādādatha vistaramtaduccatricaturbhāganirgamodgamasaṃyutamāyataṃ tricatuḥpañcadaṇḍairardhaṃ tripādikamsanālīkavidhīkaṃ syānmṛṇālikamathoparistambhavyāsī tripādoccā tvardhapādonavistarātulāvistāratāroccā jayantī syāttuloparisthānamārgaṃ jayantyamūrdhve pārśvagaṃ tūttaraṃ bhavetjayantī vaṃśakā jñeyā tulāvadanumārgakamtulāvalīkayormadhye dvidaṇḍamathavā punaḥpādātpādavivṛddhyā tu tridaṇḍāntaṃ prakalpayetanumārgayutaṃ vāpi rahitaṃ vāpi kārayetdārubhirveṣṭakābhirvā yathābalaghanānvitamtripādodayayuktā vā vidheyā vājanopariadhyardhadvitridaṇḍo vā nirgamaścodgamo bhavetuttaropari saṃsthāpya vājanasya tadūrdhvakamdaṇḍārdhātpādavṛddhyā tu tridaṇḍāntaṃ taducyatepādāṣṭāṃśaṣaḍaṃśaikaphalakaiśchādayet parichādayellohaloṣṭairvā mṛlloṣṭairvā dvijottamāḥdaṇḍikā pādatārārdhaṃ tadardhaṃ hi ghanaṃ bhavetsanālīkaṃ tu maṇḍyaṅgaṃ daṇḍaniṣkramasaṃyutamtulācchedena vā kuryāt stambhāgravipulānvitamkāyapādaṃ nayeddhīmān daṇḍikāvājanāntaredaṇḍikāmuṣṭibandhāntaḥ samādyāyasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hastimuṇḍakasaṃsthānaṃ kumbhamaṇḍīsamāyutammaṇḍanaṃ tvantare kāryaṃ daṇḍikāmuṣṭibandhayoḥmuṣṭibandhasamākāraṃ caturaśrasamākṛtidaṇḍikordhve tu valayaṃ gopanaṃ syāttadūrdhvataḥvasantakaṃ vālindaṃ vā vidheyaṃ vājanoparievaṃ syāddṛḍhakalpaṃ tu śilayeṣṭakayā drumaiḥkapotoccatribhāgaṃ vā pādaṃ vā kṣudranidrakamsapādadaṇḍā vādhyardhadvidaṇḍā vistṛtānvitāvidheyā svastikākṛtyā nāsikordhvena nāsikāvātāhatacalaccārulatāvatkarṇikākriyāpādapādaghanopetaṃ pādātpādavinirgamaḥpādārdhavipulaṃ tvardhanivṛtyāśrāgrapaṭṭikāpādākāraṃ tripādārdhasadṛśodayasaṃyutāpādena vājanaṃ kuryāttadanantaramucyatevikāraḥ syāttu devānāṃ dvijānāṃ bhūbhṛtāmapidaṇḍaṃ sapādaṃ sārdhaṃ vā pratinirgamanaṃ nayethīnādhikyaṃ tu cāṅgānāṃ prastarasya dvijottamāḥsyāt pādaprastara grītvāvarge mūle tu vedikāṣaṭsaptāṣṭadaśotsedhā tatsamaṃ dīrghikā bhavetgrīvotsedhatribhāgācca grīvādhastātsthirā bhavetśeṣo'dhastambhakhaṇḍaḥ syād bhittiḥ pādaviśālabhākcaturdhā bandhanaṃ kṛtvā kampamekena kārayetpādaṃ vā pañcabhāge tu tridvyaṃśaṃ vājanaṃ bhavetardhena kampamaṃśena vājanaṃ parikalpayetnetrāṃśena tathā nidrā kapotaṃ caturaṃśakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nidrā kāryā tadūrdhvasthā paṭṭaṣaṭkasamanvitāvājanaṃ caikabhāgena nidraikā vājanaṃ tribhiḥṣoḍaśāṃśe tadutsedhe navāṃśaṃ galamiṣyatepaṭṭapadmamathaikāṃśaṃ padmamekena kīrtitamdvārārthaṃ devaveśmārthaṃ chedanīyaṃ yathocitamevaṃ vediḥ samākhyātā dvāraṃ tu śrūyatāṃ dvijāḥdvāratuṅgaṃ tadardhaṃ syādvistāro devasadmanipañcatriṃśadbhavettuṅgamidaṃ vaiśeṣikam bhavettrivitasti viśālaṃ syāddairdhyaṃ saptavitastikamvṛddhyā tripañcamānādiṣaḍvitastyantakāni hitadādyaṃ śayanīyasya gṛhasya dvādaśaiva hinagaragrāmadurgāṇāṃ śeṣāṇyuktāni veśmanāmnavamātrādhikaṃ vāpi sarveṣāṃ samudīritamdvitālaṃ kṣudramānaṃ tu sārdhatālaṃ tu yojayetnyūnaṃ tu śubhadaṃ vāraṃ viprādīnāṃ gṛhaṃ matamtadardhe navabhāge tu sārdhāṣṭāṃśātsamunnatiḥpādottuṅgavaśādbhūmau bhūmāvevaṃ vidhīyatāmvipule'pi tathaivaṃ syātṣaṭsaptāṣṭāṃśakaistu vābhūṣaṇaṃ tu bahiḥ kāryaṃ sarveṣāmapi sadmanāmparihṛtyāṅgulicchedamāyādyaṃ parikalpayetguṇatvaravidiṅmūrtiṛkṣasaptanavāṃśakaiḥaṃśakāścāvaśiṣṭāstu kalpanīyāstu deśikaiḥkabhittivisṛtārthaṃ tu tyaktvā tatpārśvayordvayoḥkampadvāraṃ ca madhye tu yogārthaṃ bahulānvitammūlavāstutripārśveṣu kampadvāraṃ yathocitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: na tyajedyadi tatsvāmī maraṇāya bhaviṣyatistambhavyāsasamo vāpi tadardhaṃ bahulaṃ matamdvārodayāya śeṣaṃ tu tridhā vā pañcadhā kṛteśeṣeṇa bhūṣaṇaṃ kuryācchuddhadvāraṃ tu madhyamamtricatuḥpañcaṣaḍbhāgabhāgena stambhavaipuleayugmaphalakā grāhyā madhyasandhivivarjitāmadhyaṃ tyaktvā prayoktavyā yathābalasamanvitādaṇḍāstripaṃcasaptaiva navaikādaśasaṃkhyayāyugme mahati talpe ca dakṣiṇasthe kavāṭakeupariṣṭāttrayāṃśaṃ tu tyaktvādhoṃ'śaṃ dvipārśvayoḥyathābalaṃ yathāśobhamayaḥpaṭṭairdṛḍhīkṛteardhacandraistathā śṛṅgaiḥ puṣpairnānāvidhairapiūrdhvādhaḥ śikharāśliṣṭamūlabandhāgrabandhanambadhnīyātsarvadeśe vā yathāśobhaṃ yathābalampadmapatravicitrāṅgā paṭṭāṅgā skandhapaṭṭikāargalaṃ dakṣiṇe bhāge vāmabhāge tu talpakamantaraṃ ca vinirdiṣṭaṃ jñātvā karma samācaretanyayorekamuddiṣṭaṃ mahādvāre caturyugamkavāṭayugmaṃ kartavyaṃ kokilārgalasaṃyutamtathā kavāṭo vā kāryo yantrairbahuvidhairapidvāreṇa siddhaṃ dvāraṃ tu rathyārūpādivoditambhittiṃ kṛtvā tu paṃcāśadantastriṃśadbahirdvayamathavā yogavistārastvaṅgulaistribhireva vābahulaṃ prāgvaduddiṣṭaṃ pādaṃ vā tadudīritamekāṃśahīnaṃ tanmānaṃ dvāraṃ śuddhamihoditam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yugmendvanalavedenducandrākṣidvyakṣipāṇayaḥkhakaivyomākṣi vyokṣyāgni varṇaścāścayujādayaḥvedāgnyānalapāśyākṣi locanairbhūtapañcakaiḥityarṇakalpanārāśerānukūlyaprasiddhayesvastike lipimālikhya śaṅkaraṃ ṣoḍaśātmakaiḥmantrādyarṇāntakā bhūyaḥ siddhasādhyādikalpanātevamanyatra sāddhyādau caturddhā kalpanā matāsvasiddhaḥ pāṭhamātreṇa sādhakāniṣṭado ripuḥśiṣyo'pi śīlasaṃpannaḥ putro vā śivabhaktimānputre kṣiptaṃ chalātprāptaṃ gṛhītaṃ grantharūpataḥjapeccādikriyāsiddhyai mantrapaḥ sādhakottamaḥekārṇasiddhidaścaiva daśalakṣajapādibhiḥevaṃ bījajapaḥ kāryastaddvitriguṇasaṃkhyayāanuktasaṃkhyā mantrasya śataṃ sāṣṭasahasrakammūlāddaśāṃśato'ṅgānāmarcāhomajapādikamprāgāsyaścottarāsyo vā mantrāṇāṃ syājjapādikamsarvadoṣaharaṃ puṇyaṃ manaḥprītikaraṃ paramvāyavyañca mahendrākhyaṃ snānaṃ ṣaḍvidhamīritamniṣkampaṃ dīpikākāraṃ praṇavātmakamavyayamgatvā niketanādbāhye vijanaṃ sajalāśayammūtrakaṇṭakakīṭāsthiviṣṭhādiprāvṛtaṃ tyajetśmaśānārāma goṣṭhaikadrumaśṛṅgāṭakādiṣucandrasya sammukho bhūtvā bhūtānāṃ vikṛtestathāśirovakuṇṭhanaṃ kṛtvā tyajettadubhayannaraḥmaunī gulmādisañcchanno nāsāgrāhitalocanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ dvāraṃ samākhyātaṃ toraṇaṃ śrūyatāṃ dvijāḥtatpādaḥ pādapādonadvyaṃśastryaṃśo'thavā mataḥuttarāntasamutsedhe navāṣṭadaśabhāgikeuttaraṃ ca tridaṇḍaṃ syāttadardhaṃ vājanaṃ bhavettadardhaṃ vājanaṃ cordhve tatsarvaṃ syātsanātanamcitratoraṇamityeṣāṃ maṇḍanaṃ cādhunocyatedvayormakarayorvaktraiḥ saktaṃ madhyamapūritamtadeva pārśvayormadhyaṃ pūritaṃ ca dvayorapividyādharaiśca bhūtaiśca siṃhebhavyālahaṃsakaiḥcitratoraṇametatsyāddevānāṃ bhūbhṛtāṃ varamcaturaśrāṣṭavṛttābhāḥ kumbhamaṇḍyādisaṃyutāḥutsandhyādavalambaṃ tu kuryānmakarapṛṣṭhakamcatudaṇḍāntamānaṃ tu guhāveśanamiṣyatedakṣiṇe dakṣiṇāmūrti liṅgotthaṃ tasya paścimeardhamaṇḍapadakṣāṃśe vighneśaṃ nṛttarūpiṇamnānākārayutaṃ vāpi sarvatraikaṃ tu vā nyasettale tale tu devāṃśca gale cāpyevamācaretindraṃ vāhanayuktaṃ vā rudrarūpaṃ tu vā nyasetguhādvayaṃ prakartavyaṃ dvārasyobhayapārśvataḥvihāya ca guhābāhye dvārapān viniveśayetdakṣiṇe nandisaṃjñaṃ tu mahākālaṃ tu vāmataḥdakṣiṇānanayukte ca uttarāsya eva meva vāyasyāṃ diśi bhaveddvāraṃ tāṃ prācīṃ parikalpayetsarvatra cottare nālaḥ somasyābhimukho bhavetevaṃ praṇālamākhyātaṃ padmamadhye viśeṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvāratulyo natirtryāsāntaraḥ stambhadvayorapiphalakaṃ pañcavaktraṃ tu tadūrdhve śūlasaṃyutamnandyāvartaṃ ca devānāṃ sarveṣāmaṣṭamaṅgalampatākā ca pradīpaśca devānāmaṣṭamaṅgalamśrīvatsaṃ svastikaṃ śaṅkhaṃ dīpaścaivāṣṭamaṅgalamchatralakṣmīpradīpāśca dvijānāmaṣṭamaṅgalamchatraṃ caiva pradīpaśca bhūbhujāmaṣṭamaṅgalamśrīnandikau mahāśaṃkho vaiśyānāmaṣṭamaṅgalamśrīdīpachatrabheryaśca śūdrāṇāmaṣṭamaṅgalamtoraṇaṃ citrasaṃjñaṃ tu vaiśyānāṃ pravidhīyatejālakaṃ phālakaṃ śailamaiṣṭyaṃ kuḍyaṃ ca iṣyatestambhānāmantare cetstambhān saṃsthāpya cāntareūrdhvādhaḥ padmakampaiśca bhittibandhanameva vāniṣpādaṃ vā sapādaṃ vā kuḍyaṃ śailamathaiṣṭakamkuḍye stambhalatā kāryā vastvādhārasya coparicitrakumbhalatā pūrvā stambhakumbhalatā parākumbhakumbhalatāmūle daṇḍadviguṇavistaraḥpādonatriguṇā vāpi tadardhenocchrayo bhavetnandyāvartāvalambaḥ syātkumbhataḥ pādanirgatiḥpadmādīnāṃ ca kampātī? mānaṃ śobhābalānugamkumbhordhve stambhatārā*? nakrapatrāvalī kriyāyathā śobhāntaravyāsā? muktā śaṅkhāntare sthitātasyāstvalaṅkṛtiḥ prāpta?vallīmaṇḍanamaṇḍitameṣāṃ niṣkrāntiveśī tu yathāśobhaṃ samācaretpādapādaviniṣkrāntapadmapaṭṭavicitritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: muṣṭibandhopari kṣiptaṃ vyā?lāntaṃ kalaśāvadhipadmahṛtpadmasaṃyuktaṃ tadūrdhve narabandhanamvīrakāṇḍāvadhi kṣeṇī? tadūrdhve nakrapaṭṭikāūrdhve makaratuṇḍasya pūritaṃ maulibandhavatghmātaśaṅkhaṃ tu bhūtaṃ vā kārayeduttarādadhaḥcitrakumbhalataivaṃ syātstambhakumbhalatānyathāpaṭṭikā padmadhṛgveṣa *?padmopari paṭṭikāūrdhvasthapūrṇakumbhāṅkā kumbhakumbhalatā matākhaḍgādiphalakāntāṅgā tadūrdhve pūrṇakumbhavatstambhakumbhalataidṛk syādanyadapyevamūhyatāmṣaḍaṣṭadaśabhirbhānumanuvaikāramātrakaiḥvṛttākāraṃ samaṃ cetu toraṇāṅghrivadāyatamvṛttasphaṭikamatroktaṃ dyusthasadmavibhūṣitamtribhāgaiḥ śikharañcaikabhāgaḥ sthūpyudayo bhavetkūṭakoṣṭhādisarvāṅgaṃ mānasūtrādbahirnayetcaturaṃśraṃ tu vasvaśraṃ ṣoḍaśāśraṃ tu vartulammadhye nāsāsamāyuktam ardhakoṭīsamanvitamanekasthūpikopetaṃ koṣṭhakaṃ madhyaśo bhavetpañjaraṃ vihitaṃ kūṭakoṣṭhayorantaraṃ dvijāḥeṣa jātikramaḥ proktaḥ karṇakoṣṭhasamanvitamchandametatsamuddiṣṭaṃ kūṭaṃ vā koṣṭhakaṃ tu vāvikalpamiti nirdiṣṭamābhāsaṃ tadvimiśritamviparīte vināśāya bhavedeva viniścayaḥsārdhapañjaramanyatsyāttṛtīyaṃ pañjaraṃ matamsiṃhaśrotraṃ tu ṣaṣṭhaṃ syātkhaṇḍaniryūhakaṃ tataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śliṣṭaprāsādanīvrāṅgavipulaṃ samanirgamamvedikājālakastambharājitaṃ siṃhapañjaramyathārhāyāmasaṃyuktaṃ sūcipādadvayaṃ dvijāḥdhāmni prāsādamāśliṣṭaṃ satīvraṃ cārdhanirgatammukhapaṭṭikayopetaṃ vedikājālakānvitamprāgvadvipulasaṃyuktaṃ pādanirgamanānvitampañjaraṃ syādidaṃ śeṣaṃ prāgvadatra samīritamkapotādyaṅgasaṃyuktametanniryūhapañjaramniryūharahitaṃ yuktaṃ sarvāṅgaṃ lambanāsikamsaṃśritaṃ karṇapādena siṃhaśrotraṃ taducyatenīvrādhastātkapotādyaitśairmaṇḍitarūpakamdaṇḍadaṇḍāntaniṣkrāntanīvrādhastāduparyadhaḥjhaṣapañjarametatsyādaṣṭamaṃ nāmato dvijāḥsāṅghridvyaṃśena pādaḥ syādardhena prastarodayaḥūrdhve tu bhāgamāropya śirastena samācarettadaṣṭāṃśādhikaṃ vātha śeṣaṃ syādupapīṭhakampādukottarayormadhye navāṃśenopapīṭhakamsārdhāṃśaṃ prastarotsedhaṃ madhyāṃśaṃ vedikodayampañjarākṛtisaṃyuktaṃ kapotāttu vinirgatamkapotapañjaraṃ hyetatprāsāde sārvadeśikeśālākāraṃ sabhākāraṃ prasādaśikharāvṛtibrahmadvāramiti proktaṃ vimānānāṃ sanātanamsapatākā bahirgrāhyāstadvistāralupānvitāḥgarbhadvitrikaravyāsā śukanāsā mukhe mukheṛjujālakramādyaṃ syādgavākṣaṃ kuñjarākṣakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṛjukampayutaṃ yattu ṛjujālakamucyatetadeva caturaśrotthaṃ kuñjarākṣamiti smṛtammūlamapyagragulikamṛdubhittyantarārcitampatrairvicitrita randhraṃ patrajālakamiṣyatenandyāvartamiti proktaṃ vedyardhve jālakaṃ nayettyaktvā bhityāṅghrimadhyaṃ tu saptadaṇḍāntavistṛtamardhapādena kampoccamaṣṭāṃśādhikameva vābhittimadhyādbahistasyāḥ stambhayogakavāṭayukpādavarge bhavedgrīvāvarge vātāyanasthitiḥmūlaṃ trividhamuddiṣṭaṃ caturaṃ vṛttamāyatamvallīmaṇḍalamityūrdhve gomūtreṇa samanvitammūlādagrāgramākṣīṇaṃ śaṃkhasopānamiṣyateaśvapādasya vistāraṃ dviguṇaṃ ca caturguṇaṃśayitaphalakavyāsaṣaḍaṅgulamudāhṛtamdairghyaṃ tithiguṇāntaṃ syādyathākāmaṃ tu vā bhavethastisopānakaṃ lājasopānaṃ vṛddhisaṃjñakamhastavyāsaṃ tu daṇḍāditridaṇḍāntaṃ prayojayetayugmameva sopānaṃ prādakṣiṇyakramānnayettanmūlaṃ syādadhiṣṭhānaṃ pādaprastaravargayukīdṛglakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ sopānaṃ sampadāṃ padamjanmādipañcavarge tu bāhye nālaṃ prayojayetpañcāṅgulaṃ samārabhya caikaikāṅgulavardhanātaṅgulatrayamārabhya cārdhāṃgulavivardhanātsamaṃ tripādamadhyaṃ vā ghanacchidraṃ tu madhyameṣaṭsaptāṃśatrayaṃ vātha vedāṃśaṃ vā prakalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūlātpañcatribhāgaṃ vā dvibhāgaṃ vā prakalpayetpatitaṃ siṃhavaktrādyaiḥ kevalaṃ vā prakalpayetpotikārahitaṃ vīrakāṇḍopari samanvitamtadūrdhve jhaṣakāṇḍaṃ syānnānācitravicitritamsarvālaṅkārasaṃyuktaṃ stambhatoraṇamīritamśālāmadhyāntarāle tu kuryātsarveṣu dhāmasuadhiṣṭhānādiṣaḍvargasahitaṃ mūladhāmavatsakalaṃ niṣkalaṃ miśraṃ yadyadrūpaṃ śivasya tumadbhaktānāṃ svarūpaṃ yanmānuṣaṃ vā gajādikamsarvaṃ dhāmani kartavyaṃ dhāmnaḥ ṣaḍvargameva vāpīṭhākṛtiṃ vā mervādiparvatākṛtimeva vāmaṇḍape gopure vapre parivārālayādiṣupañjarādiṣu paryāyavacanaṃ tviha kathyatesabheti kūṭanāma syācchāyā valabhireva caṛjuvaktraṃ dvijāvāsaṃ krīḍaṃ syātsiṃhavaktrakamgajapṛṣṭhaṃ ca tattuṇḍaṃ gajavaktraṃ gajāparambhitterākhyeyamākhyātaṃ gṛhapiṇḍirathocyatesaṃjñaivaṃ gṛhapiṇḍeḥ syādandhāraṃ gṛhamādyakammasūrakamadhiṣṭhānaṃ vastvādhāraṃ dharātalamsthāṇuḥ sthūṇaśca pādaśca jaṅghā ca caraṇāṅghrikamprastaraṃ caiva gopānaṃ kapotaṃ mañcameva cakandharaṃ galasaṃjñaṃ ca kaṇṭhaṃ grīvā śirodharamśikharaṃ śiramūrdhā ca śikhā mauliśca mastakamsthūpikā ca ghaṭaḥ kīlo culukaḥ sthūpirityapivimānaṃ bhavanaṃ harmyaṃ saudhaṃ dhāma niketanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ālayaṃ nilayaṃ vāso'pyāspadaṃ vāstu vāstukamlayaṃ kṣayamagāraṃ ca tathopavasitaṃ punaḥdhāmnaḥ samyak samākhyātā evamanyatsamūhyatāmtanmūle vedikā kāryā kaṇṭhotsedhāttribhāgataḥcatuṣpañcaṣaḍaṃśe tu samāveśādhivedikāsamaṃ vādhyardhakaṃ vāpi dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ tu vāuttaraṃ vājanaṃ caiva muṣṭibandhaṃ mṛṇālikamdaṇḍikāntaṃ galaṃ proktaṃ tadūrdhve śikharaṃ bhavetūrdhvena sthāpitāste ca dhāmno'dhastātsamantataḥanyeṣāmapi devānāṃ dhāmni tadvāhanān nyasetekapādayutaṃ brahmaviṣṇusaṃyuktameva vāpūrvoktavidhinā vāpi pādavarge'thavā nayettatraiva kārayedvṛttaṃ sphuṭitaṃ ca samantataḥśikharotsedhamānāṃśabhāgamānavaśena vāsaptanandaśivāṃśeṣu trayodaśatithau tathāsaptāṣṭāṃśaṃ tu tārārdhamityaṣṭau śikharodayāḥkosalaṃ śaurasenaṃ ca gāndhāraṃ patrikaṃ tathājaghanādūrdhvamevaite bhāgāḥ sarve samīritāḥekādaśātsaptadaśabhāgādekāṃśavardhanātvyāmiśraśca kaliṅgaśca tathā kauśikameva catathā śauṇḍikamityevaṃ vyāmiśrādilupodayaḥcaturaśraṃ ca vṛttaṃ ca ṣaḍaśrāṣṭāśrameva catathāmalakapatrābhaṃ dīrghavṛttaṃ ca komalamṣaḍādyāṣaṣṭikarṇāntāḥ sammataṃ śikharākṛteḥcaturvidhā lupāsaṃkhyā deve devyā niketane
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ūrdhvasthānyapyadhasthāni puṣkarāṇyardhamānataḥārohaṇyavarohāṇi guhyametadudāhṛtamkoṣṇīṣāsitasīmākhyaṃ sūtraṃ yuktaṃ ghanaṃ nayetāsane caturaṃśādi nyasedvindudaśāntakānavākvāthoccamānāni kaṃ mūlādāsanaṃ nyasetkoṣṇīṣasaṅgātparyantabindvantaṃ tallupāyanamvinyasedāsane vāpi tanmānaṃ syāllupāvadhievamāvartya tatpaścādārohe vāvaruhya casamadhyaṃ vā vimadhyaṃ vā lupānyāso dvidhā mataḥkotirityevamucyeta pañcavarṇalupāḥ kramātśayitasthitisūtrāntaṃ kīlaṃ tatkūṭamūrdhanilupāvilupamadhyāntargatā sā cūlikākṛtiḥbālakūṭasya vistārasthitisūtrastanāntaraḥyathābhimatamāno vā vistarādbahulādapijānuvyāsastūttarārdhacūlikā vārdha eva vāvalayaṃ jānu nīvraṃ ca daṇḍikāvipulārdhataḥparyantājjānukāntaṃ ca cūlikābhāga eva vākuṭhārikā lalāṭaṃ ca jaghanaṃ caiva sammatamkūṭavyāso lupāmadhyaṃ dvikarṇo dviguṇo yathāchidraṃ tannīvramātraṃ vā mallānāṃ tu praveśanamsamaṃ syānnīvratārābhyaścūlyaṃśo vā lupāṃśakamtadardhaveśanānnīvraṃ valayasya vidhīyateālipya ca dhanurvaṃśaṃ nikṣipya ca tadūrdhvataḥlupāmadhyādatha chidraṃ valayasya vidhīyatekukṣivyāsāṣṭabhāgaikaṃ mānamātramiti smṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āpañcadaśasaṃkhyātāḥ parilekhyāstu ṣoḍaśatadbandvādi vilekhyātha rūpalekhāvicakṣaṇaiḥlupāgamādyaddviguṇaṃ yanmānaṃ tena buddhimāntasmādupari mallasya lekhayettadvicakṣaṇaḥtattadaṃśāvasānaṃ tu tattanmadhye samālikhetpāñcālādilupānāṃ tu pratyekaṃ procyate dvijāḥmadhye kṛtā kriyārekhā parilekhā tu sā smṛtāvitastyāyāminīmṛjvīṃ kṛtamadhyamasūtrakāmvinyasya ghaṭikāṃ paścācchinnāṃ śayanasūtravatkṣiptasūtrasya śeṣāṃśacchinne varṇalupodareudarāyāmamadhye tu likhite karakaṃ bhavettathā nidhānaghaṭikāṃ lupodaravaśāyatāmiṣṭapārśve kṣipecchāyāṃ chidre ca valasya tutallalāṭagatacchāyā tāsāṃ tāsāṃ tu vā bhavetghaṭikāmadhyamāyāmachidrāṇi valasya tusuvarṇā madhyabandhāśca kharjūradalasannibhāḥśikharoccacatuṣpañcabhāgaḥ syātpadmatuṅgakamśikharasya tribhāge tu nāsikāvistaro bhavettadvatsatricaturbhāgahīnaṃ skandhāṅgatuṅgakamsārdhadaṇḍo dvidaṇḍo vā kṣudranāsāviśālatāsapādo vā tripādo vā tadghanaṃ syādyatheṣṭataḥmukhapaṭayuktamāno vā tāvattatkandharādayaḥgrīvopari kapolaṃ taddviguṇaṃ sārdhameva vātāvacchaktidhvajāntaṃ syātsapatraṃ vā saśūlakamśayitasthitipaṭṭābhyāmaṅgulādyairvibhūṣitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yathāśobhananiṣkrāntaṃ trimukhaṃ syāttadūrdhvataḥpadmoccaṃ vārdhabhāgo vā tadūrdhve sthūpikāyatilohajaṃ dārujaṃ vāpi sthūpikākīlamiṣyateagramaṅgulavistāramānupūrvātkṛśaṃ nayetvṛttamūrdhvamadhaḥkuryācchikhipādānnyasedadhaḥāyāmaṃ tu yathāśobhaṃ tathā kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥstambhavyāsārdhavistāraṃ tricaturbhāga eva vāśikharākṛtivatkīlaṃ liṅgacchandamathāpi vāsaptāṃśavistarastasyāstadūrdhve ca tu vājanamtribhāgo vistaraṃ cordhve vājanaṃ cordhvamucyatepañcāṃśo vistarastambhaḥ kumbhaṃ pañcāṃśanirmitampañcāṃśo vistarastasya vetramardhavinirmitamvistāreṇa dvibhāgaḥ syādūrdhvaṃ vājanamardhataḥvistāraṃ caturaṃśa syāt kampakarṇantu kampakamvājanaṃ caikabhāgena ṣaḍaṃśo vistaro bhavetvistāraḥ syāttribhāgena tadūrdhve padmakuḍmalamcaturaśradviraṣṭāśraṃ sādhāraṃ vartulaṃ tu vāpadmakaṃ pañcakarṇaṃ tu pañcakaṃ padmatuṅgakamvedāṃśaiḥ karṇamityuktastadūrdhvaṃ pūrvavannayetīdṛglakṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ vimānaṃ sampadāṃ padamevāmadau tu śāstrārthamālocyālekhya buddhimānprārambhakāle sañcitya sarvavastu samācaretpramāṇasahitaṃ caivamathavānādikaṃ tu vākāmikādyāgamoktena pramāṇena samācaretsiddhānte noditaṃ cettu gāruḍādyaṃ pragṛhyatām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāsāpīḍanāniṣṭhīvahrasvodnārādikaṃ tyajetkāṣṭhagomayapāṣāṇakāsthyādi parivarjayetśuddhāmaśarkarāṃ mṛdvīṃ mṛdaṃ śaucārthamāharetmṛdamanyāvaśiṣṭāñca śaucārthaṃ parivarjayetśaucaṃ samācaredekamṛdā jananaśodhanamdaśabhirvāmahastantu saptabhiścobhayaṅkaramāmalīphalamātrantu mṛtpiṇḍaṃ yojayetsakṛtgṛhe maitrapade vāpi kṛtvā cāvaśyakakriyāmsaṃgrāhya dantakāṣṭhantu hareddantagataṃ malamsārdraṃ tvaganvitamṛjuṃ samacchedamṛjūdvahamkarañjañciribilvañca khadirañcārjunantathābhuktaye dhavadhātrī ca mākulīnimbasambhavamvarjayeddantakāṣṭhaṃ tadanyallohavinirmitampalvalāḥ plavanāścaiva saṃgamāḥ puṇyatīrthakāḥadhamā dīrdhikādyāsu kūpe caivādhamādhamamvasvaṅūgulapramāṇantu khātvoddhṛtyāstramuccarannidhāya jalatīre tu saṃsicya śirasaiva tunābheradhastādbhāgena cānyenāstraṃ samuccaranhastābhyāmāsyadṛṅnāsāśrotrādīni pidhāya cajale snātvaivamuttīrya dīkṣāyuktastrivarṇakaḥbhajettadante śaivīntu saṃkṣepavidhimāśritaḥitarastu virāgātmā laukikārthaparāṅmukhaḥdīkṣito gaṇajātiścedastrasandhyāmupāsayetsthitvā vāmakare karyāt tribhāgamudagānanaḥmūlena daśadhendusthaṃ bhāgamevantu mantrayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vaktraikyamuttamaṃ proktaṃ tantraikyaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavettadabhāvānnikṛṣṭaṃ syādevaṃ budhvā samācaretmukhyatvātsarvaśāstrebhyaḥ sarvatra parikīrtitamsthūpikāsthāpanaṃ caiva vakṣye tacchṛṇuta dvijāḥavilambena kartavyaṃ sumuhūrte śubhe dinemaṇṭapaṃ navahastādipañcahastāntameva cakuṇḍāni paritaḥ kuryādbhūtavedaikasaṃkhyayāmaṅgalāṅkurakāryaṃ tu pūrvameva samācaretmaṇḍapaṃ samalaṃkṛtya puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥpañcamṛtpañcagavyaiśca śuṃddhodakasamanvitamkṛtakautukabandhastu vañjairāveṣṭya deśikaḥaṣṭadroṇena śālīnāmardhenārdhena vā bhavetvastrairdarbhaiḥ samāchādya hṛdayena tu mantrataḥsthāpayetparitaḥ kumbhānaṣṭau vastrādisaṃyutāngandhādyairarcanāṃ kuryāddhṛdayena vivakṣaṇaḥikāraṃ dakṣiṇe nyastvā ukāraṃ paścime nyasetnandāṃ bhadrāṃ jayāṃ pūrṇāṃ krameṇābhyarcayetsudhīḥsamidājyacarūṃścaiva tilaṃ vai homayetsudhīḥpradhānasya palāśaḥ syādekaṃ vā sarvakuṇḍakeśivāddaśāṃśato'ṅgāni tarpayitvā samāhitaḥmūrtimūrtīśvarānnyastvā tattvatattveśvarān nyasetnālādyaṃ sthāpayetpaścādadhivāsayutaṃ tu vātadalābhe hiraṇyaṃ vā nyastvā saṃsthāpayeddhṛdāsthāpayitvā tadūrdhve tu sthūpikīlaṃ tu vinyasetdārunirmitaharmyaṃ cedvaṃśe vā mūlakūṭake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
