sanskrit: stambhasaṃsthāpanaṃ cetu garbhasthānaṃ tu vinyasetlupānāṃ rohaṇaṃ cettu mūladhāmnastu dakṣiṇedvāre tu garbhagehasya sthāpayedyogyamāditaḥpūjayedvastrahemādyairdadyāttebhyaśca dakṣiṇāmharmyatāratribhāgaikabhūtāṃśeṣu guṇāṃśakamrudrāṃśe rasabhāgaṃ tu viśvāṃśe saptabhāgakamvistārārdhaṃ tu tatsarvaṃ nālīgṛhamiti smṛtamtricatuṣpañcamātraṃ tu pādaviṣkambha iṣyateprastaraścaikabhāgaḥ syātkaṇṭhastvekena kīrtitaḥvṛttakaṇṭhaśiroyuktaṃ vijayaṃ nāmato bhavetmadhye bhadrayutaṃ cet tu śrīviśālaṃ prakīrtitamvedāśraśikharagrīvaṃ śrīkaraṃ syāddvijottamāḥmadhye bhadrayutaṃ karṇakūṭayuktaṃ tu mastakekesaraṃ nāmataḥ proktaṃ yugāśraṃ vā galaṃ śiraḥekabhaumamidaṃ proktaṃ dvitalaṃ tu vidhīyatedvibhāgaṃ koṣṭhakāyāmaṃ śeṣaṃ hāraṃ sapañjaramadhiṣṭhānaṃ tribhāgaḥ syātpādaḥ ṣaḍbhāga īritaḥdvibhāgaḥ prastaraḥ karṇastribhāgaḥ parikīrtitaḥcaturaśramadhiṣṭhānaṃ tadvatkandharamastakamkṣudranīḍamuparyaṣṭau nāmnaitatsvastikaṃ bhavetbhāgatrayavitastyaṃghriprastaraṃ grīvamastakamantaraprastaropetaṃ kūṭaśālāntamīritamantaraprastaropetametatkailāsamucyatevasukūṭaṃ catuḥ śālopetaṃ pañjarabhūṣitamsamagrīvaśiroyuktaṃ kūṭakoṣṭhakasaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadeva śikharaṃ dikṣu cārdhakoṣṭhakasaṃyutamnānādhiṣṭhānasaṃyuktaṃ nāmnaitatsvastikaṃ bhavethārapañjarasaṃyuktaṃ nāmnā kalyāṇamiṣyatecaturṇāsisamāyuktametatpāñcālamiṣyateśikharāṣṭamahānāsiyuktaṃ syādviṣṇukāntakamtaccaturbhāgamānena cāyataṃ caturaśrakamsthūpitrayasamāyuktaṃ tannāmnaitatsumaṅgalaṃsarvāvayavasaṃyuktametadgāndhāramiṣyatedvyaśravṛttaśiroyuktaṃ netraśālāmukhānvitamcaturaśramadhiṣṭhānaṃ vṛttaṃ syādgarbhagehakamtadeva janmādyākumbhādvṛttaṃ cettu bahirbahiḥdvibhūmirevamākhyātā tribhūmiradhunocyatebhāgena kūṭavistāraṃ koṣṭhāddvitriguṇāyatamūrdhvakṣmatāre ṣaḍbhāge bhāgaḥ kūṭasya vistaraḥūrdhvabhūmerdvibhāgena madhyabhadraṃ vidhīyatevimānoccaṃ tu vibhajeccaturviśatisaṃkhyayādvibhāgaḥ prastaraḥ pādaḥ satripādaguṇāṃśakaiḥsapādabhāgo mañcaḥ syātsārdhakaṃ kaṇṭhamīritamkūṭaṃ koṣṭhaṃ ca nīḍaṃ ca vasusaṃkhyāsamīritamdvitīye ca tṛtīye ca cakranīḍāstu ṣoḍaśaśikhare tu mahānāsyaścatasraḥ parikīrtitāḥvimānākṛtikaṃ nāmnā sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutamvistāre vasubhāgāḥ syurāyāme dvādaśāṃśakammasūrakācchiro'ntaṃ tu dvyaṃśavṛttaṃ tu kārayettadadhaścaturaśraṃ syānmūlato dvyaśravṛttake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kūṭakoṣṭhakanīḍānāṃ vistāro bhāga iṣyateśikhare tu mahānāsyaścatasraḥ parikīrtitāḥsvastikaṃ tattribhaumaṃ syācchivaprītikaraṃ bhavetśālāyāmastathā dvyaṃśo hāraṃ bhāgena kalpayetaṣṭanīḍāni nāḍyaḥ syurnīḍaṃ śobhāvaśena tuvimalākṛtikaṃ nāmnā sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutamvistāre vasubhāgāḥ syurāyāme dvādaśāṃśakaḥmasūrakācchiro'ntaṃ tu dvyaśraṃ vṛttaṃ tu kārayettadadhaścaturaśraṃ syānmūlato dvyaśravṛttakekūṭakoṣṭhakanīḍāṃśavistāro bhāga iṣyateṣaḍbhāgāḥ syustadūrdhve tu pṛṣṭhatastasya pārśvayoḥūrdhvabhaumaṃ caturbhāgaṃ yathāyuktivaśānnayetgarbhakūṭopasaṃyuktaṃ kṣudranāsīvibhūṣitamśikhare dabhranāsyaḥ syustisraḥ pādasamanvitāḥharāyāṃ kṣudranīḍaṃ syādarkadviguṇasaṃkhyayāvistārāstvaṣṭabhāgāḥ syurāyāmo daśabhāgikaḥhārabhāgaṃ tu bhāgena ṣaḍaṃśañcordhvabhūmikesāyataṃ dvyaśravṛttaṃ syādvedikāgalamastakametaddhastyādikaṃ saudhaṃ gajapṛṣṭhaṃ purātanambhāgato gṛhapiṇḍī syātkandharaṃ vāṃśato bhavettribhāgaḥ koṣṭhakāyāmaḥ sārdhato nīḍavistaraḥūrdhvakṣme'pi ṣaḍaṃśāṃśaṃ kūṭaṃ taddviguṇāyatamūrdhvabhūmau tribhāgena madhye daṇḍena nirgataḥaṣṭāśra ūrdhvabhūmau tu sauṣṭhikānāṃ tu mastakamaṣṭakūṭaṃ tathā koṣṭhaṃ nīḍakaṃ ca tathā bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhadrakoṣṭhamidaṃ nāmnā sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutammastakaṃ tasya vṛttaṃ syāccaturṇāsisamanvitamtadevāṣṭāṃśadairghyeṇa sāyataṃ caturaśrakamkoṣṭhabhadravihīnaṃ vā śeṣaṃ pūrvavadācaretpañcādaśakaraṃ vyāsaṃ daśabhāgena yojayemalīndramaṃśamaṃśena khaṇḍaharmyaṃ bahiṣkramātbhāgena koṣṭhakāyāmaṃ dviguṇaṃ sammataṃ budhāḥkoṣṭhakaṃ dviguṇāyāmaṃ hāraṃ bhāgena yojayetdaṇḍenādhyardhadaṇḍena dvidaṇḍenāthavā bhavetvasukūṭaṃ tathā nīḍaṃ koṣṭhakaṃ ca tathaiva hināsikādyaṅgasaṃyuktaṃ sarvāvayavasaṃyutamevaṃ gāndhāramatroktaṃ aṣṭāśraṃ vā galaṃ śiraḥśeṣaṃ pūrvavaduddiṣṭaṃ nāmnā śrībhogamiṣyatevṛttaṃ vṛttāyataṃ dvyaśraṃ vṛttamaṣṭaṣaḍaśrakamṛjubhāgaviśālāttu dvyaśravṛtte'tha vartuleaṣṭāṃśena daśāṃśena cordhvāṃśasyodayāṃśakānvakṣye'tha munayaḥ śreṣṭhāścaturbhaumaniketanamekaviṃśatihastānto vyāsatuṅgastu pūrvavatekāṃśaḥ kūṭavistāraḥ śālāyāmo dvibhāgataḥprāgvadeva sabhāśālāpañjarāṇāṃ tu kalpanamdvibhāgaḥ koṣṭhakāyāmo nīḍaṃ bhāgordhvamiṣyateuccaṃ yadvibhajeddhāmno navatriṃśatisaṃkhyayātasyārdhaprastarotsedhaḥ satripādayugāṃśakaiḥjaṅghā ca dviguṇaṃ cordhve dvyaṃśena prastarodayaḥsyāt satripādabhāgena prastaro vedikāṃśataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śeṣabhāgaiḥ śikhāmānaṃ harmyāntaṃ caturaśrakamśikhare vedanāsāḥ syuralpanāsyastathaiva catadeva kūṭakoṣṭhādi madhyemadhye dvijottamāḥvistārārdhapramāṇena garbhagehasamanvitamnānāmasūrakādyaṅgaṃ nāmnedaṃ śrīviśālakamgarbhagehaṃ tribhirbhāgairgṛhapiṇḍastadaṃśataḥkūṭakoṣṭhakanīḍānāṃ bhāgenaikena vistaraḥśālāmadhye mahānāsī bhāgamadhyavinirgamaḥtadūrdhve vasubhāge tu bhāgamaṭṭasya vistaramāyāmastu dvibhāgena tanmadhye nīḍamaṃśataḥvistāradviguṇāyāmastanmadhye'rdhena pañjaramaṣṭāśraṃ karṇakūṭaṃ syātkoṣṭhakaṃ karkarīkṛtamkūṭakoṣṭhakanīḍānāṃ saṃkhyā pūrvavadīritābhadrakoṣṭhamidaṃ nāmnā vedabhaumaṃ divaukasāmnālibhedaṃ caturbhāgaṃ bhāgenāndhārikāṃ nayetkūṭakoṣṭhakanīḍañca bhāgena parikalpayetjalaṃ vihāya cordhve ca vasubhāgairvibhājitetadūrdhve rasabhāge tu bhāgaḥ sauṣṭhikavistaraḥtadūrdhvaṃ tu tribhāge tu madhyāddaṇḍena nirgamaḥravikoṣṭhaṃ tathā śālāpañjarāṇāmathāṣṭakamgalanāsāṣṭasaṃyuktaṃ koṣṭhakaṃ kiñcidunnatamsopapīṭhamadhiṣṭhānaṃ kevalaṃ vā masūrakampūrvavattuṅgabhāgaṃ syādetannāmnā jalāvahamgarbhavāsaścaturbhāgo bhāgena gṛhapiṇḍikākūṭakoṣṭhakanīḍānāṃ vistāro bhāga eva hi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kūṭakoṣṭhaṃ ca nīḍaṃ cāvāntaraprastarānvitamtathā dviguṇaśālā syāttayormadhye tu pañjaramvijayasya tathā proktaṃ śeṣamūrdhve tu yojayetmahānīḍaṃ dviraṣṭa syurnāmnaitadbhadrakūṭakamnāmnāvantikamityuktaṃ śambhormandiramuttamamvedāṃśo garbhagehaṃ syādaṃśena gṛhapiṇḍikākūṭakoṣṭhakanīḍam ca pūrvavatparikalpayetjalasthalaṃ vihāyordhve vasubhāgairvibhājiteūrdhvabhūmiḥ ṣaḍaṃśā syādbhāgaḥ sauṣṭhikavistaraḥūrdhvabhūmidvibhāgena madhyabhadro vidhīyategrīvānāḍī viśālā syādvṛttavedisamanvitamalpāṣṭanālikopetamasya mūlatale dvijāḥuttaṅgaśālādvitalaṃ mūle tvadhikakūṭakamnānāmasūrakastambhavedikājālatoraṇampañcabhaumamahaṃ vakṣye śrūyatāṃ munipuṅgavāḥmasūrakoccamākhyātaṃ pādaḥ sārdhaśarairbhavetbhāgadvayena sārdhena prastaraḥ parikīrtitaḥtripādavedaistalipo dvibhāgaḥ prastaro bhavetprastarodaya iṣṭaḥ syādvitardiścaikabhāgataḥvibhāgaḥ kumbha ityukto bhāgāścaivaṃ prakīrtitāḥṣaṭtalādyaṃ kramādvakṣye pañcabhūmyaṃśakaiḥ sahaprastarastadadhiṣṭhānaṃ mānenaiva prakīrtitamṣaḍbhaumamevamākhyātaṃ prāyo vistārabhāgayukstambhaṃ masūrakaṃ kuryāttāre rudrārkabhājitetadadho munimiḥ sārdhaṃ guṇāṃśaiḥ pādakuṭṭimau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭabhaumamidaṃ proktamevaṃ prājñairmunīśvarāḥstambhaṃ ca talipaṃ kuryāttāreṃ'śāḥ prāgudīritāḥtadadho'ṣṭayugāṃśaistu pādo'dhiṣṭhānamiṣyatetadadhaḥ sārdhavasvaṃśaiḥ sapādayugabhāgikepūrvoktaṃ kalpayedevamekādaśatalaṃ matamtāre ṣoḍaśabhāgādi yāvadarkadvayāṃśakamdvitrivedeṣu ṣaḍbhāgaiḥ prāguktāṃśaistu vā gṛhamprāsādasya tu vistāraṃ kṛtvā ṣoḍaśabhāgikampañcālindraṃ ca ṣaṭkuḍyaṃ pratyekaṃ cārdhabhāgataḥgarbhageho dvibhāgena gṛhapiṇḍastu bhāgataḥkūṭakoṣṭhādisarvāṅgaṃ pūrvavatparikalpayetpañcabhirgarbhagehaṃ syāccheṣaṃ pūrvavadīritamevaṃ dvādaśabhaumaṃ syāttadūrdhvamadhunocyatestambhamāne tu yuktyaiva yojayedadhikaṃ guruḥaṃśādviṃśati bhāgādīnekatriṃśāṃśakāvadhibhāgārdhenāthavālindaṃ śeṣaṃ kuḍyeṣu yojayetyugmāṃśe tu vibhāge vā kūṭavyāsā dvirāyatātalamekaṃ bhavedgrāsaṃ khaṇḍaharmyañcatustaletritalaṃ cāṣṭabhaume tu navapaṅktitale tathāṣaṭtalaṃ vasubhaume ca caturdaśatale tathāmūlataḥ kūṭakoṣṭhādi kartuṃ samyaṅmahītalekūṭaśālādibhirbhedaiḥ pūrvamākhyā yathoditāyaddravyeṇāvasānaṃ syāttanmayā ceṣṭakā matāsthāpanaṃ vakṣyamāṇena mārgeṇaiva samācaretmaṇḍapasya vimānasya saumyāyāṃ pūrvato diśi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhyame vedikāyukto darbhamālādiśobhitaḥbhojanaṃ bhūsurāṇāṃ ca puṇyāhaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ tathāaṣṭadroṇaistadardhairvā śālibhiśca tadardhakaiḥśayyāṃ ca kalpayitvātha pañcamṛtpañcagavyakaiḥsvarādyaṃ vedavarṇaṃ tu pūrvādikramaśo likhetśayyāyāṃ sthāpayitvā tu tadvāme sthūpikāṃ nyasetparito'ṣṭau ghaṭān nyastvā lokeśāśāsu tānhṛdānandāṃ bhadrāṃ jayāṃ riktāṃ pūrṇāṃ caiveṣṭakāsu cakṛtvā kuṇḍādisaṃskāramagnikāryoktamārgataḥpalāśodumbarāśvatthavaṭāḥ pūrvādidikṣu caśivabrahmāṅgamantraiśca śatasaṃkhyāṃ tu homayetiṣṭveṣṭakābhiḥ sthūpiṃ ca kumbhānkuṇḍaṃ ca pālakānpañcaniṣkādisamprāptadakṣiṇairmūrtiṃdhārakaiḥgṛhītvā ceṣṭakāṃ sthūpiṃ kṛtadhāmapradakṣiṇaḥādyeṣṭakoktarītyaiva madhye ratnādi vinyasettanmūlaṃ kumbhatoyaiśca prokṣayetsvasvamantrataḥevaṃ yaḥ kārayenmartyaḥ sa puṇyāṃ gatimāpnuyātmṛddrumopalalohotthaṃ ratnabāṇādisambhavamābhicārāya pakvaṃ tu dvihastādupari sthitamyavagodhūmacūrṇaṃ tu payovṛkṣatvacānvitamśrīveṣṭakaṃ sarjarasaṃ tathā gugguluśarkarāeteṣāṃ saṃkhyayā tulyāṃ mṛdaṃ gṛhṇīta deśikaḥnadītīre drume śaile liṅgārthaṃ dravyamāharetsaritsalilanirdhūtapavitrāntarjaloṣitāḥāyāmavyāsanāhāḍhyā raktāḥ pītāḥsitāsitāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vātātapānalālīḍhā mṛdvīkṣārodakāśritāḥantyajānītasevyā yā nadīśailataṭe sthitāḥkhādiraścandanaḥ sālo madhūkaḥ saralo'sanaḥpanasārjunāvaśokaśca kṣīriṇo raktacandanaḥdravyasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryādvakṣyamāṇaṃ viśeṣataḥtryaṃśena dārujaṃ lohamasyārdhenottamaṃ matamtadalābhe tu tanmadhye tvekaikāṅgulahānitaḥdhāmagarbhapramāṇenādhamaṃ liṅgamucyatemadhyame'ṣṭavibhāgena navaliṅgodayāni camānāni ca trayastriṃśalliṅgānāṃ kīrtitāni tuadhamaṃ garbhapādaṃ syāttripādaṃ jyeṣṭamānakamāyādiśuddhisiddhyarthaṃ bhajenmānāṅgulena tuṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ samārabhya caturviṃśatisaṃyutamāyādiśubhasaṃyuktaṃ saḍaṃśaṃ vā purā mayāliṅgāyāme vikārāṃśe caturbhūtarasaiḥ kramātāḍhyaṃ sarvasamaṃ liṅgaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ parikīrtitamliṅgāyāme dināṃśe tu saptāṣṭanavabhāgataḥsarveṣāmapi sāmānyaṃ liṅgametadudāhṛtamvarṇānāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāṃ krameṇa parikalpayetliṅgāyāmaṃ tridhā kṛtvā brahmāṃśaḥ tvekabhāgataḥekāṃśasadṛśastāraḥ samakhaṇḍo'yamīrtitaḥṣaṭsaptāṣṭāṃśakaṃ saptabhāgāṣṭanavabhāgikamsaptasaptāṣṭabhāgaṃ tu pañcapañcaṣaḍaṃśakamevaṃ śivādhikaṃ proktaṃ dvijātīnāmanukramātṣaṭsaptāṣṭakanāhaṃ tu vṛtte'ṣṭāśre yugāśrake
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalpayecchivatīrthantu bāhubhramaṇamātrataḥnimajya pihitadvāro dhyāyecchivamanāmayammūlamantrādikairmantraiḥ sekaḥ kāryaḥ sakṛtsakṛtrājavaddhemapīṭhādisusthito hemakumbhakaiḥtīrthe vinyastamantrāṃstu saṃhṛtya svahṛdi nyasettaptena liptabhūmisthapīṭhasthaḥ snānamācaretvāsasā pariśuddhena dhavalena śarīragambhuktimuktidamāgneyaṃ kāryaṃ śuddhena bhasmanākalpañcaivānukalpañca upakalpamakalpakamrogādirahitā yā gauḥ kṛṣṇā vā kapilāthavāsadyena gomayaṃ grāhyaṃ piṇḍaṃ vāmena kārayetśuṣkaṃ vanagataṃ yattu gomayañcūrṇitaṃ tathāvastreṇāntaritaṃ bhasma gomūtrairbaddhapiṇḍakamanyairāpāditaṃ bhasma akalpakamiti smṛtamtena snānaṃ praśastaṃ syānnānyena munisattamāḥtrisandhyamācaretsnānaṃ yathāsaṃbhavato'thavāsandhyāṃ samācaretpūrvaṃ śaivīṃ vā'vaśyakantathāsandhyāntare tathāgneyaṃ kevalaṃ vā savāruṇamāgneyaṃ vāruṇasnānādasaṃkhyeyaphalāvahamśodhayedanapekṣastu śuddhyai śoddhyasya vastunaḥbhāsayatyeva yadbhasma śubhaṃ bhāsayate ca yatśrīkarañca pavitrañca hāramābharaṇaṃ tathājvarāpasmārapaiśācabrahmarākṣasapiḍitāḥrudrādhyāyī mucyate sarvapāpaiḥyatiruddhūlanenaiva snāyānnityamudaṅmukhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navadhā liṅgamānena dvyaṃśaṃ madhye guṇāṃśakamtrairāśikaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ sarvakāmapradaṃ matamsarveṣāṃ brāhmaṇādīnāmapi sāmānyamīritamdhārāliṅgaṃ praśastaṃ syātsahasramadhunocyateekādhikaṃ navatyaṃśe viṣamāṃśaniveśitammukhaliṅgamatho vakṣye bhuktimuktiphalapradamyoccatārā dvibhaktā sā guṇatyāgādadho śiraḥgrīvābhujopaniṣkrāntiridānīṃ procyate budhāḥcaturdikṣu caturvaktra nirgamāya prakalpayetjānau praviṣṭā grīvā syāccaturaṅgulamānataḥnandamātrādikaṃ bhaktvā ṣaṭtālaṃ tu caturvidhampādonasaptamātraṃ tu vistāreṇa prakalpayetbhāgārdhena bhujaskandhau ṣaḍaṅgulaviniḥsṛtaucaturdhā vibhajeccheṣaṃ bhāgamātrapramāṇataḥviṣṇvaṃśatārasadṛśaṃ makuṭaṃ ca vivartayetekavaktre trayoccāṃśe sārdhonamukhadairghyakamgrīvāskandhau kramaṇaiva vardhayeddeśikottamaḥaṣṭādhikaśate liṅgadairghye dairghyāṃśa iṣyatepuṇḍarīkaviśālākhyaṃ śrīvatsaṃ śatrumardanambhavanti puṇḍarīkādibhedā bhinnaphalāptayeprāpnoti sarvān śrīvatsādvijayaṃ śatrumardanātprajāvṛddhikaraṃ yasmātprajālābhaḥ prajāpatiḥprāptamāyuḥ paraṃ prāptalokaṃ saubhāgyamuttamamsādhyāḥ siddhāśca maruto yasmādbhūtiṃ parāṃ gatāḥaṣṭadhā vibhajettāramadhyardhena vivartanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍaṃśaistrapuṣaṃ vā syātsārdhadvyaṃśena vartanamcandrakhaṇḍanibhaṃ proktaṃ vistārāttryaṃśavartitametāni sarvaliṅgānāṃ sanātanaśirāṃsi hiaśubhe tvaśubhaṃ vidyāttadarthamupari nyasetcatuṣpañcakare pañca ṣaṭsaptasu ca saptakamśirovartanabhāge tu caturthe vā ṣaḍaṃśakeśirovartanabhāgasya tryaṃśaṃ pūjāṃśakopariekāṃśaṃ yojayeddhīmāṃliṅge dvyaṃśaṃ tu madhyamekevalaṃ vā śiromānamadhiropya vivartayetvṛttadvayaṃ tu tanmānādubhayoḥ pārśvayornayetmaṇḍalaiśca tribhirmatsyadvayamatropajāyatetatra sthitvā tribhirvāsya vartanīyaṃ śiraḥśubhamchatrākāraṃ tu viprāṇāṃ kukkuṭāṇḍanibhaṃ nṛpeaparaṃ candramapyanyaliṅgabhedena kathyatecaturvidhaṃ syācchatrābhaṃ tatrādye samaliṅgakeanyo'nyasaṅkaraḥ tveṣāmaśubhāya prakalpitaḥkintu teṣāṃ vibhāgaṃ tu prasiddhoktyā samācaretsarvamaṅgalakāryādau kartavyaṃ maṅgalāṅkuramnavāhe vātha saptāhe pañcāhe tridine'pi vāsāyādidinamārabhya devānāmaṅkurārpaṇambījānāmadhipaḥ somo tasmādrātrau tu nirvapetsadanasyāgrage deśe vāme vāpyagradakṣiṇemaṇḍapaṃ tatra kartavyaṃ pūrvasaṅkalpite'thavāvitānadhvajasaṃyuktadvāratoraṇasaṃyutepuṇyāhaprokṣaṇaṃ kuryādathavāstreṇa śodhayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarāvāḥ kṛtaṃ yadutkṛṣṭaṃ vargābhyāṃ madhyamaṃ bhavetsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ nirmitaṃ mṛṇmayaṃ smṛtamekaikāṅgulahīnaṃ syānmadhyame kanyasekramātvistāre kauśikāṃśena paritaḥ śeṣa ucyatevistārayugabhāgaiko daṇḍavistāra iṣyatevidyeśvarāṅgulaḥ kumbhavistāraḥ pañcavaktrayukyathāsambhavamānaṃ vā pālikādi prakīrtitamchinnaliṅgādisaṃyuktaṃ varjayedaṅkurārpaṇeghaṭikaiśānasaṃyuktā teṣu tānarcayedguruḥmadhyamaṃ manusaṃkhyātaṃ daśataḥ kanyasaṃ bhavetmadhyamakramamuddiṣṭaṃ tridvyekaiḥ kanyasaṃ bhavetgomayālepanaṃ kṛtvā piṣṭacūrṇaiṃrvicitrayetsūtravyāptirdaśa prācyāṃ daśodīcyāṃ tathaiva cacaturdikṣu ca catvāridvārāṇi dvipadāni camadhye navapade padmaṃ pālikāṃ koṇadeśakeevaṃ dvāreṣu cānyeṣu kalpayeddeśikottamaḥmadhye vyomapadaṃ hitvā parito'ṣṭapadaṃ tyajetpālikā manusaṃkhyātāḥ paścime ghaṭikā matāḥkumbhapārśve dvayaṃ proktaṃ pūrvasmin paścime dvijāḥprāksūtraṃ munisaṃkhyātamudaksūtraṃ tathaiva caīśānakoṇādārabhya pālikā bāhyapaṅktikeantardiśāsu dvau dvau vā vāyāvīśe parā matāḥpañcapañcapadaṃ kṛtvā madhyame sthāpayedghaṭamkumbhabāhye ca ghaṭikāḥ svāntare'ṣṭau prakīrtitāḥmadhyame jyeṣṭhamākhyātaṃ madhyamadhyamathocyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhye navapadaṃ kṛtvā īśānaṃ nairṛtaṃ vinādakṣiṇe tritaye vāme ghaṭikāḥ ṣaḍvyavasthitāḥtathaiva nairṛte deśe śarāvaḥ suvyavasthitaḥpālikā ghaṭikā caiva śarāvaśca yathākramātanenaiva krameṇaiva vahnyādviṣu ca vinyasetpūrvavatpālikādyaṃ tu śarvamārabhya vinyasetprāgvannavapadaṃ kṛtvā dvāre pūrvatra paścimeetatkanyasamadhyaṃ syāttataḥ kanyasakanyasammadhye kumbhaṃ ca pūrvādipālikādīṃśca vinyasetsthaṇḍilaṃ kārayedvidvānaṣṭadroṇena śālikāśivakumbhoktavatkumbhe prasthaṃ vā pratipālikamtadardhaṃ taṇḍulopetaṃ tilalājasamanvitamdroṇenārdhena vā pūrṇaṃ kumbhasaṃkhyāsamanvitamsauvarṇaṃ candrabimbaṃ syātsadvastravadanānvitampāyasaṃ dāpayedvidvān tāmbūlaṃ dāpayettataḥdarbhaiḥ kuśaiḥ palāśairvā niśchidraṃ suṣiraṃ nayetdravyāṇi vāpayetpaścātpayasā bhāvitāni vaikulutthaṃ saptabījāni vāpayeduttamasya tuevaṃ tu madhyamaṃ proktaṃ kanyasaṃ tilasarṣapamtilasarṣapamudgāṃśca māṣaśimbakulutthakānathavānyaprakāreṇa dravyalakṣaṇamucyateniṣpāvaśālyapāmārgaśimbāvrīhyāḍhakāḥ smṛtāḥpayasā bhāvitānyatra nirvapeddhṛdayena tuvāpayedbījamukhyena prāṅmukho vāpyudaṅmukhaḥkumbhāmbhaḥśoṣaṇātpūrvaṃ gandhatoyena pūrayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nirdiṣṭadivase prāpte somamudvāsayetsudhīḥaṅkurāstu sitāḥ śastāḥ komalā ūrdhvagāminaḥtiryaggataṃ ca kubjaṃ ca varjayecchuddhakarmaṇitīrthāṅkurasya kartavyaṃ grāmādīnāṃ pradakṣiṇamtriśūlena samopetaṃ kundālyā ca samanvitamanyeṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ varjayedvā pradakṣiṇamnadītīre taṭāke vā vane puṣpavane'pi vāprokṣayedbhūtalaṃ samyak śivatoyena buddhimānparito lokapāniṣṭavā śastramantreṇa pūjayetmṛdaṃ saṃgṛhya vāmena pūrayetsthalikāntaramvāhayitvā mṛdaṃ paścātprāsādādyaṃ? praveśayetadhamaṃ caikavargeṇa kartavyā cāṅkurakriyāprasūnaṃ nālikerasya dūrvāpuṣpākṣatānvitamghaṭikāsu śarāveṣu triṣu vā cāṅkurārpaṇampūrvoktavidhinā kālaṃ kalpayetsthāpanādikejyeṣṭhāṃ ca trīṇi pūrvāṇi varjayetsthāpanādikeneṣṭau kujaśanī jñeyau śubhayuktau śubhapradauaṅkurārpaṇakāryaṃ tu prāgeva vidhinā caretuttare caiva hastāditrayasyāṣṭāṅgadikkaraiḥtribhāgena tathaiva syāduttare snānamaṇḍapamtathā mekhalayā yuktaṃ śvabhrayukśobhitaṃ bhavethastādike hastavṛddhyā tadanyeṣāṃ prakalpayetvedimānena kūṭaṃ syātprapā vā tasya bāhyataḥsarvato vātha kūṭaṃ syādalpe śobhābalaṃ yathādvādaśastambhasaṃyuktā syālliṅge madhyamatraye
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tattadbhaktipramāṇena bāhyapaṅktīḥ prakalpayetdvibhaktirmadhyame jñeyā caturviṃśatikuṇḍakejyeṣṭhaliṅgatrayaṃ vā syāt dvātriṃśatkuṇḍasaṃyutamprādhānikaṃ tadanyatsyāccakre cānantare matampañcakuṇḍamathaikaṃ vā calaliṅge'pi kathyateṣaḍaśrāṣṭābjakoṇāni dikṣvanyāsu niveśayetantarāvaraṇe tvevaṃ bāhye tu caturaśrakamprāguktavidhinā sarvamatrānuktaṃ samācaretmaṅgalāṣṭakasaṃyukto maṅgalāṅkuraśobhitaḥayaṃ tu maṇṭapo liṅge pratimāyāṃ viśeṣataḥasya prāguktadeśe tu lakṣaṇoddhāramaṇṭapamśilāvālukatoyādyairdharṣayelliṅgapiṇḍikemṛdbhiḥ kaṣāyavargeṇa gomūtreṇodakaistathāpraṇavenāstramantreṇa huṃphaṭpraṇatiyogināliṅgapiṇḍiṃ samāveṣṭya kuśavastrasragādibhiḥtilataṇḍulalājaiśca darbhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ paristaretraktavastreṇa saṃchādya yajedgandhādibhirhṛdāekāṃśasūtravistārastathā gambhīra iṣyatenavadhā sūtravistāraḥ sarvaliṅgeṣu kīrtitaḥṣaḍbhistu lakṣaṇodhāraḥ tvadhobhāge yathā bhavettatra neṣṭastu yastasmādadho lakṣma vilakṣayetpṛthvī nimnā ca tadrekhā vistṛternavamāṃśataḥtatkhātasamavaipulyaṃ kartavyaṃ śobhanaṃ yathānavabhāgānmunīnāṃ hi datvā bhāgadvayaṃ tvadhaḥvikārabhakte'dhastādvā tyaktvā bhāgadvayaṃ tathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: athavānyallakṣma tasyāṃ navabhāgakṛtaṃ samamyavārdhakaṃ dvibhāge tu vartayellakṣma śobhanamyāvattu vaiṣṇavo bhāgaḥ sūtramūle gajākṣakepakṣasūtravinirmuktamubhayaṃ tviha kīrtitamṣoḍaśāṃśe caturbhāgaṃ tyaktvordhve dvādaśāṃśakamrudrāṃśoccaṃ tridhā kṛtvā cordhvabhāgaṃ tyajet kramātvistāraḥ tatsamo jñeyo nālaṃ tu vasubhāgikammaṇirekhe tu vijñeye tayoḥpṛṣṭhe tu saṅgatiḥekena mukulīnālaṃ saptāṃśamitikīrtitammukulaṃ caikabhāgena nālaṃ pañcāṃśato bhavetmukulaṃ caikabhāgena daśāṃśaṃ nālamiṣyateekāṃśaṃ mukulaṃ jñeyaṃ vasvaṃśaṃ nālamiṣyatepārśvayorubhayoḥ sūtraṃ yathā ṛju *?bhaveddvijāḥniṣpādya bahirūrdhvasthaṃ koṇe hastaṃ vidhāya canālāyāmaṃ tu navadhā kṛtvā caikaikavardhanamnālāntare'ṣṭadhā bhakte bhāgārdhādardhavardhitampakṣasūtraṃ ca kartavyaṃ sūtraṃ mukulamūlataḥkadalīmukulākāraṃ śūlāgrāśvatthapatrakamsārvadeśikaliṅgasya lakṣmetthaṃ kīrtitaṃ dvijāḥna bāṇaliṅge lauhe vā nadīprasravaṇodbhaveratnaje lohaje lakṣma vidheyaṃ vā na vā bhavetevaṃ lakṣmalikhedvidvāngururhemaśalākayāśilpaśāstrāntarābhyāṃ tu tābhyāṃ vā lakṣma vā likhetrekhā hīnādhikā hanyādyajamānaṃ saśilpinamācāryo mantrayogyastu sthapatiḥ karma kārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tāmrake kāṃsyapātre vā madhvājyābhyāṃ samanvitedhānyarāśiṃ tato gāṃ ca savatsāṃ brahmaṇāṃstathāpracchannapaṭamānīya sthāne sthāne nayecchivamtasyottare bhavānyāstu sthāpanaṃ tatra vā punaḥdevaṃ devīṃ samāropya rathādāvapramādataḥprāsādaṃ vā mahābhāgā viśeṣaḥ kaściducyatepratiṣṭhādivasālliṅgaṃ sandhāpya ca śilānvitamkuryātsnapanamādo tu sahasrādiṣu sambhavaiḥkautukaṃ bandhayitvā tu liṅgapīṭhe krameṇa tusthaṇḍilaṃ maṇḍale kṛtvā śayanaṃ tatra kalpayetanyatsarvaṃ samānaṃ syādgarbhāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ matamjale'dhivāsayeddevaṃ dvitrirātraṃ sapīṭhakamnābhimātrodake kṛtvā prapāmaṇḍapamaṇḍitāmbhadrapīṭhe samāropya devaṃ devīṃ krameṇa tuabhito'ṣṭa ghaṭān nyastvā śambhordevyāḥ samāhitaḥjalamadhye nyasetpaścāddevaṃ devīṃ ghaṭāṃśca tānvisṛjya śilpinaṃ paścātprokṣite yāgamaṇṭapepuṇyāhaṃ vācayitvā tu vāstuhomaṃ samācaretkṛtasnānaḥ śivācāryaḥ śuddhavastrottarīyakaḥmūrtipā bhūṣitāstadvatkintūṣṇīṣavivarjitāḥdvārāṇyabhyarcya pūrvādidvārapālayutāni cavāruṇe vṛṣabhaskandau devīcaṇḍau tu sāumyaketoraṇe pūrvamārabhya dvāre śāntyādikāḥ kalāḥviśuddhakāyo mantrātmā kṛtāntaryajano guruḥkṛtapañcāṅgabhūṣastu vāstupūjāsamanvitaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śivakumbhāstrayajano lokapālārcanānvitaḥkṛtakumbhāstrasaṃpūjaḥ tadadhyeṣaṇasaṃyutaḥjalādhivāsanasthānādānīya parameśvarammṛdbhiḥ kaṣāyavargeṇa pañcagavyaphalodakaiḥpañcāmṛtaiḥ kuśodairvā snāpayedvṛṣabhadhvajamācchādya vastrayugmena gandhādyairarcayetkramātśayyāṃ ca kalpayedvidvān śālitaṇḍulakādibhiḥtilaiḥ tadardhairlājaiśca darbhaiḥ puṣpaiḥ paristaretkārpāsajaṃ krameṇaiva kalpayedupadhānakamsampūjyāsanamantraiśca śaktiṃ śayyādhipāṃ nyasetdvāradeśe tu saṃprāpte dadyādarghyaṃ krameṇa tuliṅgasyottarato devīṃ kriyākhyāṃ pīṭhavigrahāmmūrtimūrtīśvaranyāsaṃ tatvatatveśvarānvitamātmavidyāśivākhyaṃ tu tatvatrayamitīritamvyomāntā mūrtayaścāṣṭau nyastavyāḥ pratikhaṇḍakamīśānaśca mahādevo bhīmaścetyaṣṭamūrtipāḥkhañceti mūrtayo liṅge brahmādyā mūrtipā matāḥśivaśaktimanīṣāntaṃ trikhaṇḍakalpanaṃ punaḥśabdacittamanīṣāntaṃ liṅge pīṭhe'śmani kramātdhārikā dīptimutyugrā jyotsnā cetā balotkaṭāpañcamūrtyātmake nyāse vāmādyā mūrtipā matāḥsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyairdevānadhvapatīn kramātśivāṅgāni ca sampūjya gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramātvedyūrdhve paritaḥ kumbhānnyasedviśveśvarātmakānkumbhān vastraiḥ samāveṣṭya hemapadmasamanvitān
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nivedya bhūrinaivedyaṃ tāmbūlāccaṃ ca mantravatmūrtipāḥ śivaśāstrajñāḥ pañcagocarasambhavāḥpratiṣṭhāmantratantrajñāḥ putrapautrādayo guroḥcaturvedadri?do viprāścaturdikṣu vyavasthitāḥbhavanti mūrtipā nāma saṃskṛtāḥ śivaśambaraiḥyāgāntarāyavidhvaṃsaṃ kurvantyamitatejasaḥpradhānāgneḥ samānīya svānaṃśān svāyate nyasetpālāśodumbarāśvatthavaṭāḥ pūrvādidikṣu capradhānasya palāśastu sarvaṃ pālāśameva vāsahasraṃ vā tadarddhaṃ vā tadarddhārdhamathāpi vāmūlāddaśāṃśato'ṅgānāṃ samaṃ vātha tadardhakamāgneyaiśānanairṛyavāyudikṣu yathākramamsantarpya mantrān kumbhānte sādhayeyuratho parampratibhāgamadhastena prokṣaṇaṃ vai hi sattamāḥdarbhasparśastato bhāgaṃ śuddhaṃ saṃjāyateśvarammūlāṇusaṃhitāmantrairācāryasya japādikammūrtimūrtīśahomaṃ ca tatvatatveśvaraiḥ sahasvamūrtirūpasāmarthyādvyāptisandhānayoginaḥevaṃ saṃśodhya brahmāṃśaṃ viṣṇvaṃśādiviśuddhayekuśamūlāntarāgraistu brahmabhāgādikān kramātevaṃ pīṭhe śilāyāṃ ca homādyaṃ parikalpayetmanonmanīmanantaṃ ca krameṇa parikalpayetprāyaścittamaghoreṇa kṛtvā cāṣṭottaraṃ śatambahirantarbaliṃ kṣiptvā kṣetrapālabaliṃ kṣipettataḥ prabhāte vimale deśiko mūrtipaiḥ saha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃgṛhya muṣṭimātraṃ tu dakṣahastena bhasmanaḥvidhāya śodhayenmūlabrahmāṅgamanubhistathāastreṇa dakṣahastena malasnānantu mastakātīśānena kamuddhūlya mukhaṃ tatpuruṣeṇa tusadyojātena sarvāṅgaṃ ṣaḍaṅgairhṛdayādikamnaca gurvagnidevānāṃ sannidhau mārga eva cakvacit śastaṃ hi devasya sannidhāvagnisannidhauuddhūlanepyaśaktaścet tripuṇḍraṃ vāpi kārayetnṛpaviṭśūdrajātīnāṃ paṭṭapuṇḍraṃ lalāṭakemūrdhā lalāṭakarṇau ca cakṣuṣī ghrāṇakau tathāmaṇibandhau ca hṛnnābhimeḍhraṃ pāyustathaiva capriyañcaivāṣṭamūrtīnāṃ vidyeśānāṃ tathaiva calalāṭaṃ karṇau cāṃsau ca bāhū ca maṇikūrparaupṛṣṭhaṃ ka iti vijñeyāḥ sandhayaḥ ṣoḍaśa kramātaśvinyostu priyaṃ jñeyaṃ mūrddhādiparikalpanamnābhiḥ pṛṣṭha iti jñeyāstvaṣṭau vai sandhayaḥ kramātlalāṭabāhuhṛnnābhi pañca sandhiṣu vā bhavetmadhyatarjanyanāmābhistripuṇḍraṃ vidhivannayetnṛpāṇāṃ caturaṅgulyaṃ vaiśyānāṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ bhavetstrīṇāṃ tathaiva kurvīta anyajātistu varjayetatha dīpasamākāramarddhacandraṃ lalāmakampeṣitaṃ candanenaiva vāriṇā saṃyutaṃ tu vāprātarmadhyāhnasāyāhnamadhyarātreṣu sarvadābhasmasnānaṃ yathāyogyaṃ yaḥ kuryātsakṛdeva vātāmrābjanālikerāśmavaiṇavālābucarmamiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃpūjya dvārapālādīn samutthāpya maheśvaramdatvā pūrṇāhutiṃ paścātpraviśedbhavanaṃ prabhoḥekaviṃśatibhāge tu dvāratāre tu madhyamebrahmavāmaikabhāgārdhaṃ śivasūtramiti smṛtamśivasūtrapramāṇaṃ tu saumyasūtrasya pūrvataḥpraṇavaṃ praṇatiṃ coktvā vyāpinīti sthireti casvāhetyantaṃ padaṃ coktvā sthairyaṃ sarvagataṃ smarannyasedratnauṣadhī lohadhātubījāni pūrvavatvilikhya cāyasenātha śvabhraṃ kṛtvā paṭāvṛtamsamācamya kṛtanyāso juhuyādasinā śatamdvārapradeśe datvārghyaṃ spṛṣṭvā cāthordhvaśākhakamsthiraṃ bhavedyathotpādyaṃ śvabhramastreṇa śodhayetsamūrtibhṛdguruśvabhre tataḥ tadavatārayetlayāntaṃ mantramuccārya sṛṣṭimārgeṇa vinyasetdharmādimantraiḥ saṃyojya devīmutsedhayetkriyāmkriyāśaktipadaṃ paścāccaturthyantaṃ manonmanīlākṣāgulamadhūcchiṣṭaguggulūnāṃ samāṃśataḥiṣṭakācūrṇabhāge vā pūrvabhāgasamanvitesikatābhiḥ samāpūrya cāntaraṃ liṅgapīṭhayoḥśarkarā sarjarāṃśaṃ tu samaṃ kṛtvā tu cūrṇayetvajabandhamiti ślāghyaṃ vivare taṃ prayojayetsadmaṃ ca sphaṭikaṃ caiva śarkarā guruvindakamevaṃ pīṭhe samāyojya tatra nyāsaṃ samārabhetśāntikumbhasthatoyaiśca deveśamabhiṣecayetīśvarāntāni tatvāni turyaśre vinyasedguruḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: triṣaṣṭipadavinyāsaṃ brāhme nava nava dvayoḥvṛttabhāge sadākāramevaṃ varṇaprakalpanāsūkṣmādīnyatha madhye tu vinyasedaṣṭasaṃkhyayāśaktayādipuruṣāntāśca hṛdādikavacānimānlokeśāstragaṇeśānān brāhme vidyeśvarān harauśāntyantaṃ brahmaṇo bhāge śāntyatītaṃ tu madhyameāsanāṇūnnyasetpīṭhe liṅgamūrtigatānnyasetmantrānetāṃstu pūrvedyuradhivāse tu vinyasetkumbhān sarvān samānīya vedikopari saṃsthitānsthaṇḍile tvagrakḷpte tu pūrvavadviniveśayetgurūpadiṣṭakandādermantramuccārayecchainaḥkāraṇatyāgayogena brahmarandhrādvinirgatamsphuradratnavitānena pradīpitadigambaramsṛṣṭimārgapravṛtyantamindusantatisannibhamsuṣumnānirgataṃ dhyātvā sphurattārakasarpiṇamevaṃ sarvatra sānnidhyaṃ jīvanyāsena kārayetjalena kumbhavardhanyoḥ snāpayelliṅgapiṇḍiketattatkumbhasthatoyena snāpayetparameśvaramtāvadatra tvayā deva sthātavyamiha sannidhaupratiṣṭhādivase brahmaśilāsaṃsthāpanaṃ tu vāliṅgasthānaṃ ca kalpoktaṃ sarvaṃ vāpi samācaretvidhānametatsāmānyaṃ bāṇādau tu śilāmayeyajamānena saṃkḷptāṃ gṛhṇīyāddakṣiṇāṃ guruḥṣaṣṭiniṣkaṃ samārabhya pañcaniṣkāḥ krameṇa tugobhūhiraṇyasadveśmavāhanācchādanādikam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lambasthānoktamārgeṇa cānyeṣāṃ dakṣiṇā bhavetyajamānāya sandadyātsodakaṃ puṣpasaṃyutamtejobimbanibhaṃ dhyātvā karturdakṣakare guruḥdinadvayamathaikaṃ vā juhuyānmūrtipaiḥ sahaśataṃ sahasramardhaṃ vā tathā syācchaktimantrataḥsaṃsnāpya devaṃ devīṃ ca snapanoktakrameṇa tusamidājyānnasaṃyuktaṃ pūrvavaddhomamācaretasyā vikṛtirūpā tu praiṣṭhānyā samīritābhuktvā tu vipulān bhogān dehānte mokṣamāpnuyātliṅgatāroccanāhairvā taiśca dvitriguṇaistu vāprāsādagarbhadvārābhyāṃ pādādhiṣṭhānamānataḥaṅgulatritayaṃ hastaṃ yavamānaṃ vihāya catanmadhye ca vikārāṃśe tribhāgādekavṛddhitaḥpūjāṃśo liṅgaśabdena kathito dvijasattamāḥpañcaviṃśatisaṃyuktaśatamātrāntamīritamsahasrayavaparyantaṃ yavamānaṃ prakīrtitamaṣṭaṣaṣṭyarkapaṅtyūrdhve vedadviyugaṣaḍvidhamvasubhirguṇite tasmin saptaviṃśatibhirhṛtetriṣvaṅgulapramāṇeṣu jātyaṃśakaṃ na ropayetutsedhaṃ paṅktipaṅtyādi bhajetpañcaṣaḍaṃśakamāyāṃśaścaiva neṣṭaḥ styāttrividheṣvaṅguleṣu cavasubhirguṇiteṣvarkahṛte vāyaṃ vinirdiśetnavabhirguṇite saptahṛte vāraṃ tu nirdiśetguṇaghne vasubhinne tu yonirityabhidhīyatedvayorṛkṣaphalaṃ proktaṃ rāśiraṃśaśca ṛkṣataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jātyaṃśayojite vaibhiryuktaṃ cet tatpragṛhyatāmgṛhītapratimottuṅgamānamātreṇa vā bhavetdhātujaṃ dantajaṃ beramevaṃ saptavidhaṃ bhavetpratimāṃ kārayedvidvāñcchilpinā hṛdayaṃ japetācāryaṃ pūjayetpaścādvastrahemāṅgulīyakaiḥsadāśivādyaṃ beraṃ tu daśatālottamena tuumomāskandasahitaḥ sthitaḥ syādinduśekharaḥtataḥ syāddakṣiṇāmūrtirgeyamūrtirataḥ paramsukhāsanaḥ tataḥ proktaḥ tataḥ kalyāṇasundaraḥvṛṣārūḍhaḥ tataḥ proktaḥ gaṃgāyugaparastathānandīśvaraprasādaśca ūrdhvapādasamanvitaḥmanonmanīṃ ca gaurī ca vighneśaskandanandinaḥbrahmāṇaṃ ca hariṃ lakṣmīṃ moṭīṃ vāgīśvarīmapijyeṣṭhāsavitṛ-ṛkṣendrānaśvinīṃ ca mahīṃ ṛṣīnlokapālān vasūnaṣṭau mūrtīrmadhyena kārayetvidyādharān kaniṣṭhena navatālena kārayetasurāṃśca pitṝṃścaiva tathaiva hi samācaretkubjakān rasatālena śaratālottamena tubhūtāntarāṇi kāryāṇi catuḥ tālena sālakānkabandhānekatālena dvibhāgenaivamācaretmānaṃ proktopacārādyaṃ lambādyaṃ kevalaṃ tu tatbhinnāni tāni mānāni teṣāṃ lakṣaṇamucyatekalākolakabhāgākhyaṃ syāddvitricaturaṅgulamnāhahīne vināśaḥ syādadhike ca kṣayāya calambamānavihīne tu rājarāṣṭrasya nāśakṛt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktametatsarvapradāyakamsārdhatrayodaśaṃ mātraṃ mukhamātraṃ vidhīyateakṣisūtrātpuṭāntaṃ ca tatsamaṃ parikīrtitamgalamardhāṅgulaṃ jñeyaṃ karṇo bhāgasamucchrayaḥhṛdayānnābhiparyantaṃ tatsamaṃ ceti kīrtitammeḍhramūlāttu jānvantaṃ saptaviṃśatimātrakamtālotsedhastu bhāgaḥ syātkāyamānamiti smṛtamuṣṇīṣātkeśaparyantaṃ caturmātramiti smṛtamgrīvā vedāṅgulāḥ proktā grīvāyāstu stanāntaramnāmestu meḍhraparyantaṃ viśvāmitramiti smṛtambhāgena jānumānaṃ syājjaṅghe ūrusame mateuṣṇīṣamaṅgulaṃ proktaṃ keśāntaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ bhavetgalamardhāṅgulaṃ jñeyaṃ bhāgaḥ kaṇṭhe samucchrayaḥstanāntānnābhiparyantaṃ tatsamaṃ ceti kīrtitampañcaviṃśatimātrastu tasmātpūrvāgrakāvadhibhāgena taladairghyaṃ syānmānamevaṃ prakīrtitamjyeṣṭhasya navatālasya tālaṃ dvādaśamātrakamvedabhāgāṣṭatālaiśca kuryāllakṣaṇamucyateaṣṭāviṃśatibhāgaṃ tu beramānaṃ vibhājayetuṣṇīṣakarṇajānvaṅghrigṛhītavadanāyatamsarveṣāmapi devānāṃ sanātanamiti smṛtamsyāttrayāṅgulamuṣṇīṣaṃ keśāntaṃ trayaṅgulaṃ tathāardhena tricaturbhāgaṃ hanubhūtaṃ prakīrtitamhṛnnābhimeḍhraparyantaṃ dvādaśāṃgulamucyatejaṅghe dviguṇitāyāme tāloccaṃ bhāgato bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: purogamaḥ syādaṣṭāṃśaḥ aṣṭāṃśa kandharo bhavetdhanvākāre tu tanmadhye bhrūmadhyāddvyaṃśakaṃ matammadhyāṃśamapi cūlyekā bhāga ardhāṃśato bhavetcaturbhāgānvitāvekāṃśādhikau kuṇḍalānvitautāvapi śrotrāvantaṃ ca nimnagaṃ bahirunnatamdvibhāgāyatamekāṃśaṃ vyāsamadhyaṃ tu locanamtanmadhye tasya pañcāṃśaṃ jyotirdṛṣṭiḥ tadardhataḥmānādhike'ṣṭabhāgārdhavyāsāyāme kanīnikeurdhvāntaḥ pakṣmavistāraḥ pādāṅguṣṭhārdha eva hisulocanamanidraṃ syātkarmaṇe sarvadehināmrūkṣekṣaṇe vidhātavye aṣṭāṃśārdhādhike matenetrayorantaraṃ dvyaṃśaṃ kiñcinnyūnaṃ tu vā bhavetpādena prāntasaṃyuktā vidheyā syāddvijottamāḥtāvaduccastadākāraḥ tilapuṣpasamo bhavetpuṭavatpādabhāgārdhamadhikonnatisaṃyutāṛjutiryaktripādonamiṣṭāṃśena viśālayuknāsāntāṃśaṃ natāgraṃ syātpuṭe tu vipule tathācaturaṃśāyatatayā nīvramaṃśaṃ samālikamadharoṣṭhāya taddvyaṃśamāyāmāttu viśālakamhanucakraṃ dvibhāgaṃ syāddhanvagraṃ kiñcidunnatamaṣṭāṃśaṃ karṇavistāraṃ pañcapañcāṃśanāsiyukpṛṣṭhakeśāvadhirmūrdhno mukhaṃ syāccaturaṅgulamaṣṭāṃśavistaraḥ pṛṣṭhe karṇavṛtyantare śiraḥkeśāntaṃ nāhaṣaṭpañcabhāgo'ṣṭāṃśena nāhakamskandho galasamoccaḥ syānmūlaṃ yor?mūlasaṃkṣayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: viṃśatyaṃśatribhāgonā stanapārśvāvadheḥ sthitiḥśroṇī kaṭī tathā tasmādekaikaṃ caturaṃśakamsampūrṇagomukhākāraṃ pādāgrāntaṃ mukhe mukhehikkāḥ tanāgrakastasthonāntālpaḥ sa(ma)khaṇḍanaḥtiryakkarṇadharaḥ pṛṣṭhe dvādaśadviguṇāṃśakaḥviṃśātiḥ kaṭisaṃdhau syātkakuddoṣostriraṣṭa caśroṇiḥ kaṭiśca madhyaṃ ca mukhe tiryaṅmukhe'pi caānatiścaturaṃśā tu liṅgaṃ vṛttamṛju sthiramuttuṅgamūrumūlaṃ tu mūlamadhyāgravistaraḥcatuḥ ṣaṭtāradairghyaṃ tu jānu syāddairghyavartulampārṣṇirmadhyagratalagā catuṣpañcaṣaḍaṃśakaiḥcaturaṃśākṣagulphe ca dvyaṃśasārdhāṃśamaṇḍalepārṣṇipṛṣṭhe suvṛttāntaṃ pārṣṇyaṃṅguṣṭhāgramāyatampārṣṇisīmātkaniṣṭhāntaṃ caturaṃśena vistaraḥcaturaṃśāyato'ṅguṣṭhastattāre ceddvibhāgakedvitīyasya tṛtīyaṃ syād dvayavedonanāhayuktryaṃśāyāmāṣṭabhāgena bhāgoccavipulānvitāetāsāmaṅgulānāṃ tu nakhaḥ svāgratripādabhākaṣṭabhāgādhikāyāmastvaṅguṣṭhastu dvitīyakaḥprakoṣṭhamaṇibandhāntatalāyāmaḥ ṣaḍaṃśata.ḥbhāgaḥ syātkūrparaḥ tasmānmaṇibandhāvasānakamcatustriṃśāyatavyāsaḥ tvantaṃ nimnaṃ samīritampañcāṃśaḥ talavistāraḥ talamānimnamadhyagamsapādāṃśaścaturbhāgaḥ tvaṅguṣṭhavipulāyatiḥtarjanyaṣṭāṃśahīnāṃśavyāsāṣṭāṃśāgrahīnakāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ṣaḍaṃśaikāṃśakāyāmavyāsā madhyāṅgulī matātaddaśāṃśonavistārā parvatrayasamanvitātritripādadvibhāgaistu caturbhāgavibhāgikāagraparvāṅgulīnāṃ tu dviguṇaṃ syānnakhāyatamabhyantaragatāṅgulyā bhāgādhikyāyatā matāśaṅkhacakragadāśūlapadmavajrasamanvitamālambitabhujacchāyamūrupāṇitalāntaramuṣṇīṣatapanīgojīgrīvorunābhimadhyagamyaduṣṇīṣakakrudvaṃśakhaṇḍasphikpārṣṇimadhyagammūrdhnaḥ śravaṇapālyantaṃ gulpagrīvāṃsamadhyagampārśvājasūtrādadhikā catuṣpañcāṃśakā kakuddaśabhāgaṃ kaṭīsūtraṃ mukhe pṛṣṭhaṣaḍaṅgakamjānutricaturaṃśaṃ tu pārśvasūtraṃ mukhe mukhesūtrātpañcāṃśakātparṣṇirevaṃ pārśvaṃ prakīrtitammukhaṃ syānnalakābāhyādantaraṃ caturaṃśakambhittyāśliṣṭaṃ hyardhacitraṃ dṛṣṭacitramiti smṛtamstrīmānamadhunā vakṣye ṣaṇṇavatyaṅgulaṃ tu tattrimātrāṣṭayavaṃ vyāsotsedhamuṣṇīṣamānakamgrīvā trimātrā syādvakṣaḥ sārdhaṣaṭpañcamātrakamsyādūrujānujaṅghāṅghritalānuccairanukramātmūrdhno navadaśāṅgulyaṃ keśasīmā mukhe mukhelalāṭaṃ śaramātraṃ tu madhye khyātaṃ purogatambhrūmadhyaṃ yavatāroccaṃ dairghyaṃ syāt tattrimātrakamaṅgulena samaṃ snigdhaślakṣṇaromadhanuḥ samamnetre pañcayavavyāsaṃ tanmadhye kṛṣṇamaṇḍalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kanīnike dvayāntasthe yavatārānvitāyateūrdhvādhaḥpakṣmavistāro dviyavārdhayavonnataḥkarṇabandhāttu karṇāgraṃ tataḥ saptayavaṃ smṛtamkuṇḍalena yutau tau hi bhavetāṃ kolakādhikauardhamātrādhikāvaṣṭamātrau vā śravaṇau smṛtauśrotre kalāntaraṃ nimnaṃ natavṛttāṅgavadbahiḥśrotrapṛṣṭhaṃ tathā śrotrasamamūrdhve daśārdhakamtasmātsaptayavo'pāṅgaḥ tasmāttryardhāṅgulaṃ mukhamnetrayorantaraṃ netratāraṃ nāsāpuṭāvadhināsāmūlonnatirnnetramadhye syādardhamātrikāmūlamadhyāgraṃ nāsyāstu vistāre kīrtitaṃ kramātmātrā śrotrāṅgapañcārdhāṅgulāyāmā tu mastakepuṭau niṣpāvavatproktau nātyunnatisamanvitaugojīmūlātpuṭāntaṃ tu tadvyāsasya samucchrayaḥnetraṃ vā dinapadmotthamāraktaṃ śvetamaṇḍalamānimnārdhatrimātre tu ūrdhvoṣṭavipulāyateunnatāyatavistāre ṣaḍyavā ṣaḍyavādhikātuṇḍīrakhaṇḍasaṃkāśaṃ kiṃśukaprasavacchavigrīvā pañcāṅgulavyāsā vyāsatriguṇanāsikāhanucakradvimātrārdhamāsyarūpaṃ tu pūrvavattebhyo'rdhonāyatavyāsā adhodantāstu dantataḥsusnigdhāñjanarocīṃṣi pakṣmaromāṇi yojayetkeśāstu ṛjavaḥ śuddhāḥ sūkṣmāḥ snidhyāḥ samāsitāḥyoṣitāṃ vadanaṃ kuryātsuprakāraṃ manoharampakṣaḥ kakṣāntaraṃ tasya tāraḥsaptadaśāṅgulam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadantaraṃ dvibhāgaṃ syātkukṣerapyatha vakṣasimūle saptāṅgulavyāsāvaśvatthadalasaṃmukhaucaturdaśāṅgulāntaṃ tu stanāntaṃ hṛdayāvadhihikkādho bāhudairghyaṃ tu dvāviṃśatyaṅgulaṃ bhavetmaṇibandhasya vistāraṃ triyavenādhikā kalāpañcāṅgulaḥ talavyāsaḥ talāyāmo dvikolakaḥmūlāṅguliviśālasya talāgrabahulaṃ samamṣaṭpañcayavamūlāgrā caturardhāṅgulāyatātricaturyavavistāraśyāmaraktanakhānvitāekonaviṃśattriḥpañcayavamūlāgranāhikāanāmikā pradeśinyā samānā mānalakṣaṇātagre caturyavādhyardhatriyavārdhanakhānvitāmūlādyagrāḥ suvṛttāḥ syuraṅgulyaḥ susamāhitāḥbahiḥtalasya mūlaṃ tu maṇibandhāttato'dhikamgomukhākāravaddhasto yuvatīnāṃ vidhīyatetryardhadvyardhakalā tasya mūlamadhyāgravistaraḥadharoṣṭhāvadhergrīvā trimātrā syāttathā kakutpṛṣṭhe kakṣāvadhe rekhā daśakolakasaṃmitākaṭyāstu tuṇḍataḥ tālaṃ pṛṣṭaṃ ṣaḍyavakolakampṛṣṭhe nābhiguhāsāmye śroṇiḥ saptadaśāṅgulāsphiktārāṅgāvadhestulyalekhā lekhyā mukhe mukhevalitrayayutaṃ kāryaṃ śātodarasamaṃ śubhampradakṣiṇakramāvartā nābhiḥ kāryā munīśvarāḥīṣannimnatalaṃ kāryaṃ nitambāntaṃ trikolakamaśvatthadalavadbāhyākṛtirgrāhyā manoharā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svapramāṇajalairyuktaṃ prasthayugmāpi saṃgrahetvastraṃ vātisitaṃ pītaṃ kaṣāyaṃ copavītakamtriguṇaṃ kaṭisūtraṃ syāt dviśca granthiniyantritamsūtramekantu śūdrāṇāṃ dvisaraṃ bhavetyadvā pañcasaraṃ teṣāṃ navasūtramathāpi vākṣatraviṭchūdrajātīnāṃ yaduktaṃ copavītakamanulomādivarṇānāṃ yuktāyuktaṃ vicārya cacaturaṅgulamānena triguṇīkṛtasūtrakamvartayetprāṅmukho bhūtvā toyasiktaṃ samaṃ śubhamvāmetarakarādūrdhvaṃ bhūgatau parivarjayettadbhramānmunitṛptiḥ syāttṛṇaṃ datvā'tha śodhanamāyuṣkāmī tvanekañca dvandvasūtrañca dhārayetpaścādādāya sūtraṃ tad dviguṇaṃ kaṇṭhasaṃgatamgranthau triveṣṭanaṃ kṛtvā sūtramevaṃ vidhīyatetanmānamupavītasya samameva vidhīyatesvasvajātyuktamantreṇa dhāryaṃ tadupavītakamsnānāntaraṃ tayoreva naimittikamudāhṛtamsmaratā mūrdhajaṃ mantraṃ gacchatā padasaptakampuruṣeṇaiva mantreṇa snānānāmuttamottamammāntraṃ tadvāruṇasnānavidhāvapi vidhīyatesarvasnāneṣu kartavyaṃ kevalaṃ vā vidhīyatebhāvaśuddhyā viśuddho yaḥ sa śuddho netaraḥ sadākukkuṭapretabhūsaṅgaśāvasūtakapātakaiḥanyaiśca ninditaiḥ spṛṣṭo yadi snānaṃ samācaretprakṣālanādadhaḥ snānādviśuddhiḥ syātkarādṛte
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: snigdhaiṣā dvandvaṣaḍgūḍhamaṇiromavivarjitamyonyantātkaṭikāpārśve rekhe dve vidhivanmatetālaṃ viśālaṃ mūlorormadhyoroḥ pañcakolakamtatpañcāṅgulavistāraṃ jaṅghābhāgaḥ saṣaḍyavaḥhastihastanibhāvūrū viromaṃ jānumaṇḍalamsyādaṅguṣṭhakaniṣṭhāgrapārṣṇiraṅghritalāyatāvyāsena ṣaḍyavāyāmā pādāṅguṣṭhādyavādhikāyavārdhena viśālaḥ syadaṅguṣṭhe ṣaḍyavo nakhaḥsāmānyalakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ pratimānāṃ dvijottamāḥvṛddhyā hānyā prayoktavyaṃ sarveṣvaṅgeṣu vā dvijāḥtryaṅgulāntaṃ śiraścakraṃ suvṛttaṃ makarānvitamārabhyāṅgulahānyaikatalāntaṃ parikalpayettriṃśadaṅgulaparyantaṃ dhanurbāṇādiyuktitaḥcandanaśca madhūkaśca khadiraḥ saralaḥ tathākramukaḥ saptaparṇaśca vakulaḥ kundacandanauśrīparṇī khadiraḥ sālatintṛṇīsālabilvakaupanaso devādāruśca padmatindukasaṃjñakauvakulaḥ kuṭajāhvaśca piṇḍitastiniśaḥ punaḥyasya devasya yā devī tasyāḥ tadvṛkṣa eva hijyeṣṭhāyāḥ pāṭalī proktā śivākhyaḥ saptamātṛṣukhādiraḥ sarvadevānāṃ kṣīriṇī khādiraḥ tathāgaṇapaskandaśāstṝṇāṃ mātṝṇāṃ śivapādapāḥtāmrārakūṭaraupyairvā śātakumbhena vā matāḥdravyasaṃgrahaṇaṃ kuryāttadvidhanaprakārataḥbrahmadaṇḍasya vistāraḥ pañcāṅgulamiti smṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nābherhikkāntakaṃ caiva vasvaśraḥ paribhāṣitaḥsaptāṅgula iti jñeyā taddhanetu kalā bhavetvyomamātrapramāṇena śikhāvistāra iṣyaterandhraṃ viṣṇvaṃśatāreṇa vakṣodaṇḍasya madhyamekaṭidaṇḍasya vistāraḥ saptāṅgula udāhṛtaḥagnyaṅgulapramāṇena śikhā tiryaṅmukhā bhavetcaturaśrasya tāreṇa mānārdhaṃ dvyaṅgulaṃ nyasetyojayedbrahmadaṇḍe tu susnigdhaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ nayettasya mūle tu suṣiraṃ śikhāmānena kārayetkaṭidaṇḍe śikhāyāṃ ca ūrudaṇḍaṃ ca yojayetjaṅghāmūlasya vistārastryaṅgulaḥ samudāhṛtaḥtasya mūle tu suṣiraṃ śikhāmānena kārayetyojayettūrudaṇḍaṃ tu jānumaṇḍalakaṃ budhaḥāyāmastatsamo jñeyo jaṅghā tatra tadardhataḥbāhumūlasya vistāro guṇāṅgulamudāhṛtamsaptamātrapramāṇena tanmūle suṣiraṃ nayetprakoṣṭhamūlavistārastrimātraḥ samudāhṛtaḥtanmūlena dvimātreṇa suṣiraṃ kārayettataḥvakṣodaṇḍātsamārabhya kaṭidaṇḍāntarakramāttadghanaṃ tatsamaṃ jñeyaṃ pārśvadaṇḍasya coparivakṣodaṇḍakaṭīdaṇḍe yojayetpārśvadaṇḍakamstrīṇāṃ caiva viśeṣeṇa varjayetpārśvadaṇḍakepādāṅgulaṃ samārabhya pādāṅgulavivardhanātbrahmadaṇḍe'ntyadaṇḍeṣu dvātriṃśadgṛhyatāṃ dvijāḥsvamānādardhamātraṃ tu hīnaṃ yuktyaiva kārayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: brahmadaṇḍasya mūle tu yojayettu yugāṅgulamśūlalakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ tatsthāpanamihocyatemaṇḍapaḥ kuṇḍakḷptistu navapañcaikasaṃkhyayāśilpinaṃ ca visṛjyātha puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥsaṅklpya śayanaṃ tatra jñātvā brahmādidaṇḍakānsaṃsnāpya śuddhatoyena vastreṇācchādya pūjayetmūrtibhūtaṃ tu tacchūlaṃ hṛdayena niveśayetsakūrcān hemasaṃyuktān savastrānudapūritāntattvatattveśvaropetān mūrtimūrtīśvarānnyasetgandhapuṣpādinābhyarcya mūrtimantramanusmarankṛtvā kuṇḍādisaṃskāraṃ mūrtimāvāhya tarpayetpālāśodumbarāśvatthavaṭāḥpūrvādidikṣu capradhānasya palāśaḥ syācchatasaṃkhyā pradhānaketattvatattveśvarādyaiśca pratyekaṃ tritayaṃ kramātsnātvā devaṃ ghaṭaṃ mantrī saṃpūjyāgniṃ samīpataḥsaṃgṛhya mūladhāmnastu pradakṣiṇamanuvrajansthānakādivibhāgena kṛtvā sthānaṃ ghaṭīkṛtamtathaiva nṛttasaktā ca gamanabhiratā hi caśayyāsaktā tu suptā syātsā ca prāyo'sya neṣyateśūlamūlaviśālenādhyardhamādhāramānakamcaturaṅgulamānaṃ syātsamaṃ syāccaturaśrakamcaturmātrāntamānaṃ syātkriyāmānānusārataḥpādāni nava tanmadhye kṛtvā kūṭayutāni vātatra saṃsthāpayedvāgmī tatra mūrtimanusmaranathavā pīṭhikotsedhaṃ brahmadaṇḍasya mūlataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kṛtvā tadavadhisthāne sthāpyaṃ vādhārasaṃjñakammūrtinirgataśūlaiśca susthiraiḥ sāradārujaiḥbrahmadaṇḍādidaṇḍe tu yojayitvā guruttamaḥṛjubhirlohapaṭṭaiśca lohakīlairanekadhākalkacikkaṇakādyaistu saṃpūrṇāṅgaṃ yathā nasatnayanonmīlanātpūrvaṃ dravyamātraṃ tu tadbhavettatra pratiṣṭhā kartavyā sthāpanoktavidhānataḥjaṅghorū pratimādaṇḍānsthāpayitvā tadūrdhvataḥsarvadaṇḍādisaṃyuktaṃ kṛtvā ca pratimādikamtattvamūrtyādivinyāsaṃ kṛtvā tāṃ sthāpayettu vāanyatsarvaṃ samānaṃ syātkintu pādaśilādayaḥsuṣire pīṭhamadhye tu yathāsnigdhaṃ niyojayetmūrtimantrānnyasetkumbhatoyagān pratimāhṛditacchailaṃ sudhayālepya vastreṇāveṣṭya citrayetgrāme vā nagare vāpi pattane rājadhānikesamudratīre setau ca puṣkariṇyāstaṭeṣu caudyāne puṇyadeśe vā niṣkalaṃ sakalaṃ tu vāsaudhajaṃ vārdhacitraṃ vā ābhāsaṃ vātha pīṭhakamārabhya pañcapañcāṃśamekaikapadavardhanātekaṃ vāpi dvayaṃ vāpi trayaṃ vā brahmamandirepadaṃ paiśācikaṃ proktaṃ brahmabhāge prakalpayetniṣkalaṃ brahmabhāge tu sakalaṃ daivikāṃśakesthāpayenmānuṣaṃ vāpi mātuḥ kecididaṃ bhavetrakṣogandharvayakṣādyāḥ piśācādyāśca mūrtipāḥīśānādicatuṣkoṇe sabhādyaṃ tatra kalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāpīṃ cāgneyadeśe tu govāsaṃ kūpasaṃyutamvāyau devālayaṃ kuryādvyatyāse vyasanaṃ bhavetdvijavāsastu tatsarvaṃ śarve vātha vidhīyatepañcapaṃcāṃśato nyūnāttadūrdhvaṃ dvijasattamāḥsūryaḥ kandagaṇeśānāṃ durgādyā vāstudevatāḥmoṭīśāstṛvihīnā vā saptadevāstathā matāḥkalpanā nyūnavipre tu tyajetkoṣṭhamathāṅkaṇambrahmāvaiśravaṇaḥ saumyaḥ kandarpo'ntarvyavasthitāḥtadūrdhvaṃ sarvadevāśca śaṃsitāḥ phaladāyakāḥskandaḥ tatra vidheyo vā *? brahmabhāgādibhāgakevāstuvinyāsatuṣṭāstu prāgatra sthāpitāḥ surāḥvinā pratiṣṭhāṃ devānāṃ vāstunyāsaṃ kathaṃ bhavetvinyasedrudradevāṃśca śaivaṃ sampādayedguruḥpurātanāttvarthālocya vāstunyāsasamācarettathāpi punaradyāpi viśeṣastatra kathyategṛhaśreṇiṣu vṛddhirvā hānirbāhyāntare'pi vāiṣyate kṣudramārgo vā kṣudre mahati vāstunivāstupaiśācavaiṣamyamiṣyate vāstunirbhitausthānādīnāṃ yathā pīḍā na syātsarvaṃ nayettasmādukteṣu deśeṣu marmādyaṃ parigṛhya capratipāditaharmyeṣu śivādyān sthāpayettataḥdravyasaṃgrahaṇaṃ pūrvaṃ bimbanirmāṇameva canayanonmīlanaṃ paścādberaśuddhiranantarammaṇḍapālaṅkatiḥ paścādvāstuhomamataḥ paramtataḥ kautukabandhaḥ syācchayanārohaṇaṃ punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dakṣiṇādānamante syānmantranyāsamataḥ paramdvāviṃśatiḥ kriyāḥ proktāstāsāṃ lakṣaṇamucyatedantaśca beranirmāṇe tasya saṃgrahamucyateśilādisthānamāsādya sthaṇḍile pūjiteśvaraḥśilādyaṃ prokṣya vastreṇa varmaṇāveṣṭya pūjayetsaṃpūjya vastrahaimādyairācāryaṃ sthapatiṃ tathāādau siktaṃ dravībhūtamastreṇāstrāvya vāriṇāsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyairhṛdā vastreṇa veṣṭayettasya nirmāṇakāle tu uttarābhimukho guruḥtasyāścottaradigbhāge śāntihomaṃ tu kārayetvṛkṣasaṃgrahaṇe vṛkṣaṃ saṃpūjyaivaṃ vadedguruḥsaṅkrāmaḥ syāditisthānaṃ guṇavadyanmanoramamghṛtāktena kuṭhāreṇa chindyānmṛtyuñjayaṃ smarantāpamṛtyumahārohagulmoccāṭanamagnitaḥpratimālakṣaṇaṃ proktaṃ maṇḍapaṃ tvadhunocyatetrihastaṃ tu samārabhya caikaikakaravṛddhitaḥatrānuktaṃ tu yatkiñcittatsarvaṃ pūrvavannayetcaturaśrāṇi vṛttāni taddigaśrāṇi vā nayetmaṇḍapaṃ samalaṅkṛtvā pīṭhaṃ tatra vinikṣipetekapaṭṭayutaṃ vāpi pūjayeccandanādibhiḥlokapālāṃśca caturaḥ ratnāni vividhāni camuktā vajraṃ tathā puṣparāgaṃ gomedakaṃ tathāpañcaratnamiti proktaṃ māṇikkaṃ caikameva vāsvasvalokapamantraiśca madhyādikramato nyasetśailaṃ cetsthāpane kāle ratnādyaṃ vidhivannyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: anyeṣāṃ ratnavinyāsaṃ varjayettu viśeṣataḥsugupte maṇḍape ramye gomayenānulepitesthaṇḍilaṃ tatra kartavyamaṣṭadroṇādibrīhibhiḥtasya madhye nyasedbimbaṃ prāṅmukhaṃ deśikottamaḥprathamaṃ dakṣiṇaṃ netraṃ dvitīyaṃ vāmanetrakampakṣmarekhāṃ purā kṛtvā tato vai dṛṣṭimaṇḍalamtathaivonmīlanaṃ śilpī vajrakāñcanasūcitaḥnāsikākarṇavaktrāṇi liṅgaṃ pāyuṃ ca mocayetcitrābhāsādidevānāṃ tattadvarṇaiḥ samācaretudvāsya śilpinaṃ paścāttasyāgre sthaṇḍilaṃ nayetsasūtrān sāpidhānāṃśca kalaśānaṣṭadikṣu casvamantrairabhito nyastvā lokeśāṃstatra pūjayetsvarṇayā dūrvayā netraṃ madhvājyābhyāṃ tu tarpayetlohaje śailaje vārkṣe ratnajepyevamācarettarjanyanāmikāmadhye sūryasomāgnilocanesauvarṇe rājate tāmre kāṃsye vātha śarāvaketadardhenārdhapādena pūritaṃ vā pṛthak pṛṭhakdarśayenmadhupātraṃ tu mṛtyujinmantramuccaranbījamukhyena mantreṇa dhānyarāśiṃ pradarśayetbrāhmaṇān darśayetpaścātpavamānamanusmaranpracchannapaṭamāvarjya janasaṃghān pradarśayettvaksāraiḥ pratimāśuddhiṃ citrādau darpaṇe nayetvastrairgandhaiśca mālabhirbhūṣayedbhūṣaṇārhakaiḥgrāmapradakṣiṇaṃ vāpi citrādau parivarjayetjalamadhye prapāṃ kṛtvā caturgātrasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sthaṇḍilaṃ sthāpayitvā tu gandhādyairarcayedguruḥlokapālādhipāṃstatra hemāḍhyān pūjayedguruḥlambakūrcena saṃyuktaṃ dvātriṃśatsammitena tugaṅgāditīrthamavāhya paritaḥ kalaśān nyasetjalādhivāsanaṃ kuryāccitrādau darpaṇe na vābrāhmaṇān bhojayettatra sahasrāntān daśādhikānparyagnikaraṇaṃ kṛtvā prokṣayettu śivāmbhasāaṣṭadroṇaiḥ tadardhairvā tadardhaiḥ śālibhirmatamśayanaṃ kalpayedūrdhve carmajādyairanukramātprokṣayetpuruṣeṇaiva hṛdā gandhādibhiryajetvyapohya vastrakūrcāccaṃ? snapanaṃ pūrvavannayetśaktīnāṃ caiva sarvāsāṃ vāme vā dakṣiṇe'pi vāsasūtrān sahiraṇyāṃśca sakūrcān vastrasaṃyutānvinyasya paritaḥ sarvān gandhapuṣpādibhiryajetātmavidyāṃ śivākhyaṃ ca jānukarṇaśirovadhipalāśodumbarāśvatthavaṭāḥ pūrvādiṣu kramātpradhānasya palāśaḥ syātsamidhaḥ saṃprakīrtitāḥyavapriyaṅguśālyaśca mudgamāṣakulutthakāḥtripañcasaptanavabhiḥ rudrairviśvaiśca pakṣakaiḥbrahmādidikṣu khyātāni vidikṣu hṛdayādayaḥpañcāgnyātanaṃ cettu hṛdayādīni varjayetsahasramardhaṃ tasyārdhaṃ śataṃ vāṣṭaśataṃ tu vāmūlāddaśāṃśato'ṅgaistu sarvairbrahmādi homayetdravyānte vyāhṛtiṃ kuryāddhomānte pūrṇayā yutamatrānuktaṃ tu yatsarvaṃ liṅgasthāpanavannayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: āgamādhyayanaṃ kuryādīśāne dīkṣitaḥ tviharātriśeṣamapohyātha prabhāte vimale tataḥmantrasannaddhakāyastu praviśyaṃ makhamaṇḍapamvyapohya vastrakūrcādīn yajedgandhādibhirhṛdāaghorāṣṭaśataṃ hutvo prāyaścittārthameva vāpañcaniṣkaṃ samārabhya pañcaniṣkavivardhanātathavā ca daridrastu niṣkādyaṃ pañcaniṣkakānanyeṣāṃ caiva sarveṣāṃ pūrvavaddakṣiṇā bhavetparivāraghaṭairyuktaṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutamkumbhādbījaṃ samādāya pratimāhṛdi vinyasetvardhanyā bījamādāya tatpīṭhe vinyasedguruḥvibhinnapīṭhāṃ devī cetpṛthaksthāpanamārabhetsaudhe kaścidviśeṣo'sti teṣāmevātha sannidhaukarmārcāyāstu pīṭhe vā kūrce vā snāpanaṃ sthalearcanoktaṃ samabhyarcya vastrābharaṇapuṣpakaiḥsnapanaṃ kalpayedvā cedutsavena yutaṃ tu vāsvapradhāne parāṅge ca sthāpanaṃ caivamīritamitaraṃ tadvihīnaṃ syāttacca dvividhamucyatemittyāśliṣṭaṃ citrayuktaṃ śailaṃ vā grāmasaṃsthitamprāsāde maṇḍape sāle gopure balipīṭhakebahiraṅge viśeṣo'sti tacchaṇudhvaṃ śivadvijāḥśayyākḷptaṃ vinā vāpi sarvaṃ pūrvavadācaretdhāmnaḥkḷptiṃ ca nityeṣṭimutsavaṃ snapanaṃ tathājīrṇoddhāraṃ bālagṛhaṃ tatra saṃsthāpanaṃ tathādhiṣṇyāvasāne pūrvokte kāle ca tvaṅkurārpaṇam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navakuṇḍasamāyuktaṃ pañcakuṇḍayutaṃ tu vābrāhmaṇān bhojayettatra taddinātprāgdinatrayemadhvājyadhānyagoviprakanyānāṃ darśanaṃ dvijāḥsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ prāsādaṃ prokṣayettataḥmūrtimūrtīśvarān nyastvā bereṣvapi tathācaretmaṇḍapaṃ saṃpraviśyātha puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥtadardhataṇḍulaiḥ śuddhaiḥ tilairlājaiḥ tadardhakaiḥdiṅmūrtisaṃkhyayā kumbhāṃstadbahiḥ parito nyasetcandanodakasaṃpūrṇān sakūrcān pallavānvitānkṛtvā tathāgnisaṃskāramagnikāryoktamārgataḥpūrvasmin pūrvadigdevamantrairdakṣe tu vinyasetvidikṣu hṛdayādyaiśca juhuyācchatasaṃkhyayāsamidājyacarū lājatilasasyendravaiṇavāḥśamyapāmārgakhadirabilvāḥ koṇeṣu saṃsthitāḥtattvatattveśvarādyaiśca hutvā pūrṇāṃ samācaretnavavastrasraguṣṇīṣaḥ sottarīyaḥ samālakaḥnavavastrādisaṃyuktamūrtipaiśca samanvitaḥprāyaścitaṃ ca pūrṇāṃ ca hutvā mūrtidharaiḥ sahaprāsādadakṣiṇe deśe sthaṇḍile vinyased.ghatānmūrtividyātanuṃ dehe aṣṭatriṃśatkalānvitamnyasetprāsādadehe tu vastvādhāre manonmanīmarcayedatha gandhādyairnaivedyāntaṃ pṛthakpṛthakuktānāmapi sarveṣāṃ dhāmnāmagre'gramaṇḍapammaṇḍapaṃ samamānaṃ cetsāntarālaṃ saveśakamsārdhahastaṃ dvihastaṃ vā prāsādārdhamathāpi vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: duḥsvapne durjanasparśe snānaṃ ṣaṭsu vidhīyatekukkaṭāsanasaṃsthastu jānumadhyagapāṇiyukhastaṃ gokarṇavatkṛtvā māṣamagnajalaṃ pibetbrahmatīrthena mūlena triḥ pītvā dviḥ pramārjayetcakṣurnāsāśrutī bāhū vakṣo nābhiṃ śiraḥ spṛśetsvadhāntaiḥ salilaṃ pītvā hetinoṣṭhau pramārjayetathavānyaprakāreṇa kuryādācamanaṃ budhaḥāsyaṃ dviḥ pramṛjedastrātsakṛnmṛjya mukhaṃ śanaiḥsavyāttu cakṣuṣī spṛṣṭvā tarjanyāṅūguṭhakena tuśrotre spṛṣṭvā jalopetāṃguṣṭhena tu bāhukauhṛtpradeśe tu saṃspṛśya sarvāṅgulyā svamūrddhanioṣṭhadvimārjanāttatra tathātharvetihāsayoḥhṛcchirobhyukṣaṇenaiva ṛṣīṇāntu priyaṃ bhavetnāsikāsparśanenaiva aśvinyostu priyaṃ bhavetindraviṣṇvanalānāñca bāhvornābherhṛdastathāsparśayitvā tataḥ śrotramaṃguṣṭhenāsyakaṃ mṛjetkarāgre daivikaṃ tīrthaṃ tanmūle brāhmamuttamamvāmapāṇitale saumyamāgneyandakṣiṇe talebrāhmī brahmaguṇopetāṃ brahmakāle vicintayetsāye raudrīṃ tu saṃdhyāyed rudralakṣaṇalakṣitāmyā śaktiḥ parameśasya sā sandhyeti nigadyatemelāmantrakrameṇaiva śambhuśaktiṃ punarjapetabhyukṣaṇātparaṃ karma kartavyaṃ tadanantarammūlāṅgabrahmabhirmantrairdakṣahastena nityaśaḥāhṛtya pūrakeṇaiva dakṣanāsāpuṭena tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tanmadhyamamiti proktaṃ triguṇaṃ cottamaṃ bhavetsāvakāśāntarālaṃ cettasmāddvitriguṇaṃ bhavettadardhaṃ bhittiyuktaṃ vā tadaṣṭāṃśena bhittikamyāvadvibhāgamānaṃ tu bhaveddvādaśamānakamantarālapradeśoktaṃ veśayuktaṃ prakīrtitamsvāyaṃbhuvādiliṅge tu nyūnaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ tu vāvivṛtastambhasaṃyuktaṃ na ceddvāraṃ tadagrakevivṛtastambhasaṃyuktaṃ cenmūladhāmapraveśagauśuddhanāgaradhāmnaitadgarbhamānārdhaniṣkramaḥantarālaṃ tadagre syātpārśvadeśapramāṇakampārśvadvārasamopetaṃ nirdvāraṃ vātha tadbhavetsnapanārthaṃ tadagre syāttadagre nṛttamaṇḍapammūladhāmasamaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ svāṣṭāṃśonādhikaṃ tu vāmānave mānavaṃ hyetatsāmānyaṃ samudāhṛtameteṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ pramāṇamadhunocyateśahastāvasānastu bhavenmaṇḍapavistaraḥnānājālakasaṃyuktaṃ nānādvārasamāyutamvistāramaṣṭavahnyahni vasughnaṃ raviṇā bhajetyonistārā ca paryante triṃśanmunihate satina cāyaṃ vihitaḥ tvagramaṇḍape cāntarālakeanyeṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ mūloktaṃ sarvamācaretpañcahastāntamānaṃ tu bhittimānaṃ ca maṇḍapepañcāṅgulaṃ samārabhya vyomamātravivṛddhitaḥvyomapaṅkti samārabhya vyomapaṅktivivṛddhitaḥbhadropabhadrasaṃyuktaṃ madhyastambhaprabhāsanam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: lāṅgalākārakuḍyāḍhyaṃ nānālaṅkāraśobhitamdvāratālatalopetaṃ kūṭakoṣṭhādiśobhitamāsthānamaṇḍapaṃ kuryāddhāmno dikṣu vidikṣu casabhā vā tatra kartavyā cāṣṭadiṅmukhasaṃyutamekānekatalopetaṃ pārśvasopānasaṃyutampañcahastaṃ samārabhya vyomahastavivṛddhitaḥvistārapādavṛddhyā tu yāvadvedaguṇaṃ bhavetvahnibhittiṃ samārabhya vyomabhittivivardhanātvistārabhittivasudhāṃ kṛtvārdhārdhavivardhanātyugmabhittiṣu madhyasthapādānāmojavistaraḥojabhittiṣu madhyasthapadaśreṇidvayaṃ tu vāmūlabhittipramāṇena pādaṃ vārdhatripādakammūlapādācca dvārasthāḥ pādā ye saṃsthitāḥ tvihasvasvasthānagatā vāpi vidhātavyā vicakṣaṇaiḥeteṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ prokṣaṇaṃ tvadhunocyatebrāhmaṇān bhojayitvādau taducchiṣṭaṃ vivarjayetvāstuhomaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā paryagnikaraṇaṃ nayetnivṛttyādikalā nyastvā madhyastambhacatuṣṭayevastrairastreṇa cāveṣṭya mālādyairbhūṣayattataḥmūrtimūrtīśvarānnyastvā madhyame maṇḍapasya tutaṇḍulaiḥ tilalājaiśca darbhaiḥpuṣpaiḥ paristarettadvāme vardhanīṃ tasyāṃ devīmāvāhya bhaktitaḥdharmaṃ jñānaṃ ca vairāgyamaiśvaryaṃ teṣu vahnitaḥtataḥ śivāgniṃ saṃsthāpya samidājyānnalājakaiḥpradhānena śivenāṅgaiḥ pūrvadiksthaṇḍile matāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tattvādyaiśca tato hutvā pūrṇāhutimathācaretnavavastradhṛguṣṇīṣī sottarīyaḥ samālakaḥsumuhūrte sulagne tu mantranyāsaṃ samārabhetprāyaścittamaghoreṇa kṛtvā pūrṇāṃ samācaretnyastvā tadadbhiḥ saṃprokṣya gandhapuṣpādibhiryajetevameva sabhādīnāṃ vidheyaṃ prokṣaṇaṃ budhāḥprāsādasya viśālārdhaṃ daṇḍamityabhidhīyateekaprākārakḷptistu pañcadhā parikīrtitātena bhāgena tadbāhye dviguṇaṃ triguṇaṃ tu vāpañcaṣaḍguṇamiṣṭaṃ ca prākāradvayakalpanamprāsādasya caturbhāge yastu daṇḍamihocyatecatuṣpañcaṣaḍaṃśaistu pañcaṣaṭsaptabhistathāpañcadhā kathitaṃ vedaprākāraṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥnavabhāgāvasānaṃ tu samantātparivardhayetevaṃ catuṣprākāre'pi prāsādasya viśālakamdaṇḍārdhaṃ yojayeddhīmān hastamānena cocyateeṣu prākāramānaṃ tu kṣudrāṇāmaṣṭadhā matamcatuṣpañcakaraṃ caiva pañcaṣaṭkarameva canandadīrghāṣṭakaṃ caiva dviprākārapramāṇakamtriprakārapramāṇaṃ tu vedaprākārakaṃ tathācatuṣprākāramānaṃ tu kṣudrādīnāṃ prakīrtitamniyamo vidyate naiva prāsāde sārvadeśikeardhatryaṃśacaturbhāgairdvibhāgaiśca krameṇa tuprāsādasya viśālena sapādena samena cakalpayeddhastamāne'pi prāguktavidhinā saha
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcaṣaṇmunisāle'pi cāṣṭanandavṛtau tathāsamaṃ tu caturaśraṃ tatpūrvaṃ kṛtvā tataḥ parampṛṣṭhe vā kalpayetpārśve purātanavimānakeekahastaṃ samārabhya hastaikaikavivṛddhitaḥvardhayeddhrāsayedvāpi yāvadiṣṭaprapūraṇamekapārśve'thavā kuryānmukhāyāme prakalpayetdviguṇaṃ dviguṇārdhaṃ vā triguṇaṃ ca caturguṇaṃyāvatpañcaguṇaṃ tāraṃ mukhāyāmaṃ prakalpayetbhittimadhyaṃ tu vā kuryātprākārāṇāṃ pramāṇakamkalpayetpādamārgeṇa prākārasya prakalpanepūraṇaṃ vā prakartavyaṃ hastamānavaśe'pi cataduktamātraṃ saṃgrāhya mātroktaṃ tatra yojayetśeṣaṃ ṛkṣaṃ tu vistārātsakalādvātha kalpayetāyaṃ triguṇitaṃ digbhirmanubhirvibhajettataḥdhvajādiyonayaḥ proktāḥ paryantatriṃśato bhavetmūlaprāsādahastairvā cānyairvātha nirīkṣayetdvihastāntaḥ samuddiṣṭaḥ sālānāṃ caiva vistaraḥtriguṇaṃ tu samārabhya kṣudre mahati mandireṣaḍaṃśaṃ tu samārabhya yāvatṣoḍaśabhāgikamadhiṣṭhānādivargāḍhyaṃ khaṇḍaharmyādimaṇḍitamchatrādiśikharopetamūrdhvasthavṛṣabhānvitamsapādenātha sārdhena pādonadviguṇena vāupānaṃ kathitaṃ tasyopariṣṭāttena mānataḥtasyopariṣṭātkampaṃ tu taccaturthāṃśamānataḥpādonadviguṇaṃ vāpi dviguṇāntaṃ prakalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṅguladvayamārabhya caikaikāṅgulavardhanātṣaṭpañcavedarudrākṣadvyaṅgulaiḥ parikalpayetsārvadeśikaharmye tu nā cāyaṃ vidhiriṣyatebāhyanimnaṃ tu vā kāryaṃ sālānāmaṅkaṇaṃ budhaiḥsabhākṛtirvā kartavyā caikadvitrikabhittibhiḥupānāttu samārabhya mūlaprāsādatuṅgakamdvipādaṃ pādadairghyaṃ tu śeṣeṇa parikalpayetadhiṣṭhānadvibhāgena pādaṃ śeṣeṇa kalpayetsaptahastānta utsedhaḥ stambhānāṃ parikīrtitaḥpakṣāṅgulaṃ samārabhya cārdhāṅgulavivardhanātpādoccārdhamadhiṣṭhānasaptamāṣṭanavāṃśakampādocce tricaturbhāgenāthavāpi masūrakamprastarādipramāṇaṃ ca prāsādoktavadācaretcatuṣkoṇe'pi vā kuryādgarbhaṃ ca prathameṣṭakāmsvasya dakṣiṇakeṃ'śe tu dvārakoṇāntare'pi vāsthānaṃ garbhasya nirdiṣṭaṃ tatrasthā prathameṣṭakābhittyūrdhvasthacatuṣkoṇeṣvekasminniṣṭakāṃ nyasettṛtīyā madhyahārā syānmaryādākhyā caturthakāparivārāmarān sarvāṃstatra saṃsthāpayedguruḥparivāravimānānāṃ mānaṃ garbhārdhameva vāekahastaṃ samārabhya rudrahastāntameva hiaṅgaliṅgālayākārāḥ parivārālayā matāḥsantyaktapādarūpāṃśamūladeśamukhānvitāḥdakṣasthāḥ saumyavaktrāḥ syurdakṣāsyāḥ saumyadiggatāḥnāgarāḍīśadeśe syādagastyaśca tathaiva ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vasavo ṛṣayaścārkā rudrā ekādaśaiva hisarveṣu parivāreṣu sāmānyo'yaṃ prakīrtitaḥmaṇḍapaṃ tu caturdvāraṃ kārayedvṛṣabhasya tudvitīyaḥ parivāraḥ syātsacaṇḍeśaḥ tṛtīyakaḥtataḥ saptārciṣā yuktaḥ pañcamo'dya samīritaḥaṣṭamaḥ parivāraḥ syāt saṃyuktaḥ saptamātṛbhiḥparivārāṣṭakairhīnaṃ vimāne parikalpayetādityaśca krameṇa syādgaṇavidyeśvarāstu vāpadmajaṃ sthāpayedviṣṇuṃ tadvihīnamathāpi vācaṇḍeśamīśadigbhāge kṣetrapālaṃ ca tatra vaivighnasarasvatīyuktāṃ tṛtīyāṃ vā pṛthaṅnyasetaṣṭadikṣu viśālāḥ syuḥ sapīṭhāḥ kevalāstu vādvādaśa syurdviraṣṭau ca caturviṃśatisaṃkhyakādviraṣṭaparivāro'yaṃ teṣu saumyaṃ nigadyateādityaṃ suprajaṃ vahniṃ kinnaraṃ mātaraṃ tathāskandaṃ jyeṣṭhāṃ ca durgāṃ ca viṣṇuṃ caṇḍeśvaraṃ tathāasminneva pade cāntarviṃdyeśā dvārapāstu vāsthaṇḍile tu pade sthāpya rdvātriṃśadravibhāgataḥyamaṃ suśāntaṃ bhūteśaṃ vighneśaṃ bhāratīmapibrahmāṇaṃ viṣṇumante ca kāśyapaṃ nandinaṃ tathāantarviṣadyeśvarān vāpi ṛṣīn vā vinyasedvasūnekasālādisāleṣu yuktyā sarvatra yojayetvṛṣaṃ śūlaṃ ca caṇḍeśaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ gaṇādhipameṣāṃ madhyādatheṣṭānvā nyasetpañcādisālakepṛṣṭhaṃ vihāya tritayamekamagre'thavā bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pratisālaṃ tu pīṭhaṃ vā paiśācaṃ tu bahirbhavetpañcaviṃśatimātrānto vistārādagrapīṭhakeekadvitricatasraḥ syurmekhalāyāstathoparimekhalādviguṇaṃ padmaṃ triguṇaṃ vā caturguṇamtripādaṃ vā dvipādaṃ vā parikalpayettripādena vidheyā vā yathāśobhabalena vāmahatāṃ pīṭhakānāṃ ca lakṣaṇaṃ śṛṇutottamāḥtadantare'ṣṭabhāge tu navadhā vistaro bhavetnavahastapramāṇānto mahāpīṭhasya vistaraḥtripādo hyarhdamāno vā tattadantarajo'pi vāpīṭhatārasamo vā syādekadvitryaṅgulonnataḥpādena kampaḥ karṇastu tripādena prakīrtitaḥbhāgena vājanaṃ cordhve tadūrdhve padmamiṣyateṣoḍaśāṣṭāṃśahīno vā patravistāra iṣyatetayorantaramānaṃ tu navadhoccaṃ bhaveddvijāḥpādamānāntarāṣṭāṃśe navamānaṃ prakīrtitamardhamānāntaropetaḥ karṇikocchrāya iṣyateadhiṣṭhānopapīṭhoktakṛtiṃ vopari kalpayetmadhyabhadrayutaṃ vāpi nānācāmarasaṃyutamanekanāsikājālaṃ sopapīṭhaṃ tu kevalamprāsādapotamadhyāttu pādamadhyavivarjitamtatra saṃsthāpayetpīṭhaṃ tata ārabhya vardhayetpīṭhāyāmāntarā hyetadvṛṣapṛṣṭhe'thavā bhavetgrāmamadhye'thavā kuryāddhāmeśāne'thavā bhavetkuryādādyeṣṭakāmadhye pūrvoktavidhinā guruḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: saṃśliṣṭaṃ vātha viśliṣṭaṃ sopānaṃ tadapīritammahāpīṭhadhvajādyaṃ ca paścime parikalpayetcaturdvārayute dvāraṃ pratyakṣaṃ vā saśūlakampratolī pūrvadeśe syātpaścime vā caturdiśivāyavyāṃ śayanasthānamaiśānyāṃ kūpamiṣyateindrapāvakayormadhye dhanasthānaṃ tu vā bhavetagnikuṇḍaṃ ca tatra syādyamapāvakamadhyamekāmikādiśivajñānasthānaṃ yāmyadiśi sthitamnirṛtau puṣpasaṃsthānaṃ tadvāme vātha kalpayetvāyavye dakṣiṇe vātha jñānakośaṃ prakalpayetkūpasthānaṃ kubere vā tatpūrve vaiśadeśakeaiśānyāṃ śayanasthānamathavā parikalpayetkūpaṃ ca śayanasthānaṃ puṣpamajjanamaṇḍapedevopakaraṇasthānaṃ noktaṃ vistārabhīruṇāpūjakānāṃ gṛhaṃ tatra paricārakasaṃsthitiḥāsthānamaṇḍapaṃ sarvadeśe'pi vividhaṃ nayettrihastaṃ tu samārabhya karasyaikasya vardhanāttanmadhye vedikopetaṃ ṣoḍaśastambhasaṃyutamkuṇḍaṃ vā sthaṇḍilaṃ vāpi śaravedaikasaṃkhyayāmātṝṇāṃ navakuṇḍaṃ vā caikakuṇḍamathāpi vāpañcagavyādibhisteṣāṃ śuciṃ toyādhivāsanamkautukaṃ śayanārohaṃ kumbhavinyāsameva catattadvarṇādisaṃsthāne yajetsamyakchivadvijāḥpalāśodumbarāśvatthavaṭaiḥ pūrvādidikṣu catataḥ prabhāte bimbādyaṃ kumbhānagnīṃśca pūjayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: niṣkādidaśaniṣkāntā gurāvanyeṣu pūrvavatkumbhādbījaṃ samādāya vinyasetsvasvadeśakesamaṃ sapādaṃ sārdhaṃ vā sajagat pādukā bahiḥpratiṣṭhāṃ kārayenmuktvāratnanyāsaṃ pradakṣiṇammahāpīṭhapratiṣṭhāyā vidhānamadhunocyatevedaikasaṃkhyayā kuṇḍaṃ vedāśraṃ sthaṇḍilaṃ tu vāsthaṇḍile vedikāyāṃ tu kuṇḍanyāsaṃ tu kārayetavighnaṃ ca tathāmodaṃ pramodaṃ pramukhaṃ tathāavighnaṃ vidrumaprakhyamāmodaṃ śyāmavarṇakamdurmukhaṃ kuṅkumābhaṃ ca dhyātvaivaṃ pūjayedguruḥjaṅghāgalakapadmāntamātmatattvādikaṃ nyasetkrameṇa juhuyāddhīmān palāśodumbarau vaṭamsaṃpūjya pīṭhaṃ kumbhāṃśca prabhāte pāvakaṃ tathāavighnaṃ karṇikāmadhye vinyasetkumbhamadhyagamtattatkumbhodakenaiva snāpayetpīṭhamādarātkintu madhyamakumbhasya madhyame nīlalohitampaścime kṣetrapālaṃ ca some viśvagaṇānnyasetgaṇān paścimadigbhāge yakṣānuttaradiggaterākṣasān pitṛdeśe tu vāyau nāgagaṇānnyasetsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyairnaivedyāntaṃ hi deśikaḥkarṇikāyāṃ nyasetpañcagaṇānaṣṭau daleṣu camantranyāsaviśeṣo'yaṃ piśācabalipīṭhakeādau praṇavayukravasvavarṇo viṣṇusamanvitaḥnamaskārādisaṃyuktaḥ parivārārcane manuḥathavā ekakālaṃ vā anyatsarvaṃ samarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: teṣāṃ pūjā namontena svāhāntamanunā baliḥdvārādibalipīṭhāntaṃ baliṃ dadyādviśeṣataḥkukkuṭāṇḍapramāṇena tadardhena tadardhataḥcaturdvārasamopete bhṛṅgiṇe ca vināyakedevyai caṇḍāya some tu paścādukṣabaliṃ dadetdatvodakaṃ punargandhaṃ puṣpaṃ dhūpaṃ sadīpakamdevadakṣiṇadeśasthaḥ tasmādgacchet pradakṣiṇamkarṇikāyāmavighnasya āmode pūrvadigdaledakṣiṇāpyottareśeṣu baliṃ dadyātsvanāmabhiḥekatra vā baliṃ dadyātpaiśāce vātha bhautikepūrvadakṣāpyasaumyeṣu ṛkṣādibhyo baliṃ kṣipetgṛhebhyaśca tathaiśānyāmasurebhyo'gnigocaredalabāhye baliṃ dadyāddikpālānāṃ svanāmataḥantardvārasya pūrvasmin kalpayetprathamaṃ vṛṣampīṭhe pīṭhe viśeṣeṇa paścime vṛṣabhasthitiḥtyaktvā caturguṇaṃ vāpi tasyāgre sthāpayedvṛṣamtadardhamadhamaṃ jñeyaṃ catustridviguṇaṃ tu vāgarbhaṃ kṛtvā navāṃśaṃ tu navadhā śailaje matamcaturguṇāntamānaṃ tu mṛṇmaye vṛṣabhe matampīṭhāgre mṛṇmayaṃ proktaṃ śailaṃ vā tatra saṃmatamśailaṃ sudhāmayaṃ kāryaṃ śayitaṃ tu viśeṣataḥatha sāmānyaliṅgasya purastādvṛṣabho mataḥlokapālāṅkitaṃ siddhaṃ śatasāhasraliṅgakamtadanyatravṛṣaḥ proktastatrāpi kathitastu vāliṅgatryaṃśāyasaṃyukto lambasūtrārtha dṛgyutaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmāttoyācca nirdagdhaṃ pāpaṃ dehe'sitaprabhamtaddehedakṣahastasthajalakṣepāt śivāstrataḥdevādīnāṃ yathāyojyadravyairvārivisarjanammantrāśca devatā vāṇī diśastatpatayastathābhūtāni pitaraścānye jñātayo guravastathāsvāhayā mantradevānāṃ sarasvatyāstathaiva casiddhānāṃ grahasaṃghānāṃ namontaṃ parikalpayetsarvaṃ hṛdayapūrvaṃ syāt kusumaṃ devatarpaṇamśeṣāṇāmakṣataiḥ kuryādyathāyogyopavītadhṛkmantrāstu mūlabrahmāṅgahetayo munisattamāḥvāgvādinī bhavedvāṇī diśaścendrādayaḥ smṛtāḥatriśca viśvāmitraśca pulastyaḥ pulahaḥ kratuḥtato manuṣyāḥ sanakaḥ sanandanasanātanauśivo rudro bhavānī ca brahmaviṣṇvagnivāyavaḥādityasomāvaṅgārabudhau caiva bṛhaspatiḥbhūtānyasaṃkhyasaṃkhyāni bhūtebhya iti yojayetagniśca kavyavāhādyāḥ pitaraḥ parikīrtitāḥācamya dadyātsūryārdhyaṃ tryakṣareṇa tu mantrataḥdhyātvā sūryaṃ yathānyāyamupasthānaṃ ṣaḍaṅgataḥprātaḥ sthitvā tu sāyāhne samāsīno munīśvarāḥupasthānaṃ tato japtvā vyomavyāpinameva capradakṣiṇaṃ tataḥ kṛtvā kuryāddaṇḍanamaskṛtimarogī rogayuktaścet sadyojātaṃ śataṃ japetgaṇeśarudravāgīśān pūjayet hṛdayena tuvrajeddevakulaṃ vāpi gṛhamātmīyamuttamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: bhaktvā caturaśītyantaṃ tena mānaṃ vidhīyatetāvadeva ca dairghyaṃ syādvaktratārastu ṣaṭkalaḥnetraṃ netrasamaṃ dairghyāttadardhaṃ vistareṇa canetrārdhāntaṃ bhruvoḥ sthaulyaṃ taddairghyaṃ syāddvimātrakamnāsāpradeśavistāro vaktraṃ syāddvādaśāṅgulamnetrāntaraṃ caturmātraṃ trikoṇe tu kapolakekarṇamūlācca vaktrāntaṃ pañcanetraṃ prakīrtitamkarṇamūlau dvimātrau tu tadvaduccasamanvitaukarṇau pañcāṅgulāyāmau kalāvṛttasamudbhavauṣaḍaṅgulāvṛtau mūle ṛjurekhāvibhūṣitauardhāṅgulāgravistāro manāgvakrasamanvitaḥpiṇḍamaṅgulamānaṃ syāducchritaṃ śṛṅgamūlayoḥaṣṭanetrāyatā grīvā kakuddairghyaṃ triṇetrataḥkakudo'dhoṣṭanetrastu jaṅghā pañcadṛgāyatāsārdhanetraṃ tato gulphe dvinetrau khurakau punaḥjaṅghāmūlāvṛtiḥ saptadaśamātrā prakīrtitāmūlāgre copajaṅghāyā veṣṭanaṃ pakīrtitamkakudaḥ pṛṣṭhamānaṃ tu ṣaṭtriṃśanmānamīritamtrikaṭānatimānaṃ tu dvādaśāṅgulamīritampucchamūlaṃ caturmātramagre'ṅgulavinirmitamṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇena tasmātsyātkeśasantatiḥvistāradehamadhye tu ṣoḍaśāṅgula ucyategrīvādhastāccaturmātraṃ sāsnālambaḥ prakīrtitamaśītyaṅgulavistārā kukṣirnābheḥ prakīrtitānābhirnetradvayena syāddvinetrau vṛṣaṇau matau
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sandhirdvimātraḥ ṣaṇṇetrā copajaṅghā prakīrtitākhurake dvyaṅgule kārye dvāviśatyaṅgulena tuveṣṭanaṃ copajaṅghāyāḥ ṣoḍaśāṅgulamucyateeṣā vṛṣakriyā śaktiparyantavyāptisaṃyutābhaktvā pañcāṃśamutsedhaṃ trimātraṃ khuramucyatenavamātraṃ lalāṭaḥ syānmukhavyāsaḥ svarāṅgulaḥsārdhāṅgulaṃ taduccaṃ syānnetramadhyā mukhākṛtiḥpakṣapañcāṃśamutsedhaṃ tena mānaṃ prakīrtitamārabhya mūrdhnaḥ kaṇṭhādho daśāṅgula iti smṛtaḥanutsedhaṃ tu ṣaṇmātraṃ jānumātraṃ dvimātrakamśṛṅgāntaraṃ dvimātraṃ syāttayordairghyaṃ ṣaḍaṅgulamnetrakarṇāntaraṃ tadvatkarṇāyāmaḥ śarāṅgulaḥmūlāyāmoccavistāro dvimātraikatrimātrakaiḥpañcāśadgrīvavistāro mūlavistāra eva cakakutṣaḍaṅgulavyāsa utsedho dvitrimātrakaḥkakudastu śarīroccaṃ proktamāṣṭadaśāṅgulamanyonyamūlamadhyāgravyāso vedāṅgulena capañcāṅgulaṃ tathāyāmo jānudeśaṃ dvimātrakamkhurotsedhaṃ dvimātraṃ syāttathāsyātpucchamūlakammuṣkāyāmaviśāle tu dvimātre ca yathākramamśeṣāyāmaṃ trimātraṃ syādgudaṃ māyāṅgulaṃ bhavetjaṅghāgraṃ tu trimātraṃ syāccheṣaṃ yuktibalānnayetveṇuvastrādivetreṇa sadanaṃ parikalpayetukte'dhyardhayavādyaṣṭa ucchāyasya yavāṅgulamnānābhūṣaṇasaṃyuktaṃ ghaṇṭājālasamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: evaṃ lakṣaṇamākhyātaṃ sthāpanaṃ śrūyatāṃ dvijāḥmaṇṭapaṃ parivāroktamārgeṇaiva samācaretratnanyāsaṃ prakartavyaṃ śailaje lohaje'pyathatato'kṣimocanaṃ śuddhirgrāmādīnāṃ pradakṣiṇamdvijasaṃbhojanaṃ puṇyatoyasecanameva vāvṛṣasya dakṣiṇe śṛṅge kautukaṃ bandhayedguruḥsaptavargāccaturthāntaṃ saptasvaravibhūṣitamvṛṣabhāyā namaścānte tasmin brahmāṅgakalpanāatha vidyeśvarānvāpi vṛṣasya parito nyasettīkṣṇaśṛṅgastathā nandī viṣāṇī paśubhṛttathāsaṃpūjya gandhapuṣpādyairmudgānnaṃ tu nivedayetagnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryātprāguktavidhinā sahaprabhāte deśikaḥ śuddhaḥ pūjāhomaṃ ca kārayetsumūhūrte sulagne tu mantranyāsaṃ samācaretmūlamantreṇa saṃsthāpya gandhapuṣpādibhiryajetkumbhādbījaṃ samādāya vṛṣasya hṛdaye nyasettataḥ kumbhodakenaiva snāpayedvṛṣamādarātkumbhābhiṣekaḥ kartavyastatra prokṣaṇameva camūlaprāsādavistāre saptāṣṭanavabhāgikedvāraśobhādimānaṃ syādgopurāntaṃ viśālataḥdhāmni tāre catuṣpañcaṣaḍbhāgena vibhājitedvāraśobhādivistāraḥ pañcadhā parikīrtitaḥcaturbhāge tribhāgaṃ ca pañcāṃśe caturaṃśakamdvihastādidviraṣṭāntaṃ vyomāratnivivṛddhitaḥekaviṃśatkarāntaṃ tu trihastāddvikavardhanāt
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ārabhya nandahastaṃ tu dvidvihastavivardhanāttripañcadaśasaptāttu ekahastavivardhanātanyathā hastamānena vistāraḥ pravidhīyateprathamāvaraṇe dvāraśobhāvistāra iṣyatepañcaviṃśatihastāttu trayastriṃśatkarāntakaḥpañcaviṃśatsamārabhya tricatvāriṃśadantataḥtripañcāśatkarāntaṃ tu viśālo gopurasya tunagaragrāmaveśādau mānaṃ gopuravistarekalpayeddvāraśobhādau saptāṃśadaśabhāgikamnandāṃśe bhūtabhāgaṃ ca dviguṇam ca prakalpayetmānamapyatha saṃgrāhyaṃ nirgamaṃ cāpi tatsamamekādyaṣṭadaśāṃśāntaṃ gopurāṇāṃ gurūttamāḥsārdhahastāttu pādonadvihastāddvikarātkramātpañcasaptanavāntastu dvāratāraḥ pṛthagbhavetpañcāśe dvāravistāre saptāṃśe munibhājitemūladhāmni masūrādituṅgādvedāṃśakādikaḥkṛtvā masūrapādaṃ ca taccheṣeṇaiva pīṭhakamatha prāguktabhāge tu varddhitaṃ samameva vāchedayettadadhiṣṭhānaṃ sopapīṭhe tu kevalamgopuradvāratuṅgaṃ vā kārayedvāstuśāstravittalādikamatho kuryāt pañcaṣaṭsaptabhūmikamdvāraśobhā dvāraśālā dvāraprāsādaharmyakemasūḥ stambhamānaṃ tu prāgeva pradipāditamṣoḍhā vibhajya tattuṅgaṃ prastaraiḥ sāṅghribhāgakaiḥevamekatalaṃ proktaṃ dvitalaṃ ca vidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekāṃśaṃ galamityuktaṃ sārdhadvyaṃśaṃ śiro bhavetdvādaśāṃśaṃ tribhūmyuccaiḥ kapotaṃ sāṅghribhāgabhākdvibhāgaḥ pādadairghyaṃ syādaṣṭāṃśenāṃśamānataḥśeṣeṇa sthūpikotsedhastritalaṃ caivamīritamtribhāgasahitaṃ bhāgamantoccaṃ pravidhīyatebhāgena galamānaṃ syāttribhāgaiḥ śikharodayaḥuttarādiśikhāntaṃ cāpyekonatriṃśadaṃśakampādonadvyaṃśakaṃ mañcaṃ sārdhadvyaṃśaṃ tu pādapaḥsapādāṃśakapotoccamūrdhvabhāgāddvibhāgataḥsārdhadvyaṃśaḥ śirastuṅgaḥ śeṣeṇa syācchirodayaḥuttarādiśikhāntaṃ yanmañcaṃ ṣaṭtriṃśadaṃśakamdvibhāgaḥ prastarotsedhaḥ pādoccaṃ vedabhāgataḥmañcaṃ pādonabhāgābhyāṃ tripādaḥ pādavaidhṛtiḥsapādabhāgaṃ mañcoccaṃ sārdhabhāgadvibhāgikamsadvipādadvibhāgena śiraḥ śiṣṭāḥ śikhā matāḥstambhaprastarabhāgābhyāṃ kalpitābhyāmadhastaleuktāni gopurāṅgāni vibhajeccaturaṃśakamdvyaṅgulaṃ tryaṅgulaṃ vāpi catuḥpañcaṣaḍaṅgulampañcabhāge viśāle tu tribhāge garbhavistaraḥvyāsaḥ saptāṃśavedāṃśo garbhakūṭastu bhāgabhākkūṭakoṣṭhāntarāle tu pañjarādivibhūṣitamtāre navāṃśe garbhaḥ syāttribhāgaḥ tadvahiḥ kramātkūṭakoṣṭhādisarvāṅgaṃ pūrvavatparikalpayetsārdhāṃśo bhittiviṣkambha ekabhāgamalindakammukhe pṛṣṭhe mahāśālā pañcāṃśo vā ṣaḍaṃśakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vistāre rudrabhāge tu nālīgehaṃ tribhāgataḥekāṃśaṃ khaṇḍaharmyaṃ syādanyatsarvaṃ samānakamvistāre ravibhāge tu nālīgehaṃ yugāṃśakambhāgena khaṇḍaharmyaṃ syādanyatsarvaṃ samānakamtrayodaśāṃśe vistāre garbhaḥ syādaṃśabhāgabhākkhaṇḍaharmyamihaikāṃśaṃ kūṭaśālādi pūrvavatpañcāṃśe hastipṛṣṭhe ca pakṣaśālādibhiryutaḥsaptabhaumamidaṃ proktaṃ gopuraṃ sārvadeśikamcaturaṃśonakaṃ vā syādūrdhvadvāraṃ tu vistarātsopānagarbhagehe tu talaṃ prati samācaretmaṇṭapābhaṃ bhaveddvāraṃ śobhāyai paṇḍiteśvarāḥprāsādākṛtivaddvāraprāsādaṃ paripaṭhyateśālākārasamaṃ kuryāddvāragopuramantimampañcabhāgādibhāgaṃ vā caikatriṃśatsamāvadhivṛddhyā bhāgo'rdhamānena tithyaṃśāntaṃ prakalpayettena vistārabhāgena vyomāṃśaṃdviguṇāvadhitasmādūrdhvaṃ tu dairghyaṃ syādadhikaṃ dvāratārakamgarbhagehātsamantāttu garbhārdhātpādavṛddhitaḥtathālindaṃ ca hāraṃ ca kalpayetkalpavittamaḥtribhāgaṃ tu samārabhya ardhāṃśāttithisaṃkhyayāprāsādālaṅkṛtiṃ caiva śālāyālaṅkṛtiṃ tu vānānāmasūrakopetaṃ nānāstambhasamanvitamvalabhyādiśiroyuktaṃ bahusthūpisamanvitamāyāmāṃśādhikairvāpi samāṃśaiḥ parikalpayetdhāmnāṃ samastabhūṣābhiranyābhiḥ samalaṃkṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: khalūrikāvidhānoktarītyā caitatsamācaretmūrdheṣṭakāvidhānaṃ ca dhāmoktavidhinācaretkṛtvordhvaśailaṃ pratyekaṃ catuḥsaṃkhyaṃ niveśya cakiñcaitadadhidevāṃśca jñānākhyakriyayā sahavivṛttiṃ ca vinā brahmarahitāḥ kāraṇaṃ tu vāaṇḍāntarvartinaḥ ṣaṭsu kalānyāsāḥ prakīrtitāḥvāmādyā navakalpe syurlokapālā daśākhyakeviśverudrāśvinī proktāścatuṣpañcadaśānvitetattatsvanāmamantreṇa nyasettaddhāmni nirmitepūrvoktavidhināyuktakuṇḍe vā sthaṇḍile'pi vāsthaṇḍile vedikordhve ca aṣṭau ca sthāpayedghaṭānśatasaṃkhyaistadardhairvā tanmantraiḥ samidādibhiḥśāntyādīnādito nyastvā tanmanūnabhiṣecayetanyatrāpyanukalpaṃ syātpracurā vā prakīrtitāniṣkale paścimadvāraṃ sakale dakṣiṇaṃ hitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidyātatvātmakaṃ gehaṃ siddhimuktiphalapradamprakṣālya pādau hastau ca tathā''camya yathāvidhityajañccheṣādhvano bhāgaṃ prāsādaṃ praviśed budhaḥevaṃ saṃkṣepataḥ proktaṃ snānādyaṃ munisattamāḥparārthaṃ svārthamityeva dvividhaṃ tatprakīrtitamyajanaṃ svārthamākhyātaṃ svasyeṣṭaphaladaṃ yataḥaṣṭaṣaṣṭimahākṣetreṣvanyatra ca manoramemanujaiḥ sthāpite liṅge parārthayajanaṃ smṛtamgrāmādīnāṃ vivṛddhyarthaṃ parārthejyā prayujyatāmdhārmikaḥ kurute nityamādiśaivo dvijottamaḥśivasṛṣṭi vinā ye tu jāyante brahmaṇo mukhātyadi mohena kurvīran rājño rāṣṭrasya nāśanamṣaṇmāsātpatanaṃ yānti tasmāttānparivarjayetśivājñāvaśatastasya parārthejyā na doṣabhākśivaliṅgārcanasyaite koṭyaṃśenāpi no samāḥsuciraṃ sañcaratyasminsaṃsāre duḥkhasāgarena tvanabhyarcya bhuñjīyādbhagavantaṃ trilocanamājānu pādau prakṣālya hastāvāmaṇibandhanātdivyā nabhogatāścaiva bhūgatāstrividhāḥ smṛtāḥpārṣṇighātatrayādbhomān prāsādādapasārayetyāmyakauberavaktrantu na siddhāviṣyate budhaiḥekadvāravimāneṣyaṃ niyamo niṣkalasya tucaturdvāraṃ prakartavyaṃ tatrāyaṃ niyamo na hiliṅgasyābhimukhaṃ yattu dvāraṃ tatpūrvamiṣyatebalipīṭhaṃ vṛṣaṃ śūlaṃ tadvaktrābhimukhaṃ bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yamunāñca mahākālaṃ vāmaśākhāgatau yajetdevī caṇḍau dvipārśvasthau dvārāṇāṃ caturānanerūpasaṃsthānabhāvaistu gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramātpraviśeddakṣapādena prāsādābhyantaraṃ guruḥsaṃpūjyātmabhuvaṃ vāstoṣpate brahmaṇa ityapigandhapuṣpādikaṃ sarvamānītaṃ paricārakaiḥvīkṣitāṃstattvadṛṣṭyā cābhyukṣitānastramantrataḥkalaśānsuśironāhān susthirān chidravarjitānśivatīrthamanuprāpya ṣaḍaṅgenābhimantrayetpūrayed rudragāyatryā hṛdā toyaiḥ paṭasrutaiḥdvau dvau yoktṛniyuktāṃstānekaikena tu pāṇināna spṛśedūrupārśvasthadvāraśākhādikaṃ yathāpraliptabhūmāvāstīrya kuśapuṣpādikaṃ hṛdākṣmālokapadapañcāśatpañcapañcaghaṭāṃstu vāsnapanoktyā'tha saṃsthāpya kuryānnityābhiṣecanamtṛtīyā dravyaśuddhiḥ syāccaturthaṃ mantraśodhanammārjite copalipte ca dhāmanyanyatra vā budhaḥyatheṣṭamāsanaṃ badhvā ṛjukāyottarānanaḥparasparau ca saṃspṛśya talakau hastapṛṣṭhakauvidyāśarīratāṃ dhyātvā tayoḥ śaktyantamuttamamgṛhasthaḥ sṛṣṭimārgeṇa karanyāsaṃ tu kārayetaṅguṣṭhādikaniṣṭhāntamīśātsadyāvasānakamkaniṣṭhādyaṅguṣṭhāntaṃ ca saṃhāranyāsamucyatenetraṃ hastatale nyasya paścādaṅgāni vinyasettarjanyāṅguṣṭhake nyāsaḥ sarvāsvaṅguṣṭhato bhavet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadvāstravarmacūḍākahṛdo'ṅguṣṭhādito nyasetmūrdhādiḥ sṛṣṭirityuktā pādādiḥ saṃhṛtirbhavetamṛtīkṛtya bhāvena kavacenāvakuṇṭhayetsakalīkaraṇe sandhyākāle cācamane tathāsaṃhāramudrayā dehavyāptaṃ cittaṃ nirudhya cahṛtkaṇṭhatālubhrūśaṃkharodhinyo brahmarandhrakamtāsāmupari yā śaktistasyāṃ vā yojayennaraḥyojanaṃ deśikaiḥ kāryaṃ rakṣārthaṃ bhogyakarmaṇāmmuktau karmaṇi devājñāvaśato nāsti tallayaḥsaṃsiddhā jagataḥ sṛṣṭilayabhogādihetukāpradhvastāśeṣadoṣo'yaṃ nirmalaścāvaśiṣyateadhikāravaśād bhūyo dehitvaṃ pratipadyatekṛtvaivaṃ yojanaṃ paścāt tatastatvāni bhāvayetpañcaviṃśati ṣaṭtriṃśadekaṃ vā'dhyātmikaṃ tu vāpañcatattvakramādvakṣye śodhanaṃ dehaśuddhayeetāḥ kalāstābhireva vyāptaṃ sarvamidaṃ jagatvarṇāstu bhuvanairvyāptāstattvairvyāptāni tāni tuśodhanīyā vibhāvyaivaṃ pañcapañcādhvagarbhitāḥyaddhyānaṃ pratiparvaṃ tu prāṇāyāmasamanvitampārthivaṃ caturaśraṃ tu hemābhaṃ vajralāñchitamnivṛttyākhyakalopetaṃ hṇāmityuddhātapañcakamvāmaśīrṣasamāyuktaṃ pratiṣṭhākalayānvitamagnistryaśraṃ saptaśikhaṃ raktābhaṃ rudradaivatamyuktaṃ tattriṃbhirudghātairhrūmityuccārasaṃyutamīśādhipatyaṃ yārṇaṃ tatpuruṣakavacairyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ākāśaṃ vartulaṃ tyaktalāñcchanaṃ dhūmravarṇakamekodghātena haumuktvā yathāsthānaṃ prayojayetvāhneyaṃ tālumūle tu bhrūmadhye vāyusambhavamājānu pṛthivī jñeyā nābherāpyaṃ nigadyatetadūrdhvaṃ gaganasthānaṃ dhāraṇārthaṃ prakīrtitamrecakaṃ pūrakaṃ caiva kumbhakaṃ ca tridhā'bhyasetbrahmaviṣṇuharāsteṣāmadhidevāḥ prakīrtitāḥmātrādvādaśabhirhīno dviguṇairmadhyamo mataḥrecayeddehagaṃ vāyumaśuddhaṃ vyomasaṃsthitamsampūrṇakumbhavattiṣṭhedrevayettadanantarampāśupatena śastreṇa revayedbandhamocanātsthānātsthānāntaraprāptirjīvasyāsya tadutkramātśivena sahitaṃ cāntaṃ codghātagranthibhedataḥpūrakārddhena pārthivyā heyopādeyavitsudhīḥpatrapuṣpaphalopetaṃ snigdhaṃ vairāgyaśastrataḥjñānānalena nirdagdhaṃ pādāṅguṣṭhādikāntakampralīnamantyayā śuddhaṃ nirmalaṃ vyoma bhāvayetāplāvya cāmṛtenaiva vidyāṅgaṃ vinyasettataḥāvāhya tatra cātmānaṃ mudrayā puṣpamantrayukaghoraṃ hṛdaye nyasya guhye vāmaṃ prakalpayetmūrdhādipādaparyantaṃ mālābrahmāṇi vinyasetbījabrahmāṇi vā vidvānaṣṭatriṃśatkalāṃ nyasetīśvaraḥ sarvabhūtānāṃ namontaṃ pūrvamūrdhaniśivo me'stu namo'ntaṃ ca tathā kauberamūrdhaniīśānasya kalāḥ pañca praṇavādi prakalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nāmaiśānakalānāṃ syāttannāmnā kevalaṃ tu vātatpuruṣāya vidmahe natyantaṃ pūrvavaktraketanno rudra namontaṃ ca kalpayeduttarānanekalāścatasro vaktre syurmūrdhnyavyaktakalā bhavetaghorebhyopi natyantaṃ tamāṃ hṛdayagocarerakṣāṃ ghoranamontaṃ ca dakṣiṇāṃse tu vinyasetmṛtyuṃ ca sarvataḥ sarvanamo nābhau tu vinyasetnamaste rudranatyantamabhayāṃ pṛṣṭhake nyasetbahurūpakalāścāṣṭau vidyādehe prakalpayetrakṣāṃ jyeṣṭhāya natyantaṃ liṅge praṇavakaṃ nyasetpālyāṃ kālāya natyantaṃ vāmorugatamāvahetvikaraṇāya namontaṃ ca saṃyamīṃ vāmajānunibuddhiṃ vikaraṇāyeti namontaṃ vāmajaṅghikedhātrīṃ pramathanāyeti namontaṃ vāmatassphicisarvabhūtadamanāya padamekaṃ prakalpayetunmanāyeti natyantaṃ bhavāṃ pārśve tu vāmakesadyojātaṃ prapadyāmi siddhi dakṣiṇapādakedyutiṃ bhave namontaṃ ca nyaseddakṣiṇabāhukenyasennātibhave medhāṃ natyantaṃ nāsikāgrataḥsvadhāṃ bhavanamontaṃ ca nyaseddakṣiṇabāhukesadyojātakalāścāṣṭau nyasetsarvāḥ svamudrayāmūlamantraṃ samāvāhya paścādaṅgāni vinyasetśikhāyāṃ tu śikhāṃ nyasya kavacaṃ stanamadhyataḥdīpakaṃ vāgbhavaṃ binduṃ śrīkaṇṭhāya padaṃ tataḥnyaset oṃ āṃ anantāya virajāyai natiḥ punaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]
