sanskrit: śālmalyai nama ityevaṃ nyaseddakṣiṇacakṣuṣinyasedvāmākṣimadhye tu omuṃkāramanantaramdakṣaśrotre nyasedetadomūṃkāramanantaramvāmakarṇe nyasedetadomṛṃkāraṃ tu vinyasetdakṣanāsāpuṭe nyaset omṝṃkāramanantaramvāmanāsāpuṭe nyasyet oṃ ḷ/kāramanantaramoṃ ḹṃkārapadaṃ pūrvaṃ harāyeti padaṃ punaḥomeṃkārapadaṃ pūrvaṃ caṇḍīśāya padaṃ punaḥomaiṃkāramathoddhṛtya bhautikāya padaṃ punaḥomoṃkāramathoddhṛtya sadyojātāya yatpadamomaumanugraheśāya ulkāmukhyai namaḥ puanaḥomaṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya krūrāya ca padaṃ punaḥomaḥkāraṃ samuddhṛtya mahāsenāya yatpadamoṃkaṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya krodhīśāya padaṃ punaḥoṃ khaṃkāraṃ samuddhṛsya caṇḍeśāya padaṃ punaḥoṃ gaṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya padaṃ pañcāntakāya cadakṣiṇe maṇibandhe syādoṃ ghaṃkāramanantaramnatistrailokyavandyāyai dakṣapāṇitale nyasetmantraśaktyai namaśceti nyaseddakṣakarāgrataḥātmaśaktyai namaśceti vāmabāhau tu vinyasetbhūtamātre namaśceti vinyasedvāmakūrparevāme tu maṇibandhe syādoṃ jhaṃkāramanantaramvāmapāṇitale nyasyedoṃ ñaṃkāramanantaramoṃ ṭaṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya someśāya padaṃ punaḥoṃ ṭhaṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya padaṃ lāṅgaline namaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: oṃ ḍaṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya dārukāya padaṃ punaḥoṃ ḍhaṃkārapadaṃ yattadardhanārīśvarāya caoṃ ṇaṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya umākāntāya yatpadamoṃ taṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya ṣaḍīśāyeti yatpadamoṃ thaṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya ḍiṇḍine yatpadaṃ punaḥoṃ daṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya atraye yatpadaṃ punaḥoṃ dhaṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya ceśānāya padaṃ punaḥoṃ naṃkāraṃ samuddhṛtya meṣāya padamuddharetoṃ paṃlohitāyeti kālārātryai namaḥ padamkubjinyai nama ityevaṃ vāmapārśve tu vinyasetkāminyai nama ityevaṃ pṛṣṭhabhāge tu vinyasetvajrāyai nama ityevaṃ nābhideśe tu vinyasethṛddeśe vinyasedoṃ yaṃ padaṃ yattattvagātmaneoṃ raṃ raktātmane ceti bhujaṅgāyeti yatpadamoṃ laṃ vasātmane ceti padaṃ yattu pinākineoṃ vaṃ medomayāyeti khaṅgīśāya padaṃ punaḥoṃ śaṃ asthyātmane ceti bekāyeti samuddharetoṃ ṣaṃ majjātmane ceti śvetāya padamuddharetoṃ saṃ śuklātmane ceti bhṛgave padamuddharetoṃ haṃ prāṇātmane ceti lakulīśāya yatpadamoṃ laṃ liṅgātmane ceti tamorūpāya yatpadamoṃ kṣaṃ krodhātmane ceti vartakāyeti yatpadamhṛdādisthānagairvarṇairmātṛkāṅgāni kalpayetkucaṃ cakṣurdvayaṃ kūṭaṃ hṛdādyairjātibhiryutamkīlaṃ mantrasusiddhaye japatu tat saṃyojya saṃlopya ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: hṛcchiraścūlikāvarmanetrāstrāṇi yathākramamevaṃ kṛtvā lipinyāsaṃ tattvānāṃ navakaṃ nyasetkaṇṭhahṛnnābhideśeṣu śāśvatasthāna eva catryakṣaraṃ melanāyuktaṃ nābhau hṛdi lalāṭakeevaṃ mantratvamāpanno divyadehe yathākramāthṛdaye'rcāvidhānaṃ tu nābhau homaṃ prakalpayethṛdaye kalpayeddhāma īśvarāvāhanakrameāvāhya devaṃ gandhādyairmānasaiḥ śivamarcayetuddīpya ca nijaṃ vahniṃ saṃruddhāpānavṛttitaḥtanmadhyagaṃ śivaṃ dhyātvā tadekībhāvamāśritaḥādhāre prāṇamāveśya badhvā granthi samūlakamyadvā vistarataḥ kuryānmānasaṃ yāgamādarātdevaṃ vicintya tatrasthaṃ tripakṣamupakalpayettripakṣakṣayagaṃ? dhyāyettattvagrāmaṃ caturvidhammūrtividyātanuṃ kalpya samāvāhya śivaṃ tataḥgaṇeśairlokapālaiśca hetibhirvajrapūrvakaiḥsaptaviṃśatyāvaraṇairyathāśakti samarcayetmanasā bhāvayannityaṃ pūjayetparameśvaramprāpnoti tadvadatrāpi phalamiṣṭamavāpnuyātprādharmikānāṃ sarveṣāṃ pratyāvṛtti virecayetmaheśaṃ sadāśivaṃ caiva śivamiṣṭvā tu recayetlokapālāstrayoścaiva rudrādīnāmathāvṛtaucandrārkodayataḥ pūjā vṛthā kleśo bhaviṣyatisuṣumnāmadhyage prāṇe pūjayetsarvadevatāḥpārthivādyaṣṭapūjākhyatattvajātaṃ samarpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tā eva pānanaivedyaṃ taijasaṃ dī?pamālikāevañcetaratattvāni yathāyogyaṃ nivedya cakṛtvaivamātmaśuddhiṃ tu sthānaśuddhimathācarettadbahiḥparighāṃ dhyātvā kavacenaiva mantrataḥdivyaṃ dhāma vicintyā'tha dravyaśuddhiṃ prakalpayetprokṣayettena toyena śuddhyarthaṃ hetimantrataḥyadanyadupayogyaṃ tu hetinā kṣālayettataḥsauvarṇaṃ rājataṃ tāmraṃ kelihārañca śaṅkhajamanyadvā yantrikādisthaṃ pātramuktaṃ śivārcaneghandhapuṣpādikaṃ sarvamānītaṃ paricārakaiḥprakṣālya pādyapātraṃ tu gandhatoyena pūrayettadvadācamanīyārthaṃ tatpātraṃ parikalpayetācamīye prayoktavyaṃ hṛdayena tu mantrataḥāpaḥ kṣīrakuśāgrāṇi taṇḍulāḥ sumanāstilāḥkalpayitvā viśeṣārghyaṃ tatra mantragaṇānnyasettattoyaiḥ kavacenaiva sakuśaṃ prokṣayettathādadhikṣīraghṛtādīṃśca prokṣayeddhṛdayena tuśrīkhaṇḍāgarupatrakaiśca kusumairāmodibhiḥ saṃyutāḥproktadravyagaṇeṣu labdhamiha yattadgrāhyamāḍhyetaraiḥsnānakumbheṣu sarveṣu nikṣipetta dviśuddhayegandhaṃ vastraṃ bhūṣaṇañca naivedyaṃ kusumaṃ tathāavaśiṣṭaṃ tu gāyatryā mantrayed dravyaśuddhayepavitrairhṛdayādyairvā snānārthamabhimantrayetmudrayā cāmṛtīkṛtya bhāvayedamṛtākhyayātilakaṃ candanaṃ kṛtvā puṣpaṃ śirasi vinyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mālādyaiśvaryajālāni mantrāṇāṃ kīrtitāni vaioṃkāra dinamontāśca paṭhenmantrānaśeṣataḥtrimātrādakrameṇaiva yāvannādāntamaṃ vrajetyojaye pañcagavyaṃ tu tadvidhānamihocyatepañcatattvakṛtanyāse pañcapātrāṇi vinyasetsupratiṣṭhaṃ suśāntaṃ ca tejovadamṛtātmakamgomayañcaiva gomūtraṃ īśānādyaistu mantritamamṛtīkṛtya sapūjya śivenaikatvamādiśetpavitrairhṛdayādyairvā snānārthamabhimantrayetsnapanaṃ tu yathānyāyaṃ taccānekavidhaṃ bhavetsūtranyāsamaghoreṇa tālamātrāntaraṃ yathācaturdalaṃ yadā pañcakalaśasthāpanaṃ diśipañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyātaṃ tatsamantāt samāvṛtampañcaviṃśatisakhyātān kalaśān madhyamasthitānaṣṭadvārasamāyuktaṃ bahirāvaraṇadvayammadhyame tithima?khyātaṃ madhyamatritayaṃ tyajetsūtradvayaṃ nyaset?pūrvāparagaṃ yāmyasaumyakamsyāccaturdaśa saṃkhyā?tā vṛtirbāhye bhrameṇa camadhyavyūhasya paritaścatuṣkuṇḍaṃ tu vā'ṣṭakamaṣṭottarasahasrāttu tyajedbāhyāvṛti guruḥanyatsarvaṃ samānaṃ syādaṣṭapañcaśataṃ bhavetbāhye ṣoḍaśasaṃkhyātān gṛhṇīyāddigvidiggatamsthaṇḍilaṃ puruṣeṇa syācatuḥprasthamitaṃ parammānaṃ ca śivakumbhe syāttadardhaṃ karake matamkalaśe veṣṭanaṃ dvitrivyomasūtraiḥ krameṇa tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ebhiryuktaṃ śivāmbhaḥ syācchivamantrābhimantritamṣaṭtriṃśattattvaparyantān kuśān tryādīnatha nyasetvastrayugmena saṃveṣṭya śivakumbhaṃ ca vardhanīmpādyamācamanañcārghyaṃ pañcagavyaṃ caturdiśidvitīyasnapanaṃ proktaṃ tṛtīyaṃ ca nigadyatebhūtīkṣusārakadalītilasarṣapapānasāḥpañcaviṃśatimadhye tu saṃtyajedantarāvṛtamcaturdikṣu ca koṇeṣu pādyādyaṣṭakamīritamprāguktatritayañcaitadviśeṣānnityakarmaṇiuttamottamapūjāyāmaṣṭottaraśatāvadhidravyāṇyetāni sarvāṇi mūlamantreṇa vinyasetdatvā hṛdayamantreṇa vastrāṇi vividhāni cabrahmabhiḥ sakalīkṛtya tatkalāstatra vinyasetsthāpanādi ca pādyādi kṛtvā datvā hṛdā guruḥpadarśya liṅgamudrāṃ tu kavacenāvakuṇṭhayetpañcakḷptau tu brahmāṇi hitveśānaṃ dvijottamāḥantare vāmadevādyāḥ pañcaviṃśatisaṃkhyakekrodhādyā vasusaṃkhyātāḥ śatarudrādikāstu vāmadhye vidyeśvarāḥ pūjyāḥ śatarudrā bahirmatāḥsa ca nāmnāṃ sahasraistu paṭhyate tadviśeṣataḥsvāhāntaṃ vā namaskāraprāntaṃ praṇavapūrvakamliṅgaśuddhikramātprāptā yathāvadabhidhīyatesvayambhūdevabāṇārṣapauruṣādyamanekadhāpaṭaṃ vā bhitticitraṃ vā pīṭhaṃ vā mantrasaṃskṛtamviśeṣataḥ svayaṃsiddhaṃ pāṣāṇaṃ ratnameva vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: etatsarvaṃ śivejyārthaṃ yathāyogaṃ prakalpayetlohajaṃ saṃyajeddvāre parivāre tu śailajambindunādasamāyuktamādo praṇavapūrvakamdvāramastreṇa saṃprokṣya dvārapānarcayet kramātmahākālena yamunāṃ savye'savye samarcayetete pūjyā namontaiśca hṛdayādyairyathākramamkāryaṃ trividhavighnānāṃ nyasya khaṅgamudumbaresandhyāvasāne nikṣepyaṃ pracchannapaṭamuttamamliṅgamadhyagatāṃ pūjāṃ pūrvakāle prakalpitāmuccārya pañcabrahmāṇi pūjāṃ liṅgādvisṛjya cacaṇḍeśāyeti nikṣipya piṇḍikāmastrayogataḥastrāmbunaiva saṃśodhya śivaliṅgaṃ savedikamāvāhanāsanaṃ padmamanantaṃ snānakarmaṇivastrādīnyanyakarmāṇi siṃhāsane prakalpayetarcanaṃ śaivikaṃ kāryamanyathā na vidhīyateaiśānyāṃ gurupaṅktīśca pūjayeddhṛdayena tuāsanaṃ dvividhaṃ proktaṃ dehajīvavibhedataḥmahāmāyāvasānaṃ tu divyadehaṃ vicintayetyallaghu vyāpakaṃ taddhi vyāptaṃ hi tadadhiṣṭhitamsā'dhāraśaktirnyastavyā pūrvaṃ kūrmaśilāsanedugdhābdhisadṛśākārā kalpitā hṛdayārṇagāhṛdaye'ñjalisaṃyuktamekavaktraṃ caturbhujamtatrādhāre hṛdā mantrī vinyasedāsanātmakamsiṃhākārasitārkāṃśupītakṛṣṇanibhāḥ śubhāḥadharmājñānāvairāgyānaiśvaryākhyāni tāni tu
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: adhaśchadanamūrdhvaṃ ca raktaṃ śuklaṃ vicintayetnairṛtyādīśadigbhāge mekhalādhordhvasaṅgatamśaktikesarasaṃbhinnaṃ karṇikāśaktisaṃyutamvāmā jyeṣṭhā ca raudrī ca kālī caiva tataḥ parambalapramathinī caiva sarvabhūtadamanyapimanonmanīṃ karṇikāyāṃ vinyaseddhṛdayena tumaṇḍalatrayamarkenduvahnyākhyaṃ svasvarūpataḥbrahmā viṣṇuśca rudraśca maṇḍalatrayadevatāḥkamaṇḍaludharaṃ raktaṃ daṇḍahastaṃ prajāpatimdhyātvā patreṣu vinyasya sarvakilviṣanāśanampītāmbaradharaṃ divyaṃ vanamālāvibhūṣitamdhyātvā viṣṇuṃ mahātmānaṃ kesareṣu niveśayetsiṃhacarmaparīdhānaṃ śaśāṅkakṛtaśekharamkarṇikāyāṃ niveśyainaṃ mahāpātakanāśamvahnitrayaṃ ca tatraiva vinyaset pravibhāgaśaḥvyapti? sañcintya tanmadhye śaktiṃ bhūyo'pi vinyasetanantaḥ kartṛrūpeṇa pīṭhātmā tvatra tiṣṭhatidharmo jñānaṃ ca vairāgyaṃ tvaiśvaryaṃ ca catuṣṭayamṣaḍadhvamāsanaṃ śambhoḥ pūjā syāddhṛdayena tusarvādhvanirmitaṃ pīṭhaṃ caturyugamahāṅghri?kampañcāśadbhāvasambhinnakaṇṭakairupaśobhitamvidyeśvaradalaṃ śaktikesarairupaśobhitampīṭhamevaṃvidhaṃ dhyāyenmātṛkākṣarasambhavamanantaṃ sṛṣṭi?pūrveṇa tatpūrveṇa mahāmbujamoṃkārādyā akārāntāstyaktaṣaṇḍanavasvarāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kesarāṇi caturviṃśatkādibhāntargatāni camaṇḍalatrayamatraiva pūrvak?parikalpayetmaṇḍalatritayebhyutthāmanalastambhasannibhāmhṛtsampuṭamajātaṃ vai mūrtimantramudāhṛtamvinyasenmūrdhni madhe tu vidyādehaṃ sadāśivamaṣṭatriṃśatkalopetaṃ brahmāṅgakṛtavigrahamdhyānaṃ vai sarvasiddhyarthaṃ paṭādau vā'pi nirmitamśāntaṃ candrakalācūḍaṃ sarpasannaddhasajjaṭamkuṇḍalaiḥ karṇikairhāraiḥ kaṭisūtrodarabandhanaiḥṣoḍaśābdayu?taṃ kāntaṃ suprasannaṃ smitānanamabhayaṃ pāśamanyacca ghaṇṭāṃ nāgāṅkuśau tathāprasādābhayakhaṭvāṅgaśaktiśūlāstu savyataḥicchājñānakriyāśaktitrayanetrayutaṃ smarettriśūlaṃ triguṇaṃ proktaṃ sattā paraśurucyatebahiḥ saṃhāriṇī śaktiḥ pāśānāṃ bhasmasātkarīnāgopadhṛṣṭatā śaktiḥ sarveṣāṃ ca vidhāyikāghaṇṭā nādātmakaṃ rūpaṃ mantravigrahabodhakamyadbhogye hyātmanaḥ prāptistvatraiva niyamo'ṅkuśamīśaḥ sphaṭikavanmadhye pūrve kuṅkumavannaraḥcandrāṃśunirmalaṃ sadyaṃ vaktraṃ paścimadiggatambhrūhīnaṃ tuṅganāsaṃ ca sukapolasmitādharamvivṛtāsyaṃ mahāghrāṇaṃ vṛttākṣaṃ lelihānakamjvālākṛ?tijaṭāvyālabhogibaddhordhvacūḍakamtryakṣaṃ makuṭayuktaṃ ca kuṇḍalālaṅkṛtaṃ śubhamlalāṭatilakopetaṃ darpaṇāsaktatejasam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatraiśānaḥsthitottāno mūrdhasthastvatibhīṣaṇaḥevaṃ vaktrāṇi saṃbhāvya rūpaṃ sādāśivaṃ yajetevaṃ śāktaṃ vapuḥ kalpya tasmin paramakāraṇamvyāpakaṃ sarvatattvānāmaprameyamanūpamamvyaktaṃ kuryādviśeṣeṇa niṣkalaṃ sakalātmaniyathā kāṣṭhama?to vahnirvya?jyate mathanādibhiḥniṣkrāntaṃ kramataḥ svaśaktikiraṇaiḥ syādevamāvāhanamyadyāvāhanamiṣṭaṃ syātsarvagatvaṃ vihanyatetadvadekatra cidvyaktirvyāpakasya na bādhyatetadvanmantratanudvārā śivasyeṣṭau gamāgamausatanustanuhīno vā sarvakṛtsarvagaḥ śivaḥtacca prāṇapathā kāryaṃ nāḍyā jyotiḥ svarūpayāyena sāmarthyataḥ śambhoḥ svasya svasvāmitā bhavetsannidheraparityāge yo'rcākālāvasānakaḥloke sukhātmakaṃ vastu gopanīyaṃ yathā tathāyathānalataraṇyādyāḥ samarthāḥ svasvadīptibhiḥastitvaṃ hṛdayaṃ tasya śiraścordhvaṃ śikhāsthitiḥnirasyati yayā śaktyā bhavamastraṃ tadasya hievaṃ ṣāṅguṇyamatroktaṃ jagatkartuḥ śivasya tuhṛcchiraścūlikāgātranetrahasteṣu vinyasetamṛtīkaraṇaṃ proktaṃ prabhoramṛtamudrayātanmahāmudrayā kuryānmodanadrāvaṇārthayāparamānandasandohadhavalīkṛtadiṅmukhamarghyaṃ mūrdhasu dātavyaṃ dūrvāpuṣpākṣataṃ tathāsvāhāntena hṛdā cārghyaṃ dūrvādyaṃ vauṣaḍantataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sragā?dibhiḥ kāmyavidhāvavaśyamsaṅgītañca samastametaduditaṃ śambhorvibhūtau satipañcopacārā ete syurdīpāntaṃ vā'pi sammatamkṛpāṇadarpaṇādau? vā maṇau vā pratibimbitebalyantaṃ śāntikaṃ proktaṃ pūjā hi trividhocyateprasthadvayaṃ tu tatkāle pāvayitvā nivedayetevamuktaprakāreṇa adhamādhamamācaretsāyaṃ prātaḥ samabhyarcya dīpāścatvāra eva hidīpāścatvāra eva syuḥ sāye tu dviguṇāstataḥmadhyamasyādhamañcaiva madhyāhne cāḍhakaṃ haviḥtrikālaṃ puṣpa laṅgena balidānaṃ nayed dvijaḥardhayāme tadardhaṃ ca caturviṃśatidīpakamvādyadhvanisamāyuktaṃ śaṅkhakāhalasaṃyutammadhyamasyottame caiva trikāleṣvāḍhakadvayamtrikālaṃ balidānaṃ syāttrikālaṃ homamācaretṣaḍvidhaṃ yatra kurvīta kālasaṃkhyā na vidyatedroṇārdhamarghayāme tu dīpāstvaṣṭaśataṃ bhavetvādyakānāṃ caturviṃśatsarvavādyasamanvitamrūpāyauvanasampannāritrakālaṃ nṛttamācaretuttamaṃ madhyamaṃ yatra trikāleṣu caturhaviḥdroṇaṃ śudvodanaṃ kuryāt pācayitvā pṛthak pṛthaktrikālaṃ balihomaṃ ca śītāridīpamucyatekālaṃ yāmadvayaṃ proktaṃ nṛttaṃ kuryāttrisandhiṣupāyasyā?dīnipikvāni pañcadroṇena vai pṛthaktrikālaṃ balihomaṃ ca pañcāśadvādyasaṃyutam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: nṛtaṃ kuryāttrisandhyāyāṃ kālo yāmayuto bhavetdroṇataṇḍulasiddhāni tadardhena tadardhataḥharvidadyādviśeṣeṇa ekakāle'thavā punaḥevaṃ navavidhe proktaṃ pratyekaṃ tu vidhīyatesaṃhitāmantrasaṃ?jataṃ sapuṣpaṃ dhūpitaṃ śubhampakvena? vāsitenā'tha śuddhagavyena sarpiṣāśubhena śālipiṣṭena haridrāsaṃyutena casugandhāmalakādyaistu snānaṃ tatra vidhīyatepauṣṭikairvā suracitai rājikālavaṇena tupayodadhighṛtakṣaudraśarkarādyaiḥ svaśaktitaḥkhaṇḍābhāvādikṣusāro madhvabhāve ghṛtaṃ bhavetnālikeraphalāmbhobhiranyairvā rasavadrasaiḥabhiṣekaṃ tataḥ kuryānna kuryācchūnyamastakamtena mūrdhnigataṃ puṣpaṃ tyaktvā'nyat tatra yojayetāvāhanārghyapādyeṣu snāne dhūpavilepanearghye vilepane snāne triṣu gandhaṃ prakalpayetkṣālane prokṣaṇe caiva vāri saptasu yojayetdvārapūjāvasāne tu snānānte ca nivedyakesthāpitaiḥ kalaśaiḥ paścādabhiṣekaṃ samācaretkusumaṃ pūrvavinyastaṃ tadastreṇāpanīya cajalairanuccaladbhiśca snāpayedīśamastakeadbhiruccalitābhistu taddravyāṇi na sevayetuddhṛtya nītvā devāgne yantrikopari vinyasetgandhaṃ puṣpaṃ ca dhūpaṃ ca dīpamarghyaṃ vidhāya cakūrvaṃ sapuṣpaṃ toyābhyāṃ śivamantramanusmaran
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: deveśīmapi tadvāme devasya viniveśayetpiṇḍikārūpiṇīṃ devīṃ snāpayettadanantaramgandhāmbunā'bhiṣekaṃ tu kṛtvā liṅgaṃ sapīṭhakamgandhadravyaiḥ samālipya śivaliṅgaṃ savedikamdatvāṣṭapuṣpaṃ devāya dadyānmantrahavistataḥśuddhābhiḥ puṣpamālābhiḥ patracchedairathārcayethemadūrvāṅkurairhemalakṣmīpuṣpairanekaśaḥtrisareṇottarīyeṇa kaṭisūtreṇa sādhakaḥanyairmakuṭapuṣpādyairgolakairhemanirmitaiḥmāṇikyamarkavāre syāccandravāre tu mauktikamsarvavāreṣu yogyāni bhūṣaṇānāṃ vidhirmataḥācāmānte ca mūrdhādau śirasyarghyaṃ pradāpayetupasnānasamāyuktaṃ dhūpaṃ vā vinivedayetgāpayenmantragānaṃ vā vīṇānādamathāpi vātadūrdhvaṃ gauḍabhāṣādyairgānaṃ dhūpāntamācaretsaṃskṛtādanapabhraṃśaṃ nānāsvarasamanvitamnānādeśaprasūtaṃ ca nartanaṃ parikalpya canirdhūmajvaladaṅgārapūrṇapātrodare bhṛśamsurūpāṃ dhīranirghoṣāṃ ghaṇṭāṃ vāmena pāṇinākapilāghṛtasaṃpūrṇaiḥ karpūrāgaruvartibhiḥtriśūladīpikābhiśca dīpamālābhireva cagodānaṃ tiladānaṃ ca svarṇadānaṃ tathaiva caprabhūtaiḥ snehasampūrṇairjvaladbhirdīpakaiḥ sthiraiḥyathāṅgaṃ bhamasnā''labhya tilakairvā tripuṇḍrakaiḥsakṛdāvamanaṃ datvā kartavyaṃ karma cottaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśānaṃ karṇikāyāṃ tu pūjayet?kusumādibhiḥvāmamuttarapatre tu sadyaṃ paścimapatrataḥbāhubhirdaśabhiścaiva śaśāṅkamakuṭaiḥ sahaagnīśarakṣovāyavyacaturdikṣu gataṃ yajethṛdayaṃ candravarṇābhaṃ śiro gorocanaprabhamādhūmraṃ kavacaṃ nyasyedastraṃ kapilavarṇakampañcavaktrayutāḥ sarve daśabāhvindubhūṣitāḥdviraṣṭavatsarākārāḥ surūpāḥ sthirayauvanāḥmūrdhādibhyo hṛdādibhyastvānetavyāḥ prabhorimegarbhāvaraṇamevaṃ tu pūjayedabhito haramaṅkārūḍhā prabhoḥ pūjyā ādiśaktirmanonmanīnāvakuṇṭhanameteṣāmamṛtīkaraṇaṃ vināsnapanaṃ dīpakḷptiśca na pṛthak cāṅgabhāvataḥananteśaśca sūkṣmaśca śivottamaikanetrakauete devāścaturvaktrā haravaddaśabāhavaḥkhaḍgakheṭadhanurbāṇakamaṇḍalvakṣasūtriṇaḥyugāntādityasaṃkāśāḥ saṃsṛṣṭau śivacoditāḥśivottamaṃ tu vāruṇyāmekanetraṃ tathottareśrīkaṇṭhāṃ caiva nairṛtyāṃ vāyavyāṃ tu śikhaṇḍinamsiṃhārūḍhāmbikā tryakṣā pītābhā darpaṇodvahāvaiyāghravasanastryakṣaḥ śūladaṇḍakuṭhārabhṛtnandinaṃ pūrvadigbhāge padmarāgasamaprabhamharitābhaṃ mahākālaṃ śūlahastaṃ trilocanamgaṇeśo vāmanākāro gajavaktraḥ svadantabhṛtsalaṅḍukakuṭhārākṣamālāhastastrilocanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vṛṣo vṛṣākṛtistryakṣaḥ kundendutuhinadyutiḥnirmāṃsavigraho bhṛṅgī śveto vāruṇadiggataḥśaktikhaḍgapatākābjaprāsakukkuṭadaṇḍabhṛtcaturbhujo dvibāhurvā bhavatyekānanaḥ śriyaivāyavyāṃ vidrumābhāsaḥ pūjanīyaḥ phalārthibhiḥdevī caiva tu caṇḍeśo mahākālo vṛṣastathādhyāyedetānanudvignaḥ padmarāgasamaprabhāndviradendrasamārūḍhaṃ pītavarṇaṃ tu vajriṇamjvālāmālāvṛtaṃ śaktidharamagnimajāsanamnairṛtyāṃ nirṛtiṃ nīlaṃ gadāhastaṃ narāsanamśabalaṃ dhvajahastañca mṛgasthamanile'nilamkapilaṃ śūlahastaṃ ca vṛṣārūḍhaṃ trilocanamviṣṇuṃ tvadhogataṃ kṛṣṇaṃ tārkṣyasthaṃ cakrapāṇinamūrdhvagaṃ saṃyajet prājñaḥ svasvanāmādikākṣaraiḥpūrvabhāge yajedvajraṃ pītavarṇaṃ ṣaḍaśrakamnirṛtau nīlakhaḍgaṃ tu śvetaṃ pāśaṃ tu vāruṇeaiśānyāṃ jvalitaṃ śūlaṃ cakramarkasamaprabhampañcāvaraṇapūjaivaṃ samāsātparikīrtitāathavā kevalairaṅgaiḥ kevalairbrahmabhistu vāhetibhiḥ sahitān lokapālānabhyarcayettu vāyajed gadādibhiścaivamantarāvaraṇakramātevamāvaraṇaṃ pūjya dadyānnaivedyamuttamamaṅgānāmapi sarveṣāṃ pṛthaṅnaivedyamardhataḥpūteṣvitarathaikasmin haviṣyaṃ mantrasaṃskṛtamyajanaṃ gandhapuṣpādyaiḥ pratyekaṃ pravidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tadante nityahomo vā praviśyābhyantaraṃ punaḥmukhavāsañca tāmbūlaṃ devayogyaṃ pradāpayetgeyanṛttajapastotraistadā tamabhinandayetdhyātvā tacchirasi nyasyet pavitraṃ karmapūrakampatanāttrāyate yasmāttasmādeva pavitrakamparamāntikamuccārya prāsādaṃ pūrvavannyasetprārthayitvā japaṃ kuryādakṣasūtreṇa buddhimāndṛṣṭādṛṣṭaphalāvāpterakṣasūtraṃ taducyatejapamālā prakartavyā saṃskṛtā śarvaśambaraiḥaṅguṣṭhatarjanīyogānmadhyamā siddhiriṣyatemūlāddaśāṃśo brahmāṅgajapaḥ kāryo'tra dhīmatāasaṃkhyātaṃ manobhrāntyā japaṃ kuryādvicakṣaṇaḥsādhakaḥ sādhyasidhyarthaṃ virāmāyetaro janaḥoṃ guhyātiguhyagoptā tvaṃ gṛhāṇāsmatkṛtaṃ japamyatkiñcitkarma he deva sadā sukṛtaduṣkṛtamśivo dātā śivo bhoktā śivaḥ sarvamidaṃ jagatnivedyaivaṃ svamātmānaṃ japaṃ pūjāṃ ca bhaktitaḥstutvā'nekavidhaiḥ stotraiḥ praṇipatya punaḥ punaḥpacanālayavahnyāśākuṇḍe vahnividhikramāttato liṅgaṃ samabhyarcya gandhapuṣpādibhiḥ kramātsaṃhāramudrayāstreṇa devānāvaraṇasthitānhṛnmantrānugataṃ mūlamuccārya karaṇojjhitamśivatattvavibhāgena cintayed hṛtsthitena caparigṛhītaliṅge tu sāpekṣaḥ prāk pradarśitaḥsarvatrāpyanapekṣastu pratyahaṃ tu vidhīyate
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tasmai samarpayetsarvaṃ nirmālyaṃ tatprakīrtitamaiśānyāṃ pīṭhakasthaṃ vā bāhye caṇḍagṛhe'thavānaivedyaṃ gandhapuṣpādyaṃ dravyaṃ yajjāyate cirātrajaḥ sthaṇḍilaliṅgasthaṃ śivabhuktojjhitaṃ hi yatvitānacchatramālyādi vastrabhūṣaṇavāhanamtasmādanyadapi dravyaṃ śivāya viniveditamvitānadāmasaṃsparśaḥ dhūpāmodo na dūṣyatenirapekṣaṃ visṛjyaiśaṃ liṅgaṃ saṃśodhya pūrvavatpavitraiḥ sakalīkṛtya gāyatryā paryupāsayetvedikāsahitaṃ liṅgaṃ kṣamasveti ca vai vadetprāsādagarbhamunmṛjya tribhirgomayagolakaiḥsnānapānīyadugdhādyaiḥ yadi sikto bhavettadāācamya prayato bhūtvā devadevaṃ praṇamya cacalaliṅge'pyayaṃ nyāyo vihito yajñamandirepāṇipādau ca prakṣālyāpyācamya vidhinā tataḥbhāskarodayamārabhya yāvadvai bhāskarodayaḥṣaṣṭyucchavāso bhavetprāṇaḥ ṣaṭprāṇo ghaṭikā bhavetaṣṭasandhyāsu yā pūjā sā bhaveduttamottamāyāmārdhakālasaṃvṛttā pūjā navavidhā bhavetsaṃdhyātikramaṇāddoṣo nyūnāyāṃ tu na doṣabhākghaṭikādvitayaṃ snāne ghaṭikaikārcane bhavetnityāgnikāryamardhaṃ ca nityotsave dvināḍikāevaṃ kālavidhiḥ prokto mahāsandhyātrayasya cayathāsambhavakāle tu yathāsambhavanāḍikāaruṇodayavelāyāṃ prāgeva praharārdhataḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tatkāle pūjayeddevaṃ sarvakāmārthasiddhayebhūribhirgandhakusumairgandhaiḥ parimalairapikhaṭvārūḍhāmumāṃ devīmalaṅkṛtya viśeṣataḥputrapautravivṛddhyarthaṃ pūjayecchaṅkaraṃ tataḥnṛpaterāyurārogyasiddhaye vijayāya capūjakaḥ sandhipūrve tu kuryātsnānādikaṃ vidhimyajanārthaṃ tu sambhārāḥ sambhriyantāṃ jalādayaḥsusvādu vāsitaṃ puṣpaiḥ navamṛtkumbhapūritamśrīkhaṇḍāgarupatrakaiśca kusumairāmodibhiḥ saṃyutāḥproktadravyagaṇeṣu labdhamiha yattadgrāhyamāḍhyetaraiḥbhārādinavabhārāntaṃ navaliṅge'dhamādhameaṣṭadroṇairathādbhirvā dviguṇaistriguṇaistu vāsnānodakapramāṇaṃ syādātmārthe hi yathecchayāsnapanārthāya kathitapramāṇena prakalpayetdevālaṅkārayogyena pramāṇena samanvitamkārpāsatantujaṃ vastramadhamaṃ parikīrtitammanoramaṃ tu suślakṣṇaṃ viśiṣṭaṃ vastramucyateākhudaṣṭāgnidagdhaṃ ca keśaviddhaṃ ca varjayetkuṅkumaṃ candanaṃ dūrvā sidhārthośīrakaṃ tathāsiddhārthośīrakaṃ dūrvāyuktaṃ madhyamamucyateelālavaṅgakarpūravarālaphalasaṃyutampalatrayaṃ ca karpūraṃ truṭī patraṃ dvijottamāḥāpaḥ kṣīrakuśāgrāṇi yavasiddhārthataṇḍulaiḥāpaḥ kṣīrakuśāgrāṇi taṇḍulāḥ sumanastilāḥtaṇḍulabrīhisidhārthatilodakamathāpi vā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: candanaṃ cāgaruñcaiva kuṅkumaṃ gandha ucyatekāśmīragandhakarpūracandanairvā prakalpayetuttamottamaliṅgādāvāpalādi palāvadhievaṃ pādyādivastūnāṃ pramāṇaṃ parikīrtitamśvetapadmaṃ ca punnāgaṃ śaṅkhapuṣpaṃ ca mallikādvikarṇi kuravaṃ jātī lakṣmīśca vakulaṃ tathāviṣakāsīsakusumaṃ bhadrā ca mahatī ca sāhālikā śatapatraṃ ca unmanttaṃ kuśapuṣpakamraktapadmaṃ palāśaṃ ca raktotpalaṃ ca pāṭalīvyāghrī ca raktamandāraḥ paṭṭikā vaijikā tathāśonakyaṃ karṇikāraṃ ca campakaṃ hemadhutturametāni pītapuṣpāṇi kṛṣṇe nīlotpalaṃ varamapāmārgaṃ kuśā dūrvāḥ pañcabilvāḥ śamī tathāekapatrāravindaṃ ca viṣṇukrāntistathaiva caevamādīni patrāṇi putravṛddhikarāṇi caarkapuṣpasahasrebhyo bakapuṣpaṃ viśiṣyatedhuttūrakasahasrebhyaḥ śamīpuṣpaṃ viśiṣyatekaravīrasamā jñeyā jātī vijayapāṭalīnāgacampakapunnāgā dhuttūrakasamāḥ smṛtāḥśirīṣasarjabandhūkakusumāni visarjayetvaibhītakāni patrāṇi kusumāni vivarjayetgandhavantyapavitrāṇi kusumāni vivarjayetkanakāni kadambāni rātrau deyāni śaṅkarepraharārdhe smṛtā jātī karavīramaharniśamsvayaṃ patitapuṣpāṇi tyajedupahatāni ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: alāme'pīha puṣpāṇāṃ patrāṇyapi nivedayetphalānāmapyalābhe tu tṛṇagulmauṣadhīrapipratyekamuktapuṣpāṇāṃ daśasauvarṇakaṃ phalamsraggranthiteṣu teṣveva dviguṇaṃ phalamaśnutedravyakrītaiḥ prasūnādyairarcayedanyathā na catriguṇaṃ candanaṃ proktamīṣatkarpūramiśritamekadvitricatuṣpañcanakhacandanapāyasaiḥśītāridhūpamevaṃ syānmadhunā ca pariplutammurāmāṃsisitāmiśraṃ dhūpaṃ dadyānmadhuplutammadhyamaṃ dhūpamākhyātamuśīrādi śivapriyamkevalaṃ cāgarurvāpi dhūpārthaṃ mahiṣākṣi vāśatādiḥ syuḥ sahasrāntā ayutaṃ lakṣasīmakāḥdīpāḥ syurekasaṃkhyāyāṃ rātrau taddviguṇaṃ bhavetevaṃ saṃkhyā pradīpādau saṃkhyaiṣā parikīrtitārājasaṃ tilatailena miśramājena sarpiṣātāmasastu bhaveddīpo māhiṣeṇa tu sarpiṣātāmasaścāpi paiśāco dīpo yogyetaraḥ smṛtaḥhomastadvidhisaṃsiddhadravyairbhūtabalistathātāṇḍavaṃ tāṇḍavādhyāye nṛttageyādilakṣaṇaiḥbhaktyā vittānusāreṇa naivedyaṃ tu prakalpayetanivedyaṃ na bhuñjīta bhagavantaṃ sadāśivamvardhate tasya taddhānyaṃ phalapuṣpādayastathāalpe mahati vā tulyaṃ phalamāḍhyadaridrayoḥdatvā śivasya naivedyaṃ kalyāṇaṃ kārayedbudhaḥkalyāṇaṃ devakalyāṇe kṛtaṃ cāpi vinaśyati
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kalyāṇaṃ varjayeddhīmān cūḍodvāhādikaṃ svakambrīhiṇāmavaśiṣṭānāṃ taṇḍulantvadhamaṃ bhavetitare brīhayaḥ proktāḥ phalaṃ teṣāṃ pṛthak pṛthaksitaśālyatiraktā ca saugandhiścottamā matākustumbaraśca nīvāro madhyamāśceti kīrtitāḥtathā vai sūkarīvrīhirhrasvavaktrī ca kanyasāyāvantastaṇḍulāstatra naivedyaparikalpaneviśopya sūryakiraṇairvrīhyādīṃśchuddhabhūtalemusalaṃ hṛdayenaiva hanyātsaṃgṛhya sādhakaḥcāturvarṇodbhavastrībhiḥ puruṣairvā'tha ghātayetdviśataiḥ pañcaviṃśatyā vrīhibhiḥ pūritaṃ tu yatśuktistalaṃ prakūrcañca prasṛtiḥ kuḍupaṃ tathādroṇaṃ khārī kramātproktaṃ mānamevaṃ prakīrtitamdharaṇāṣṭau palañcaiva palaṃ muṣṭirihocyatebhāraṃ khāritrayaṃ proktaṃ mānamevaṃ prakīrtitamaṣṭāṅgeṣu caturvahnikarendudroṇanirmitamtaṇḍulairāḍhakāddhīnairnaivedyaṃ na prakalpayetprasthaṃ kuḍupasayuktaṃ paiśācāśanamucyateāḍhakadvayamārabhya tadvṛddhyā navasaṃkhyayāyāvat prārthitamānaṃ tu tāvatkāmyahavirbhavetśreṣṭhamadhyādhamāstadvadvidhinā'dya vidhīyatenavamṛdbhāṇḍakaṃ vā'pi pratisandhyaṃ prakalpayetśuklavastradharāścaiva śuklayajñopavītinaḥvastrapūtaiśca toyaiśca jaladroṇīṃ prapūrayetjalenaiva tu ṣaṭkṛtvaḥ niṣpīḍya ca muhurmu?huḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: jñātvā tu yuktitaḥ samyak adhyardhaṃ jalameva vāpalipte gomayādyaistu prokṣite'tra mahānaseuddhṛtya vāmadevena ropayeddhṛdayena tupipīlikādisañjuṣṭaḥ koṭarakrimisaṃ?yutaiḥdhūmagandhamatiklinnamatipakvañca śītalamevamuktaṃ tu śuddhānnaṃ pāyasaṃ tvadhunocyatealāme'rdhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā śeṣaṃ toyaiḥ prapūrayetpāyasaṃ pūrvavat kṛtvā caturbhāgaṃ gulaṃ kṣipetkadalīphalasaṃyuktaṃ gulānnamiti kīrtitamalābhe'rdhaṃ tadardhaṃ vā mudgānnamadhunocyateeteṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ yathālābhamathāpi vāāloḍya pācitaṃ hyetat haridrānnaṃ prakīrtitammudgamāṣakulutthāṃśca śimbā niṣpāvameva cakuśmāṇḍaṃ panasālābu kāliṅgaṃ bṛhatīdvayamkadalī kāravī vyāghrī āmramurvārukaṃ tathāekaikamupadaṃśānāṃ prasthasyaikapalaṃ bhavetghṛṣṭaṃ ghṛtena saṃyuktaṃ nālikeraphalādibhiḥlavaṇājyayutāni syurupadaṃśāni tāni hiviṃśatpalaṃ syāllavaṇaṃ prasthaṃ prasthaṃ samīritamsarpiṣo dviguṇaṃ mānaṃ marīcāttu praśasyatemudgabhinnaṃ samaṃ proktamadhikaṃ guṇameva vāsiddhārthakalkayuktāni rasavanti ca pācayetkulutthadhānyacūrṇaṃ ca marīcaṃ peṣitaṃ kramātgulena saha saṃyojya rasavanti phalāni cavividhāni ca pūpāni yogyadravyaiḥ kṛtāni ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: naivedyamupadaṃśādyaṃ susiddhamavatārayettaptābhighāramājyena pavitraiḥ parikalpayetpātrāṇi śodhayettoyairstripuṇḍaṃ parikalpayetśaṅkhadhvanisamāyuktaṃ chatradīpādisaṃyutampātraṇyuddhṛtya sarvāṇi vinyasenmukhamaṇḍapekaraṇādhyāyasaṃsiddhalakṣaṇairlakṣiteṣu canyasteṣu śuddhavastrordhve darvyā lakṣaṇayuktayāupadaṃśāni sarvāṇi naivedyopari vinyasetbālacūtaphalañcāpi dadhyādikamaninditamtripādyupari vinyasya sthalikādigataṃ haviḥamṛtīkṛtya gostanyā naivedye kusumaṃ nyasetantarāvṛtisaṃsthānāṃ devānāṃ tu pṛthak pṛthaktadadhastvagnikāryārthamadhastādbalikarmaṇeagnikāryāvaśiṣṭaṃ ca baliśiṣṭaṃ ca yaddhaviḥnaivedyaṃ tu pradātavyaṃ manasā tadasambhaveabhāve validānaṃ syāddvārādhyakṣapuraḥ saramrudrebhyaḥ pūrvato dadyānmātṛbhyo dakṣiṇe tathāgrahebhyaśca tathaiśānyāmasurebhyo'gnigocarenakṣatrarāśivargebhyastathā viśvagaṇāya cavāyuvāruṇadigbhāge kṣetrapālabaliṃ kṣipetprathamaṃ dvārapālānāṃ bhūtānāṃ syād dvitīyakamaṣṭa dviṣaṭ dviraṣṭau hi dvātriṃśatparicārakāḥgaṇeśaṃ tatra saṃpūjya sopacāraṃ viśeṣataḥtataḥ pūrvasthite pīṭhe baliṃ dadyādviśeṣataḥpitṛdānavanāgāśca brahmādyaiśānamantakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svāhāntaṃ balinirdeśaṃ sarvebhya iti yojayetsarvadigdvārasampanne tridvyekāśāvakāśaketato garbhagṛhaṃ gatvā dadyādācamanīyakamyena nirmalatāṃ yāti nirmālyamiti kīrtyateagādhe'mbhasi vā'gnau vā gavāṃ vā'pi nivedayetagnikāryaṃ tataḥ kuryātkuṇḍasaṃskārapūrvakamkuṇḍaṃ vā sthaṇḍilaṃ vā'pi vahnerāyatanaṃ dvidhātenaiva sādhayet sūtraṃ dakṣiṇottaragaṃ kramātcaturaśraṃ bhavet kuṇḍaṃ vṛttaṃ vā hastanirmitamiṣṭakābhiḥ supakvābhirapakvābhirasambhavemantrāṇāṃ vāruṇānāṃ ca kumbhākāraṃ vidhīyatesaptajihvākṛti proktamāgneyānāṃ gurūttamaiḥtrikoṇamalpavīryāṇāṃ strīrūpāṇāṃ bhagākṛtiḥpañcakoṇaṃ tu mūrtīnāṃ kinnarāṇāṃ tathaiva caaindryāṃ stambhe catuṣkoṇamagnau tāpe bhagākṛtiḥvāruṇyāṃ śāntike vṛttaṃ ṣaḍaśroccāṭane'naleśatārdhaśatahāme tu vistāraṃ dviguṇaṃ kramātbhavellakṣayute home caturhastaṃ ca ṣaṭkaramhastamātraṃ bhavetkuṇḍaṃ liṅge kanyasake nyasetpañcamāṃśaṃ puro nyastvā koṇavedāṃśamānataḥcaturaśre gṛhe bhakteṃ tyaktvā'dyante tadaṃśakeiṣṭadikṣu nyasetpaścāduttare sūtrapātanamkaṇṭhārdhāṣṭāṃśasantyāgāt vṛttakuṇḍamihoditamcaturaśre'ṣṭabhāge tu karṇikā syāddvibhāgataḥtṛtīye dalamadhyāni turīye dalakoṭayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vṛttakuṇḍasamaṃ cānyadathavānyaprakārataḥutsedhaṃ ca tathā kṛtvā karṇikā sārdhato bhavetkṣetrārdhadaśamaṃ bhāgaṃ catudikṣu taduttaretasya karṇapramāṇena tadbhujāṃścāpi lāñchayetvistārasadṛśaḥ khāto mekhalāśeṣa eva vākaṇṭhamānamidaṃ proktaṃ mekhalāṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥmekhalādvitayaṃ kāryamaṅgulārdhāṅgulakramātanyanemidvayaṃ tasya tṛtīyārdhāṅgulā matākartavyā mekhalā cānyā tridvyaṅgulakramāttathāanyāṅgulacatuṣkā syāttṛtīyā tvaṅgulaistribhiḥṣaḍbhiranyāṅgulaiḥ kāryā caturbhiraparāṅgulaiḥaṅgulairaṣṭabhiścānyā tṛtīyā ṣaḍbhiraṅgulaiḥdaśāṅgulā dvitīyā tu tṛtīyāṣṭāṅgulā matāathavānyaprakāreṇa mekhalāmānamucyatetadekabhāgamātraṃ syāttena dvitricaturguṇaiḥṣaḍaṅgulaviśāloccā mekhalaikā bhavedyadimekhalāmadhyagā yonirdvyaṅgulocchrāyasaṃyutādvihastādiṣu kuṇḍeṣu vistāre dvyaṅgulādhikāsā yoniḥ sarvakuṇḍānāṃ svārdhamānena nirmitāpraṇālena samāyuktā kuṇḍamānayutena tunābhiḥ syātkuṇḍamadhye tu svārdhamānena nirmitāekāśītipadā vedī maṇḍapena bahirbhavetcaturdhā vedikāṃ kṛtvā vedikā kuṇḍamadhyamepradhānavāyusomeśakuṇḍeṣu prāṅmukho yathāvaidikaṃ miśrakaṃ śaivamagnikāryaṃ tridhā smṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mantraiśca vaidikaiḥ śaivairvihito miśra ucyateutpādane kramastvevaṃ vihitaḥ śivaśāsanevaidikāgniḥ samuddiṣṭo miśrāgnistūbhayātmakaḥpraṇītā brahmakūrcena saṃyukto vaidikaḥ smṛtaḥmiśravaidikayoragnyoḥ svarūpaṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥṣaḍakṣo mekhalāyuktaḥ pādatrayasamānvitaḥupavītī ca mauñjīvān saptahastasamāyutaḥhiraṇyā kanakā raktā kṛṣṇā jihvā ca dakṣiṇeevaṃ jihvāḥ samuddiṣṭā miśrāgnauvaidikānaleraktā cottarajihvā syāt kṛṣṇā yāmyāṃ diśi sthitābahurūpaiśajihvā syājjihvāsthānaṃ prakīrtitampañcavaktrayutaṃ rakaṃ saptajihvāvirājitamraktavastraparīdhānaṃ paṅkajopari saṃsthitamkanakā bahurūpā cāpyatiraktā tataḥ paramūrdhvavaktre sthitāstisraḥ śeṣāḥ prāgāditaḥ sthitāḥvaidiko'pi tridhā gārhapatyaḥ syāddakṣiṇo'nalaḥkārayeddeśiko dhīmān śaivamiśrānalodbhavemiśraṃ vā sādhayettatra niyamo'pi vidhīyatedaivastvāhavanīyastu cānyeṣāmapi śaṃsitaḥpratiṣṭhārthaṃ śivāgnestu sampadarthaṃ samāharetnityāgnau yojayed vṛddhamanyatrāpi ca yojayetśivāgnyutpādahomastu śreṣṭhaḥ saṃparikīrtitaḥvaidike kevalāgnau vā śivamantrānna yojayettathaiva miśravahnistu vaidikāgnistu kathyatevyāso bodhāyanaścāpastambaścaivāśvalāyanaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śāstrāṇyanyāni śrotāraḥ purāṇaṃ ca smṛti tathātanmata?na kṛto yo'gniḥ vaidikaḥ paripaṭhyateadhikāriṇa ityuktā dīkṣitāḥ sarvayogyakāḥkuṇḍasaṃskārapūrvaṃ tu śaivāgniṃ sādhayettataḥathavā vaidike home virvṛtte tadanantaramnābhisthe'gnāvapānena viśrāmyodānavṛttinānityāgni veśayed bhūyaḥ śivāgnimapi kuṇḍakevihite'ntyeṣṭikarmādau ubhayoḥ saṅkarārthakamvaidikāgnyavasāne tu śaivaṃ sampādya vānalamevamantyeṣṭikarmādau sāṅkaryaṃ sammataṃ tvihaśaivāgni saṃpravakṣyāmi kuṇḍalakṣaṇapūrvakamsarvakāmapradaṃ nitye hastamātravinirmitamgajoṣṭhasadṛśā yonirmadhye syād dvādaśāṅgulāsthapiḍale tadabhāve vā saṃskṛte'gni niveśayetaniṣ?panne śivāgnau tu hutaṃ bhavati niṣphalamvarmaṇābhyukṣaṇaṃ kāryaṃ tāḍanaṃ cāstramantrataḥkuṭṭanaṃ ca tataḥ kuryātsammārjanamataḥ paramkuṇḍārcanaṃ ca paridhiviṣṭaranyāsa eva caetatsarvaṃ tu matimān astramantreṇa kārayettadvadvāgīśvaraṃ cāpi yadvākāśatanuṃ śivamkalpaṃ manthānusampātaṃ samidhaścaitayostataḥsūryakāntāt dvijāvāsātprasūtamathavā'nalamayaskāntādito'kalpamathavānīya kalpavitkravyādāṃśaṃ parityajya prokṣayedastravāriṇāvahnibījaṃ ṣaḍaṅgaiśca vahneḥ saṃyojanaṃ nayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: amṛtīkṛtya saṃpūjya kuṇḍasyaiva pradakṣiṇamvāgīśīgarbhanāḍyāṃ tu svātmanaḥ sammukhaṃ yathātoyabinduṃ tato datvā chādayettu sadindhanaiḥdevīhaste hṛdā badhvā garbhādhānanimittakamtilairdatvā puṃsavananimittaṃ vāmamarcayetaghoreṇa samabhyarcya śikhayaivāhutitrayamniṣkṛtiṃ ca tadā kṛtvā jātakarma tato nayettilenaiva tadā kuryātsūtakasya nivṛttayedarbhānāstīrya kuṇḍasya samantādastramantrataḥāhutitritayenātha vaktrāṇāṃ puṣṭayepi vācaturviṃśatisaṃkhyākān ṣoḍaśāṅguladairghyakānśivāgnistvamiti brūyāt mūlamantrapuraḥ saramindrādīn lokapālāṃśca pūjayetparidhiṣvapiviṣṇumīśvaramabhyarcya prāgādicatasṛṣvapiavakuṇṭhya pratāpyāgnau vā bhrāmya ca tadagrataḥpunarābhrāmya mūlena mūlaṃ saṃspṛśya taddvayoḥsruve śambhuṃ samabhyarcya svātmano dakṣiṇe nyasetājyamastreṇa saṃprokṣya kavacenāvakuṇṭhya cakuṇḍasyaivopariṣṭāttu triḥ pradakṣiṇamānayetprādeśikapavitrañcāṅguṣṭhānāmikamadhyamamtadvatsaṃplavanaṃ kṛtvā hṛdayenātmasammukhamnirīkṣyājyaṃ tato dhīmānnīrājanamathācaretamṛtīkṛtya mūlena dhenumudrāyutena caoṃkāreṇātra vinyasya nāḍīnāṃ kalpayettrayamagnaye vāmataḥ somāyeti mantreṇa homayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: caturthīmagnaye sviṣṭakṛte svāhā'hutiñcaretayaṃ vibhāgaḥ śukle syātkṛṣṇe sūryāhutiṃ caretsvaiḥ svairmantraiḥ samopetaṃ sadyaṃ vāmena yojayettaṃ ceśāne tu saṃyojyaṃ taṃ śivenaiva yojayetsvasvamantrasamopetaṃ sadyojātādito nayetannaprāśanacūḍādisaṃskārāṇāṃ prasiddhayevauṣaḍantena mūlena sruksruvābhyāṃ viśeṣataḥgrāhayettu pṛthagbhāgaṃ vahnimuddhṛtya yatnataḥanāhute śive vahnau homastvāvāhite śivetasmāt tvadīyahṛtpadme sthāpya santarpayāmyahamvinyasya kalpayenmūrtiṃ bhāsvarāṃ suvarāṃ parāmpūjayitvā bahistasyā bhogāṅgāni prakalpayetprarocya paramīkṛtya śivavaktrāgnivaktrayoḥyāgasthāne śivenaikībhūtaṃ samyagvicintayetśivāddaśāṃśato'ṅgāni tarpayettu dvijottamāḥātmārthe vā parārthe vā pratyahaṃ homamācaretājyābhāvāttilairhomaḥ kartavyaḥ kṛṣṇavarcasaiḥtriphalairbilvapatrairvā puṣpairvā yājñikaiḥ śubhaiḥmṛgīṃ vārāhamudrāṃ vā śaṅkhinīṃ vā vidhāya casusnehamadhudugdhānāmāhutiḥ syātsravātmikāparyāyātsarvabhakṣyāṇi pañcāgrāṅgulibhistilānhastapiṇḍamitaṃ śākaṃ svāṣṭāṃśaṃ kandajātayaḥtrikhaṇḍāni tu mūlāni dvyaṅgulā vallijātayaḥhaviṣyānnaṃ tataścānte tāmbūlaṃ vinivedayetpūjayitvārpayitvā ca prarocya ca visarjayet
