sanskrit: rodhayitvā tu tatraiva rakṣayetprativāsaramsaṃpūjya tatra deveśamavisṛjyāṅgamālabhetyadvā visarjayetkuṇḍe vahnimanyatra rakṣayetjapedvā juhuyādvātha bahurūpaṃ praśāntayesaṃskṛte phalake vātha gandhapuṣpādisaṃskṛtegaṇebhyaḥ paścime bhāge yakṣebhyaścottare balimpālāśyāṃ palabhakṣebhyo nāgebhyo vāyugocaremaṇḍalābhyantare deyā balistebhyaḥ prakāmataḥātmārthe'pyevamādiṣṭaṃ gṛhādau devasadmaniagnikāryabaliñcānte evameva samācarettato liṅgāntikaṃ gatvā pratarpyānantarakriyāmnityotsavaṃ tataḥ kuryācchuddhākhyaṃ nṛttamantimeutsavaṃ śuddhanṛttaṃ ca gṛhāgre na samācaretgandhaiḥ puṣpaiśca saṃpūjya datvārghyaṃ ca parāṅmukhamsaṃhāriṇaṃ śivaṃ dhyātvā mūrtau mūrtyā niyojayetprāsādaṃ kāraṇatyāgādyāvanniṣkalatāṃ gatamhṛtsaroje sthitenaikyaṃ kalpayenmudrayā tayābindvādyaṃ nādaparyantamante caṇḍeśvaraṃ yajetpratimānāṃ ca sarvāsāmante ca sthaṇḍile nahidevāya dattaṃ yaddravyaṃ caṇḍeśāyeti kalpitamnirmālyalaṅghanaṃ dānaṃ bhakṣaṇaṃ ca vivarjayetpārvatīyakṣamātṝṇāṃ na nirmālyaṃ śive yathāguruṣvapi na nirmālyaṃ vyākhyāsu pratimāsu canaivedyaṃ bhrātṛputrāṇāṃ bhaginīnāṃ ca dāpayetsnāyātprakṣālayedvātha nābherūrdhvamadhastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: cyutaskhalitaśudvyarthamabhyasenmantrasaṃhitāmmāghamāsaṃ vinā śastaṃ bhānorayanamuttaramśrāvaṇaśca vidhīyante tadanye ninditā matāḥśukle vādyatṛtīyāṃśaṃ kṛṣṇe cāntyaṃ tu vā tyajetnavamīṃ pañcadaśyau ca hitvā yugmetaraṃ tithimkṛṣṇe ṣaṣṭiṃ ca yāḥ śiṣṭāstāḥ sarvāninditāstvihaanūrādhāśvayuk saumyaṃ vaiṣṇavaṃ vāruṇaṃ maghāpūjyāḥ śatabhiṣak caiva viśākhā pūrvajaiḥ sahamānuṣe pauṣyapauṣṇāśca tadanye ninditāstvihamanuṣyairapi vāraṃ ca varjayettu sitāparamśubhakarma na kartavyaṃ jīve cāstaṃ gate budhaiḥdivā garbhapratiṣṭhā ca śarvaryāṃ vāstukarma carātrau vāstubaliṃ grāme nāgnau kuryātkathañcanavivarjyaścararāśistu sajīvaścecchubhapradaḥgurūdayastu viprāṇāṃ bhūpatīnāṃ bhṛgūdayaḥtriṣaḍekādaśasthāne pāpāstu niśi śobhanāḥcaturaśre śubhāḥ pāpā varjanīyā viśeṣataḥvarjayeddeśiko dhīmān pañcagocarasaṃsthitaḥyuktaṃ ca kāṅkṣitañcoḍuṃ santyajeddeśikottamaḥviṣkambhaṃ parighaṃ caiva gaṇḍaṃ vaidhṛtiharṣaṇemāsaśūnyaṃ grahairbhinnaṃ dagdhavāraṃ tathaiva catithinakṣatramāsābdāyanāntaṃ ca varjayetyajamānānukūlarkṣe svalpadoṣe guṇādhikekārayedvāstukarmaitatsarvasampatsamṛddhayenimittaśakunānādau jñātvā karma samācaret
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śuciḥ śuklāmbaro bhūtvā bhūṣaṇaiḥ samalaṅkṛtaḥnimittān śakunānetān paśyeddhyātvā sadāśivambhūṣitā vā suputrā vā harṣitā ca viśeṣataḥbhakṣyaṃ bhojyaṃ ca pānaṃ ca māṃsaṃ dīpaṃ tathaiva caśrīvatsaṃ pūrṇakumbhaṃ ca śaṅkhaṃ gorocanaṃ tathāyānyanyāni praśastāni śubhaṃ teṣāṃ tu darśanamkokilaṃ vāmataḥ śastaṃ prasthāne sarvakarmaṇiharmyaprāsādamāṅgalyamanojñasthānasaṃśritāḥna grāme'raṇyagaurgrāhyo nāraṇye grāmasaṃsthitaḥdvandvagau cārthitau grāhyau kākolastviṣṭakāṅkṣiṇaḥkṣutaṃ sarvatra neṣṭaṃ syādgokṣutaṃ maraṇaṃ diśetniyaterindhanānāṃ ca darśanaṃ śokadaṃ bhṛśammalinābhaktanagnāderdarśanaṃ duḥkhadaṃ bhavetvarāhamahiṣoṣṭrāderdarśanaṃ ca tathā bhavetekadhā dvitridhā kṛtvā nimittatrayadoṣakṛtśaivaṃ brāhmaṃ tathā vāstu vaiṣṇavañcaindrameva carākṣasaṃ caiva vāyavyaṃ vāruṇāgneyakau tathākarṇikārārjunāaśvatthakapitthāśokaghātakīviṣṇukrāntākhukarṇābhyāṃ śālmalī giriśāribābilvaiḥ palāśairdarbhaiśca kuśaiśca hariṇaistathātindukaistintriṇībhiśca karajairveṇubhistathāniṣkaṇṭakaistathā vṛkṣairyā bhūmiḥ sahitā bhavetkadalīpanasāmraiśca punnāgairvakulaistathāindīvaraiśca vaiśyaiśca śūdrairaindrī mahī matāaṅkolaiśca tathā vṛkṣairmārjālairnakulaistathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śauryavīryakarī sā syātprajāsampatsamṛddhidāmallikākaravīraiśca madhūkairbhautikī matābhallātakairmahāvṛkṣairduṣṭasattvaiḥ palāṇḍubhiḥāsurī yuddhadā bhūmiḥ pūtigandhasamanvitāśleṣmātakaiḥ kharairuṣṭraiḥ sṛgālaiḥ sūkaraiḥ punaḥpaiśācī ca smṛtā śāstraiḥ sarvanāśasamanvitāmarīcagulagandhāḍhyā rākṣasī sā kṣayapradāyā vāyavyeti sā proktā duḥkhanairdhanyadāyikāsnuhiśleṣmātakādyaiśca saṃyuktā kṣudraśarkaraiḥśaive śaivī samākhyātā vaiṣṇavī viṣṇudeśakeśaivī vipraviṣiṣṭā ca brāhmī syādvaiṣṇavī ca bhūḥpaiśācī tvāsurī bhūmī rākṣasī yā ca bhūrmatāsā ca gobhiściraṃ bhittvā bhūrgrāhyā vatsarordhvataḥanūpā jāṅgalā ceti vāstuyogyā dvidhā dharāyuktamalpīyasātyantaṃ khāte'gādhe'pi jāṅgalamsūkṣmavālukamānūpaṃ kṛṣikṛtyuccalajjalamjāṅgalaṃ kadalītālapanasāditarūdbhavamsarvartusukhadaṃ sarvahitamānūpamiṣyatepadmakaṃ bhadrakaṃ dhūmraṃ pūrṇañceti caturvidhamkarodāñjalimātrodyadudakaṃ vāstu padmakamsaumyaṃ sārataraṃ tattu prāgudagvīraṇānvitampūrṇakaṃ dhūmrakaṃ nityamanilānaladikplavamdaśadaṇḍapramāṇaṃ tu ṣaṇmātrāvanataṃ tu yattanmandamadhyatvaritajalāvahasamanvitamcaturaśraṃ samaṃ yattu devanāñca dvijanmanām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śūdrasyāpi yathāsaṃkhyaṃ kalpayeddeśikottamaḥśvetaṃ raktaṃ ca pītañca kṛṣṇaṃ viprāditaḥ kramātpunnāgajātipuṣpābjadhānyapāṭalagandhakaiḥekavarṇaṃ ghanaṃ snigdhaṃ sukhasaṃsparśanānvitamtiktaṃ ca kaṭukaṃ caiva kaṣāyamadhurāmlakampradakṣiṇodakopetaṃ karamātroccalajjalamsuṣirāsthivihīnaṃ tu tanuvālukasaṃyutampaṅkaśeṣojjhitaṃ śvabhradarīloṣṭavivarjitamduṣṭaprāṇisamīpasthaṃ nṛpamandirasaṃśritamcaṇḍālavāstukaṃ caiva karmakārālayāśritamśaṅkarārāmasaṃyuktaṃ tasya kṣetraṃ tu varjayetyatkarma vihitaṃ mohādevaṃbhūte tu vāstunihīnajāteḥ samuddiṣṭamutkṛṣṭānāṃ vidhīyatemiśravarṇayutaṃ vāstu śreṣṭhaṃ tadvarṇajanmanāmadhikanyūnatulyeṣu pāṃsuṣvetādṛśaṃ phalamsapuṣpakumbhatoyena pūryamāṇe'vaṭe yadiuttānapuṣpakaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ na tvadhomukhapuṣpakamtrirātreṇa prajāyante yasyāṃ sā syācchubhā mahīsāpi grāhyā gṛhādau tu sā colbaṇaguṇānvitāevaṃ parīkṣya gṛhṇīyānmahīṃ bahuguṇānvitāmanyeṣāmapi sarveṣāṃ praveśabalirucyateādiśaivakulodbhūtaḥ pañcagocarasaṃsthitaḥsitānulepanāḍhyaśca praveśabalimārabhetnavabhāgāṃ dharāṃ kṛtvā brahmasthānāditaḥ kramātime bhūmau vasanto'tra bhūtapaiśācarākṣasāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dadhyājyāpūpasaṃyuktairannaisteṣāṃ bali kṣipetācāryaṃ pūjayetpūrvaṃ sarvān sampūjayettataḥvasāno nūtanaṃ vastramuttarīyasamanvitaḥsitacandanaliptāṅgaṃ cūtāśvatthadalānvitamsadvastravadanaṃ kumbhaṃ sitasūtravibhūṣitampūjayitvā vidhānena gandhapuṣpākṣatairguruḥvedātodyakulastrīṇāṃ praśastadhvanibhistathādhyāyan prajāhitaṃ kṣipraṃ pariṣiñcetpradakṣiṇamtasmādagneḥ palāśasya pavaneśānayostathāācāryādīnathābhyarcya kartā dadyācca dakṣiṇāmgrāmāṅgabhūtadevādau pṛthaṅneṣṭo vicakṣaṇaiḥsarvaṃ svatantrataḥ kuryācchraddhāvittānusārataḥhastamānāvaṭaṃ khātvā bhūmimadhye śubhe dinedarbhāstarāntike tasya payaḥ pītvā guruḥ svapetuttamaṃ vīryamāsthāya namaste'stu śivā bhavasāvaśeṣaṃ jalaṃ dṛṣṭvā tad grāhyaṃ sarvasaṃpadeahni vā pūraṇaṃ kṛtvā parīkṣāṃ tu samācaretanyūnaṃ cejjalaṃ tatsthamuttamā bhūḥ praśasyatetato hīnaṃ tu hīnā syādatihīnā vipatkarīsarveṣāmapi vāstūnāṃ sā tu sādharaṇī matāsuśvetau vṛṣabhau dāntau yuvānau balasaṃyutaukakudaṃ ca tathā vālakhuraśṛṅgāṇi bhūṣayetuktalakṣaṇavarṇāḍhyaṃ gṛhītvā govṛṣadvayamtasyopakaraṇaṃ dravyaṃ khādiraṃ devaviprayoḥnimbaśca vakulaścāpi gavākṣī kaṭphalastathā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: halaśca lāṅgalo muṣṭiryugamasya prakīrtitaḥdvivitastiṣaḍaṅgulyaṃ lāṅgaleṣu prapaṭhyateagre tu caturaṅgulyaṃ lāṅgaleṣu praśasyateghanadviguṇavistārā patākā dhvajayaṣṭivatmadhye trisaptamātreṇa nābhervṛttānibho yugaḥśamyaḥ śamyāntaraḥ samyak vitastiriha kathyateśamyāntaraḥ samaṃ śamyālambanaṃ syādyugādayaḥhiraṇmayaṃ pāṃsugarbhaṃ devānāṃ pravidhīyateyadvā halādikaṃ yattu tadardhe vasubhājitenyūnaṃ vāpyadhikaṃ vāpi kārayetkarturicchayānalikerakṛtā vāpi rajjuḥ sarvatra śaṃśitāhalādayaḥ surādīnāṃ sarve sarvatra vā matāḥkṛtamantratanurbhūtvā soṣṇīṣaracottarīyakaḥvṛṣaṃ tryambakamantreṇa halaṃ cāstreṇa pūjayetātmānamiva taṃ dhyātvā preṣayetkṛṣikarmaṇidvātriṃśadvāramityuktaṃ devāgrajamahībhṛtāmsarveṣāṃ saptavāraṃ vā pañcavāramathāpi vāevaṃ kṛṣṭvā samīkṛtya saṇmātrāvartitaṃ kramātpayasā kṣālayitvā tu vapennetramanusmaransarvopakaraṇopetaṃ dadyāttasmai ca govṛsauśayanaṃ duṣkṛtañcānyat prajānāṃ sarvadoṣadamprāyaścittaṃ tadā kuryācchāntihomaṃ śivadvijaḥtatrasthānāṃ ca sasyānāṃ vardhitānāṃ ca karṣaṇāttrirātraṃ pañcarātraṃ vā saptarātraṃ tu vāsayetkhurasaṃghaṭṭanāghrāṇaparibhramaṇagoṣpadaiḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pavitrīkṛtabhūmadhye grāmādyaṃ parigṛhyatāmgṛhagrāmādikartaṇāṃ śivadīkṣānvitātmanāmśaṅkusaṃsthāpanaṃ vakṣye grāmādīnāṃ śubhāvahamanyatra sthāpitaḥ śaṅkurgrāmādyaṃ nāśayiṣyatiśaṅkvarthaṃ maṇḍalaṃ kuryāddevānāṃ ca sanātanamnirdaraṃ nirjaraṃ snigdhaṃ suspṛśyaṃ susamaṃ śubhamdvijādīnāṃ yathāsaṃkhyaṃ yojanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥkhātayettān bahūn samyak samān samatarāntarāndadhyājyakṣīrasammiśraṃ savalmīkamṛdā dṛḍhamajarjaramanīcoccaṃ susnigdhaṃ darpaṇopamamkhādirastiniśo rājñāṃ vaṇijāṃ śākakhādiraukṣīravṛkṣaśamīsālāḥ sarve yogyāḥ samīritāḥagre tvekāṅgulo vāstu sarvavarṇeṣu yogyakaḥagre tryaṅgulavistāraḥ śaṅkurvā sarvavāstuṣuekāṅgulakṣayādāyo mūlanāho vidhīyatedevādīnāṃ śiro'graṃ syāddvijānāṃ chatrasannibhamkadalīmukulāgraṃ syācchūdrāṇāṃ maṇḍalāgrakamāsanaṃ vākulaṃ rājñāṃ taindukaṃ cāpi khādiramyojayeddeśiko dhīmān khyātaśaṅkau purātanemadhyādyantasthitaiḥ kīlairmaṇḍalairnavabhiryutaiḥgrāmakedāraśaile syātsūcirekāṅgulāyatāpañcagavyena saṃśodhya bhūyaḥ śuddhodakena vāgandhādibhiḥ samabhyarcya vāstuvṛddhimanusmaranśaṅkusthānottaragate kriyāmenāṃ samācaretkṛtakautukabandhastu sthaṇḍilasthaṃ samarcayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tataḥ prabhāte vimale suvāre tu śubhe dinedigdevatāśca saṃpūjya gandhādyaiśca svanāmabhiḥsaṃprāptadakṣiṇairvipraiḥ śilpinā ca samanvitaḥindrādīn paritaśceṣṭvā śaṅkusthāpanamārabhetvṛttaṃ saṃbhrāmya tanmadhye sthāpayettaminodayetadbindudvayagaṃ sūtraṃ pūrvāparadigiṣyatebindudvayāntaraṃ bhrāntaḥ śambarānanapucchakamdhruvavedhena vodīcīṃ prācīṃ vā dhruvatārayāmitakṣetrārdhamānena caturaśraṃ tu sādhayetjalena talasāmyaṃ syānmadhyame vātha karṇikeprācītaraṃ tu yatsthānaṃ sarvadoṣakaraṃ bhavetparamāṇukramādvṛddhyā mānāṅgulamiti smṛtamrathareṇuśca vālāgraṃ līkṣā yūko yavastathāaṣṭābhiśca krameṇaiva kanyasādivibhedataḥśālibhiśca tribhiḥ sārdhaiścaturbhiśca tathāyataiḥsārdhaiḥ ṣaḍbhiryavairvātha sārdhaiḥ saptabhireva vāmadhyamāṅgulimadhyasthaparvadīrghaṃ tu yadbhavetardhonamadhamaṃ proktaṃ mātrāṅgulavibhedataḥevaṃ mātrāṅgulaṃ proktaṃ yāgādīnāṃ paśasyatetaddvayaṃ hastamuddiṣṭaṃ sa kiṣkuriha sammataḥmātraistu ṣaḍviṃśatibhirdhanurmuṣṭiḥ prakīrtitaḥmānāṅgulotthahastāstu śāstre'smin saṃprakīrtitāḥtalaṃ prasārya cāṅguṣṭhasahitaiścaturaṅgulaiḥvitastiḥ kathitaścaivaṃ prādeśastadanantaramprājāpatyasya mānena maṇḍape vigrahe'pi ca
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: rājadhānyādikaṃ rājabhavanaṃ ca taṭākakamdhanurgraheṇa kuryāttu rathyādhvānaṃ viśeṣataḥkiṣkumānena vai sarvamāpannaṃ tu samācaretliṅgaṃ ca pratimāṃ caiva dvārastambhaṃ ca cūlikamatyalpaṃ tu yavenaivamāpnuyānmānavittamaiḥhastaiścaturbhiruddiṣṭo daṇḍo rajjustadaṣṭabhiḥadhvānaṃ rajjunā badhvā kṣetraṃ caiva tu mānayetnyagrodhavalkalenātha tālaketakavalkalaiḥdevavipramahīpānāṃ vaiśyaśūdrairvivarjitāśaṇakaṃ ca krameṇaiva devādīnāṃ praśaṃsitāḥnālikerasya patrasya māpanaṃ sarvasiddhidampūrvottaramukhenātha pārambhe dalanaṃ bhavettatpatrasirayā vāpi kṣudraskandhena māpayetsvāyato dīrghasaṃyuktastvardhamātrapravistaraḥtattadardhaghanopeto vistāreṇa samo'thavāmūle svāyambhuvaṃ rūpaṃ madhye lakṣmīsvarūpakamayaṃ deveṣu yogyaḥ syāddaṇḍo dvyaṅgulavistaraḥhemnā vā rājatenātha tāmreṇaivāyasāthavāsakalaṃ padamekaṃ syāt pecakaṃ tu dvitīyakamupapīṭhaṃ tataḥ paścādugrapīṭhamataḥ paramparameśapadaṃ cāpi navamaṃ parikīrtitamdeśīyaṃ dvādaśaṃ proktaṃ padaṃ tūbhayacaṇḍikampadmagarbhapadaṃ pañcadaśamaṃ tu prakīrtitamaṣṭādaśapadaṃ cātra karṇāṣṭakamiti smṛtamsyādviṃśatipadaṃ sūryaviśālaṃ nāmataḥ padam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dvāviṃśatipadaṃ cātra padaṃ supratikāntakamsyāccaturviṃśatipadaṃ vipragarbhamiti smṛtamyattu ṣaḍviṃśatitamaṃ tatsyādvipulabhogakamyattvaṣṭāviṃśatipadaṃ viśālākṣapadaṃ smṛtampadaṃ triṃśattamaṃ proktaṃ viśvasāraṃ purātanamindrakāntapadaṃ yattu dvātriṃśatkathitaṃ tvihaindraṃ yamaṃ ca varuṇaṃ somaṃ gandhādinārcayetkuryāttu pecakapade karṇasūtradvayānvitetanmadhye niṣkalaṃ beraṃ sthāpayeddeśikottamaḥkarṇasūtradvayenaiva saṃyuktaṃ pīṭhamiṣyateetatpadaṃ maṭhādīnāṃ tacca grāmādiyogyakamkarṇasūtradvayopetaṃ mahāpīṭhaṃ tu kārayetīśo jayanta ādityo bhṛśo'gnirvitatho yamaḥmukhyaḥ somo'ditiśceti sūtrasthā bāhyadevatāḥupapīṭhapade caikaṃ bhuṅkte madhye pitāmahaḥcaturdikṣu gatā devā ekaikapadabhoginaḥāgneyādicaturdikṣu bhuñjate devatāḥ padamgandharvaśca tathā devo gṛhakṣatayamau tathāvāyuścāpi gajaścaiva bhallāṭaḥ soma eva caupapīṭhapadaṃ nāmnā grāmādīnāṃ śubhāvahammadhye catuṣpadaṃ brāhmamantarāvaraṇe tataḥprāgādi bhuñjate devā dvipadaṃ koṇavarjitamāgneyakoṇamārabhya bhuñjate devatāḥ padamkoṇeṣu bhuñjate devāḥ padānāmardhakaṃ kramātnairṛtasya tu pūrvārdhe gṛhaḥ syātpaścime svayam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: īśānapaścimārdhe tu ditirīśastu pūrvagaḥjayanteśo mahendraśca ādityaḥ satyakastathāgandharvaśca tathā devāścatvāraḥ padabhoginaḥasuraśca tathā devāścatvāraścottare matāḥugrapīṭhamidaṃ nāma grāmādīnāṃ supūjitammadhye navapadaṃ brāhmamantarāvaraṇe tataḥpūrvādikramayogena tripadaṃ bhuñjate surāḥsāvitraścendrajaścaiva rudrajastvāpajastathāīśānaśca jayantaśca mahendrādityasatyakāḥvitatho gṛhakṣataścaiva yamo gandharva eva casugrīvapuṣpadantau ca varuṇāsuraśeṣakāḥmukhyo bhallāṭakaḥ somo ṛbhurhyaditireva casthaṇḍilākhyapadaṃ caitadgṛhārāmādipūjitammadhye catuṣpadaṃ brahmā tanmukhasthāścatuḥ surāḥcaturdiśi sthitā bāhye ṣoḍaśa dvipadeśvarāḥagrahārādiyogyaṃ tanmaṇḍūkākhyapadaṃ tvihakarṇasūtradvayopetaṃ kalpanīyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥcatasro devatāḥ ṣaṭ ṣaṭ padabhogaparāḥ smṛtāḥmaṇḍūke'tra samā devāḥ kathyante ca yathākramātādityaḥ satyakabhraṃśāvantarikṣaśca pūrvagāḥgandharvo bhṛṅgarājaśca mṛgaścaiva tu dakṣiṇevaruṇaścāsuraścaiva śeṣo rogastu paścimegajaścāpyaditiścaiva ditiścaiva tathottarearyamā ca vivasvāṃśca mitraśca pṛthivīdharaḥāpaścaivāpavatsaśca savitāpi sāvitrakaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: madhye brahmā sthitaḥ prokto maṇḍūke cāpi tatpareīśānādiṣu koṇeṣu śūlasthāḥ padavarjitāḥpūrvāditaḥ samārabhya caturdikṣu vyavasthitāḥāsanaṃ karṇasūtrābhyāṃ yuktaṃ tu parikalpayetādityaśca yamaścaiva karuṇaḥ soma eva cakṣetraṃ śatapadaṃ durgapurāṭṭālakabhūmiṣusthānīyaṃ karṇasūtrābhyāṃ yuktaṃ tu parikalpayetkoṇeśādipade brahmā tvīśāgnipitṛvāyavaḥcatvārastvaryamādyāstu pūrvādidaśabhāginaḥyathāsthānāścarakyādyāścāṣṭau bāhye prakīrtitāḥdeśīyākhyaṃ padaṃ karṇasūtrābhyāṃ parikalpayetādityaśca yamaścaiva varuṇaḥ soma eva cadeśīyākhyapadaṃ caidamagrahārādipūjitampadānyekonapañcāśanmadhye brahyādhitiṣṭhatikoṇasthāstripadā jñeyā īśāgnipitṛvāyavaḥpūrvavaccāpavatsādyā bāhyasthāḥ parikīrtitāḥprāk ca pañcadaśodak ca sūtrāṇi parikalpayetagrahārādiyogyaṃ syādbhadrāsanamidaṃ padamekāśītipadaṃ madhye bhuṅkte lokapitāmahaḥaṣṭādaśāṃśabhāgasthāścāryamādyāḥ prakīrtitāḥprāñci saptadaśodañci sūtrāṇi parikalpayetagrahārādiyogyaṃ syāttriyutaṃ parikīrtitamekaviṃśacchatapadaṃ brahmā bhuṅkte tu madhyamedvāviṃśadbhogino devā mukhasthāḥ parikīrtitāḥvṛttābhogamidaṃ proktaṃ grāmādau saṃprayojayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: karṇāṣṭakamidaṃ vidyādagrahārādipūjitamekonasaptatipadaṃ tanmadhye brāhmakaṃ bhavettripadā lokapālāḥ syurantarasthā dvibhāginaḥproktaṃ gaṇitapādaṃ tu grāmādau parikalpayetsusaṃhitapadaṃ karṇasūtrayuktaṃ prakalpayetaryamādicatuṣkasya triṃśattriṃśatpadāni caādityādicaturṇāṃ tu tripadaṃ parikīrtitampūrvavaccāpavatsāderaṣṭakasya dvayaṃ dvayametatsusaṃhitaṃ nāma padaṃ grāmādipūjitampūrvoktena prakāreṇa padaṃ grāmādipūjitamdviśataṃ ca navāśīti madhye brahmapadāni capañcāśallokapālāḥ syuranyatsarvaṃ samānakamvipragarbhaṃ yathāpūrvamagrahārādipūjitamtriśatañcaikaṣaṣṭiñca madhye brahmapadāni caagrahārādiyogyaṃ syādviśveśākhyamidaṃ padampadaṃ vipratikāntaṃ ca karṇasūtradvayānvitambrahmā bhuṅkte'ryamādyāstu pūrvavatparikalpayetidaṃ vipratikāntākhyamagrahārādipūjitamtriṃśatprāñci tathodañci sūtrāṇi parikalpayetcaturṇāmaryamādīnāṃ ṣaṭcatvāriṃśadaṃśakamviprabhuktiriti jñeyaṃ padaṃ grāmādiyogyakampadamīśvarakāntaṃ tu karṇasūtradvayānvitamaryamādicatuṣkasya pañcāśatprativeditamparjanyādestu catvāro bhāgāḥ pratyekamīritāḥindrakāntaṃ yathāpūrvamagrahārādipūjitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: catuḥ ṣaṣṭipadaṃ daivaṃ mānuṣaṃ pārameśvaramtraivarṇikānāṃ vā kuryādagrahārādivāstuṣuviṭchūdrayostathaikonapañcāśatpadamīritamcatuḥ ṣaṣṭyekāśītyākhyamāsanaṃ ca tridhā matamvāstukarmaṇi śastaṃ syādgrāmādau ca gṛhādiṣukarṇasūtravihīnaṃ vā madhye karṇadvayānvitampadaṃ sarvaṃ vidheyaṃ syādevaṃ buddhyā prakalpayetcakravat pañcasūtrāṇi sāntarāṇi samāni caekāśītipadaṃ hyetajjñeyaṃ viṣamasaṃsthitiḥcatuḥ ṣaṣṭipadaṃ caitaccaturvṛtte pakalpayetcatuḥ ṣaṣṭipadaṃ vāstu paramaiśantu vāstukamstrīpuṃsoriva saṃyogastathā yojyaṃ vicakṣaṇaiḥbhṛśāṃśe mithunaṃ vidyātkulīro vitathe bhavetmitre tu vṛścikaḥ śeṣe dhanurmukhye jhaṣasthitiḥcarācarobhayā jñeyāstattadevāṃśake nyasetpradakṣiṇagatānyeva meṣādiṣu vibhāgataḥyame tu guruvāraḥ syānnairṛtau budhavārakamsome tu somavāraḥ syādīśāne rāhusaṃsthitiḥtadvaśādvihitaṃ sarvaṃ sarvasiddhiphalapradamprathamaṃ brahmaṇaḥ sthānātprāksūtraṃ sabaliṃ nyasetcaturaśrāyatāśrasthaparyantaṃ syāttṛtīyakamṣaṣṭhaṃ syāttadanantaryaṃ saptamaṃ madhyakarṇikamevamanyattu vijñeyaṃ yāvaddvātriṃśakaṃ padampramāṇasūtramanyatsyādevaṃ sūtradvayaṃ bhavetparyantasūtramānaṃ tatsūtraṃ prāmāṇikaṃ param
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: taddhi vinyāsasūtraṃ syājjñātavyā sūtrakalpanāteṣvekabhāgaṃ sūtrasya mānaṃ tatprāṇa ucyateprāṇavāyupramāṇena śāstre'smin kīrtitāni hiprāṇavāyupramāṇena dviguṇāścānuvaṃśakāḥtriguṇaśca mahāvaṃśo vāstumadhye prakīrtitaḥmahāsirāśca tatrasthā madhye karṇagatā matāḥmahāsirāścānusirāḥ saṃjñeyāstu napuṃsakāḥmahāsirāmahāmarmaparyante sandhiriṣyatemahāśūlaṃ catuṣprāṇaṃ triguṇaṃ cānuśūlakamcatuṣkaṃ tu catuḥ sūtraiḥ ṣaṭkaṃ ṣaṭsūtrayogataḥpadasya cāṣṭamāṃśena marmamānaṃ prakīrtitamtrihastanirmite kṣetre yavamānaṃ tu sūtrakamhṛdaye vaṃśake śūle sūtrasandhau ca marmakedevālayādikaṃ noktaṃ kṛtañcetkulanāśanambhittistambhagṛhādīni kārayeddeśikottamaḥyadaṅgaṃ vāstu martyasya bādhyate sarvakarmaṇirātrau kuryādbaliṃ vidvānahni grāmādivāstuṣususnāto navavastrastu soṣṇīṣaḥ sottarīyakaḥtādṛśena ca tatkartrā yuktaḥ karmedamācaretuktvā tvāvāhayāmīti cāvāhyārcanamācaretpādyādinikhilān datvā svasvoktaṃ tu baliṃ kṣipetphalānyaryamaṇe dadyāttilamāṣodanaṃ tathāpṛthvīdharāya sadgandhān dāpayetsusamāhitaḥjayantāya ghṛtaṃ dadyāt mahendraḥ kuṣṭhabhāg bhavetsatyakāya badaryāstu phalaṃ madhusamanvitam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: dāpayedantarikṣāya tapanaṃ dugdhasarppiṣāpūpṇe ca vitathe dadyātpakvānnaṃ susamāhitaḥyamāya pāyasaṃ dadyādgandharve gandhamucyatedadyānnirṛtaye tailaṃ piṇyākānnaṃ ca buddhimānpiṣṭāni puṣpadantāya puṣpāṇi sajalāni cavārāhaṃ tu balau māṃsamasurāya pradāpayetrogāya śuṣkamastyān vai dhvajaṃ pītaṃ ca vāyavebhallāṭāya gulānnaṃ vai samyagdadyādbalipradaḥgajāya śarkarāpūpamadityai modakaṃ viduḥpāyasaṃ ghṛtasammiśramīśānāya nivedayetindrāya māṣamannaṃ vai mudgānnaṃ cendrasūnaveāpāya mastyaṃ māsaṃ ca cāpavatsāya dāpayetbidārikāyai dātavyaṃ lavaṇaṃ dhīmatā bhṛśamkulmāṣaṃ pāparākṣasyai māṃsānnaṃ syādgraheṣu casarveṣāmapi dātavyo balirdadhnā samanvitaḥgṛhadevālayādau ca madhyamaḥ kathyate'dhunāaryamādicaturṇāṃ tu pāyasaṃ balirucyateīśānādyaṣṭadevānāṃ mudgānnaṃ balirucyatepaścimāśāsthitānāṃ tu ghṛtānnaṃ balirucyateaṣṭānāṃ bāhyadevānāṃ māṃsānnaṃ balirucyateśuddhamannaṃ pradātavyaṃ gandhapuṣpapuraḥ sarammatsyaṃ śūdragṛhe proktamanyatra madhu kalpayetgrāmādau vā baliḥ sopi śuddhadravyairvidhīyatāmmahāvāstuni viprendrā deśikā bahavo matāḥabhāvādādiśaivānāṃ tatra brāhmāḥ śivadvijāḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: svagṛhe tvanuśaivāstu mahāvāntaraśaivakāḥekatra vātha kartavyo deśikena ca dhīmatāmaṇḍape vā prapāyāṃ vā vāstuhomaṃ samācarethastamātramidaṃ kuṇḍaṃ ratnimātramathāpi vāpalāśodumbarāśvatthavaṭāḥ pūrvāditaḥ kramātkumbhe vodumbare vāpi vāstudevān prapūjayetkṛtasthaṇḍilakādhāraḥ soṣṇīṣaḥ sottarīyakaḥuṣṇīṣarahitaiḥ sārdhaṃ vedadhvanisamanvitamsaṃprāptadakṣiṇaḥ śānto manastuṣṭisamanvitaḥparyagnikaraṇopetaṃ vāstuhomaṃ niyāmakamvāstupūjāvihīnaṃ tu vāstuvāstu vinaśyatigrāmādigṛhaśālāsu devaveśmani deśikaḥyathāvadvihitaṃ vāstu na tyajanti hi devatāḥtatra kālaparīkṣādi prāguktavidhinācaretagrahārastadevoktaṃ viprendrāḥ kāmikāhvayeeko grāmaṇiko yatra sabhṛtyaparicārakaḥjanaiḥ parivṛtaṃ dravyakrayavikrayakādibhiḥsarvadaivatasaṃyuktaṃ nagaraṃ cābhidhīyateyatsthānaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ tu kharvaṭaṃ puravāsināmkrayavikrayasaṃyuktamabdhitīrasamāśritampaṭṭaṇaṃ tatsamākhyātaṃ vaiśyairadhyuṣitaṃ tu yatvane janapade caiva kevale śūdrasevitaḥsāmantānāṃ samṛddhānāṃ yatsthānaṃ śibiraṃ smṛtamrājaveśmasamāyuktaṃ sarvajātisamanvitamāgantukānāṃ sarveṣāṃ naiṣṭhikānāṃ nivāsabhūḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vidyāsthānaṃ tu tadvatsyādbahusenāsamanvitamgrāmādīnāṃ samīpaṃ yatsthānaṃ kubjamiti smṛtamvistārāyāmamānaṃ tu sarveṣāṃ tu sanātanampañcadaṇḍaṃ samarabhya daṇḍābhyāṃ vardhayetkramātadhame tu tadūrdhvaṃ tu tatsamaṃ cottamaṃ bhavetkuṭumbabhūmimānaṃ tu vāṭakṣetravivarjitamcaturaśrārdhabhāgaṃ vā caturbhāgamathāpi vāpañcaṣaṭsaptamūrtyaṃśapaṅktibhāgamathāpi vātriguṇāntapramāṇena cāyāmaṃ parikalpayetsarvaṃ deve ca vipre ca sāmānyamiha kīrtitamvistāreṇābhyaseddairghyaṃ triguṇaṃ cāṣṭabhirhṛtamdhvajo dhūmaḥ śvasiṃhau ca vṛṣaḥ kharagajottamauśastāḥ syurninditāścānye dhūmādyā yonayastvihaśiṣṭamaśvayujādyaṃ tu nakṣatramiha kīrtitamtrayodaśadinaṃ tyājyaṃ tathā pañcadaśoḍukamsaptaviṃśatinakṣatraṃ tyājyamanyacchubhaṃ smṛtamtadeva cātra saṃgrāhyaṃ viparītaṃ parityajetnāmajanmarkṣayorānukūlyaścottama ucyatenakṣatrasya phalaṃ yattu vayastasya prakīrtitamsakalañcāṣṭabhirhanyādāyaḥ so'pyanyathocyateśiṣṭastvāyaḥ samākhyāto vyayastatra prakīrtyatevyayaḥ śiṣṭa iha proktastvanyathāpi ca kathyateāyādhikyaṃ tu śubhadaṃ samaṃ hīnaṃ ca varjayettriṃśadbhirvibhajecchiṣṭaṃ tithināgāvaṭaistu vāparyantāvaṭakenātha vāraṃ saṃkalpayedbudhaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭadvādaśakau varjyau śeṣāḥ śreṣṭhāśca rāśayaḥvistāreṇābhyaseddairghyaṃ tādṛśīmathavā punaḥcaturaśrāyatāśrāṇāṃ sakalenaiva yojayetkumbhakasya viśālārdhaṃ nāhārdhena nyasedbudhaḥādau śatapadaṃ kṛtvā paryanteśānakoṣṭhakātpañcatattvaṃ tathāgneyakoṇātpaścimamārgataḥvarṇān viṃśatisaṃkhyākān krameṇaivaṃ tu vinyasetnayabhajakhavarṇaśca gajadacala eva capaścimābhimukhaṃ pūrvaṃ likhitānāṃ tṛtīyakamekādaśa nyasetpaścātprānte nyasettrayodaśakṛttikā kathitā tāvado vā vo vū catuṣṭayamcandrabhaṃ kuśca ārdrā syātpañcaviṃśatimadhyamehuśca heśca tathā hośca ḍaśca puṣyaḥ prakīrtitaḥanena kramayogena sarvamatra samācarethastayukte ca koṣṭhe ca pūṣaṇāṭhān parikalpayetbhecottarābhādrapade dūthājhāñān tathā nayetakāragrahaṇenaiva ākāraḥ svīkṛtastvihaukāragrahaṇenaiva ūkāraḥ svīkṛtastvihaevamanyatra conneyaṃ nāmanakṣatrakalpanātnāmarkṣaṃ yojayedvidvānnāmāntaraparigrahātevaṃ nakṣatracakrañca yuṣmākaṃ kathitaṃ mayāvipadi pratyare caiva vadhe caiva yathākramāttṛtīye cāpi paryāye cottamaṃ paripaṭhyategaṇañcāsuramānuṣyaṃ varjayecchubhamanyathādaṇḍikaṃ svastikañcānyatprastaraṃ ca prakīrṇakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śrīvatsaṃ vaidikaṃ caiva nandyāvartaṃ ca kumbhakamkumbhakaṃ vaidikaṃ caiva daṇḍikaṃ ca viśeṣataḥpūrvāgramuttarāgraṃ vā vīthiṃ kṛtvobhayorbudhaḥekavīthisamāyuktaṃ vīthidvayasamāyutamkartarīkṛtadaṇḍābhaṃ vātha kuryāttu daṇḍikamudagagrairnavānyaiśca mārgairyuktaṃ tu tadbhavetpaścimābhimukhaścaiva dakṣiṇasyāṃ tu nirgamaḥprāṅmukhastu tato bhūtvā saumyavīthyāstu nirgamaḥevameva tu sarveṣāṃ grāmādīnāṃ vinirgamaḥtisṛbhiḥ prāṅmukhābhistu prastaraṃ tviha kathyateudīcībhiḥ samāyuktaṃ prāṅmukhābhiścatasṛbhiḥekaviṃśatisaṃkhyātaiḥ prāṅmukhābhiśca pañcabhiḥṣaḍvīthikāṃ samārabhya trayoviṃśatikāvadhiṣaḍbhiśca prāṅmukhābhiśca parākaṃ tviha kīrtyateudaṅmukhābhirvīthībhiryuktaṃ prāṅmukhamārgakaiḥaṣṭabhiḥ prāṅmukhairmārgairudīcīnaistadāditaḥśrīpratiṣṭhitamityuktaṃ tasminniṣṭaṃ pragṛhyatāmśrīvatsamiti nirdiṣṭaṃ sarvavāstuṣu yogyakampuṣpadantādike vāpi yatheṣṭaṃ dvārasammitamgṛhavīthisamāyuktaṃ caitadvaidikamucyatepradhānaṃ vāpradhānaṃ vā sarvatra vihitaṃ tvihaetacca vaidikaṃ proktamantarbāhyavibhāgataḥparito'pi samaṃ kṛtvā mārgaiḥ pūrvottarānanaiḥvidhāya vīthiṃ nābhyākhyāṃ nirgamaiśca samanvitāmnābhau vinirmitāstisraḥ pañca sapta navāthavā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vṛttākāraistu mārgaiśca ekānekaiḥ samanvitamkumbhakañceti nirdiṣṭamanekaiḥ koṇakairyutamnagarīpattanādau tu vihitaṃ tviha kāmikebrahmabhāgāvṛtāvīthirnābhivīthīti kathyatesaiva maṅgalavīthīti rathavīthīti cocyatetā eva janavīthyaḥ syuḥ kṣudrāstiryaggatā matāsyādekādaśadaṇḍāntaṃ vīthimānamihāgamehitvā maṅgalavīthyagraṃ nābhiṃ na protayetkvacitcaturdvāraṃ prakartavyaṃ sarveṣāmapi vāstunāmgṛhakṣatapade caiva gandharve dakṣiṇe śubhammukhyabhallāṭayoḥ sthāne cottaradvāra ucyateśeṣe nāge'ditau sthānamudagdvāreṣu kīrtitamtithidaṇḍāvasānaṃ tu gṛhakṣetraviśālatāathavā hastamānena gṛhavistāra ucyateekaṣaṣṭiviśālaṃ tu gṛhakṣetraviśālatācatuḥ śālāgṛhaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ triśālaṃ madhyamaṃ bhavetbrahmasthānasya vāyavyāṃ viṣṇusthānaṃ prakīrtitamgrāmamadhye tadīśānyāmaṣṭadikṣu śivo mataḥanyatsarvaṃ yatheṣṭaṃ sthātteṣāṃ sthānamihocyateravisthānaṃ bhavettatra sthānaṃ vāpi śacīpateḥsugrīve vāruṇe vāpi ṣaṇmukhasthānamīrtitamvāruṇyāṃ vātha nairṛtyāṃ vāyusomāntare'thavāyame vā nairṛte bhāge vāyavyāmindramadhyamevāruṇyāṃ śrīsarasvatyoḥ sthānamuktaṃ śivāśritāḥāgneyāṃ moṭikāsthānaṃ kāmadevasya tatra vai
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: kāmabhāskarayorvāstu ṣaṇmukhasthānamucyatesahasrādadhike vipre madhye viṣṇugṛhaṃ tu vāśrīpateḥ pūjayā nityaṃ prajāvṛddhirbhaviṣyatiindrapūjā manuṣyāṇāṃ prabhāvaṃ saṃprayacchatiśāstṛpūjā svakṛtyeṣu niyuṅkte vāstuvāsinaḥumā pūjā viśeṣaṇa vijayaṃ saṃprayacchatisarvasiddhiravighnena vighneśasya saparyayālakṣmīpūjā śriyaṃ dadyādalakṣmīṃ ca vyapohatimātṛpūjā sadā sarvasampadaṃ kurute dvijāḥtasmānmaheśvaro nityaṃ pūjanīyaḥ phalārthibhiḥanyatra madhyamaṃ proktaṃ liṅga saṃsthāpitaṃ dvijāḥpaścime madhyamaṃ vidyādadhamaṃ cānyadeśakeugrā śāntā ca tatrādyā ugrakarmaratā matāśāntā tu madhyagā proktā grāmādau sarvavāstuniugrāstu mūrtayaḥ proktaḥ śeṣāḥ śāntā udāhṛtāḥjāmadagnyaṃ ca jānīyādugraṃ vaiṣṇavavigrahamraudrāṇāmiha devānāṃ sthāpane phalamucyatenāśastu yāmyadeśe tu pretadaityādibhirbhṛśamduḥsthitiṃ pāvane vidyādrāṣṭrasaṃsthāṃ tu saumyakegrāme tvevaṃ samākhyātaṃ sarvatrānyeṣu vā matāna madhye sthāpayedrudramūrtiṃ grāme viśeṣataḥśāntamūrtipratiṣṭhāṃ tu kārayeddeśikottamaḥagrahārādvinānyeṣu sthānīyādiṣu vāstuṣutathaiva śeṣadeśe ca parjanyāṃśe jayantakeīkṣaṇaṃ sakalānāṃ tu aihikāmuṣmikāvaham
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: ekadaṇḍaṃ samārabhya pañcadaṇḍāvasānakamevaṃ tu kathitaṃ rudramūrtīnāṃ sthāpane phalambrahmasthāne sthitaṃ liṅgaṃ viprakṣatriyaśobhanamārogyaṃ vāruṇaṃ liṅgaṃ saumyaṃ vittapradaṃ bhavetvāyavye sampado dadyātsarvamīśānagocaresome caiśānake vāpi someśānāntarālakegrāmāderabhivṛddhiḥ syādrājño rāṣṭrasya caiva hijyeṣṭhamadhyakaniṣṭhāśca kṣudrāśceti caturvidhāḥcaturdaśasahasrāttu ṣaṭsahasradvijāntakamtataḥ pañcasahasrāttu sahasrāntaṃ yathākramamśatahīnasahasrāttu yāvatpañcadatāntakamathavānyaprakāreṇa vakṣyate śṛṇuta dvijāḥlakṣāntaṃ saṃgṛhītavyaṃ teṣu śaktyaikamācaretvardhayedatihīnaṃ cedekasmādeva vardhanātdvātriṃśadvā caturviṃśat ṣoḍaśa dvādaśaiva vāgrāmaḥ śarīramaṅgaṃ syāddevamartyaparigrahaḥpadaprastarasūtre vā madhyasūtradvaye'pi cavīthyantare gṛhaśreṇyāṃ sīmni vā sūtravardhanamdaṇḍacchedo na kartavyo grāme vāpi gṛhāyatauanyatra daṇḍaṃ na chidyāccharīre tu viśeṣataḥpadaśeṣayutaṃ veśma chinnadaṇḍaṃ gṛhādikamśreṇyantareṣu tatraiva padaśeṣaṃ samāpayetjalasya nirgamārthaṃ tu kṣudramārgāḥ praśaṃsitāḥaṅgeṣu yaḥ kṛto doṣo grāmasya hi janasya tuvāstunaḥ sarvamarmādi tyaktvānyatra vasennaraḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maraṇaṃ marmaṇi jñeyaṃ sandhau mitrārthanāṃśanammaraṇaṃ brahmasūtre tu karṇasūtre'rthanāśanamyugmāyugmavibhāgena vinyāso vividho mataḥanyonyasaṅkaro yasmādaśubhaṃ syājjaneṣu cabrahmasthāne sabhādīni kalpayedvidhinā budhaḥtanmuktvā pārśvayoḥ kāryaṃ sabhāsthānasamṛddhayevāyavye nairṛte caiśe kuryādvai devatālayambrāhmaṃ vā madhyame bhāge pīṭhaṃ vā parikalpayetuttare mānuṣe bhāge viṣṇuṃ saṃsthāpayedbudhaḥindrasūtrādudīcyāṃ tu sūryaṃ saṃsthāpayetsudhīḥdurgā vā tatra kartavyā skandapārśve'thavā bhavetgrāmāddaśanavāṃśaṃ vā aṣṭasaptāṃśameva vātadantardaivikaṃ proktaṃ śiṣṭaṃ brāhmamiti smṛtamkṛtvā teṣvekabhāgaṃ tu parito vardhayedguruḥdaivamānuṣabhāge tu varṇānāṃ vāsa iṣyatepaiśāce na ca kartavyo vāsaḥ karmopajīvināmvarṇānāṃ vāsa ityukte brahmapaiśācikāṃśakeanyeṣāṃ karmiṇāṃ gehaṃ vāstupaiśācike matamdevālayasya pārśve tu pūjakānāṃ gṛhaṃ bhavetanyeṣāṃ vāstudevānāṃ padapaiśācike padamdaivajño gaṇako vaidyastvambaṣṭho bheṣajapradaḥvaṇijaśca kulālāśca nāpitāḥ puṣpajīvinaḥvaidehakāstantuvāyāḥ karmakā rajakā apivāruṇyāṃ vaṇijāṃ sthānamindradiśyathavā bhavetnāpitānāṃ dvayepi syādagnerindrasya vā diśi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāditrajīvināṃ sthānaṃ somadeśe ca kalpitamyāmyāyāṃ diśi saumyāyāṃ cakriṇāṃ sthānamiṣyateproktaṃ tu tantuvāyānāṃ sthānaṃ yāmyadiśi sthitamutkṛṣṭānāṃ samīpe syānnikṛṣṭānāṃ tu dūrataḥkarmakāṇāṃ nivāsaḥ syādrajakānāṃ tato bahiḥcaṇḍālānāṃ kuṭīrāṇi krośabāhye prakalpayetnadyādau vidyamāne tu śmaśānaṃ tīradeśaketaṭākaṃ kārayetkūpamanyadikṣu vivarjayetathavā sarvakāṣṭhāsu vāpīkūpataṭākakāḥcaṇḍālakarmakārāṇāṃ śmaśānodakpradeśayoḥdevaveśmagṛhādīnāṃ mārgasya ca viśeṣataḥśleṣmātakaṃ vaṭañcāpi kaṭakañcāpyudumbarampradakṣiṇakramādetānīśānādyaṣṭadikṣvapiete doṣaharāḥ proktā gāmādīnāṃ viśeṣataḥbahirbhaṅgalavīthyāṃ tu pādapādārdhavardhanātcaturādicatuṣpañcadaṇḍārdhārdhapadaṃ punaḥevaṃ tu raudradevānāṃ vimānaṃ parikalpayetsagarbhaṃ sarvasampatyai vigarbhaṃ nāśanaṃ bhavetdevatāsthāpanātpūrvaṃ sthāpanaṃ cottamaṃ bhavetgrāmavinyāsamārabhya caikābdādūrdhvakālakepurvokte tu śive kāle sitapakṣe viśeṣataḥnāgayoge divā vāpi grāmagarbhaṃ tu vinyasetgṛhiṇīṃ garbhiṇīṃ kartuṃ yadi garbhaṃ na nikṣipetcaturaṅgulamārabhya caikāṅgulavivardhanāttadardhaṃ syātsamutsedhaṃ tripādaṃ vātha tatsamam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: sabhāgaṃ vā dvibhāgaṃ vā vāṇabhāge dvibhāgakamghanaṃ pañcayavārdhaṃ tu bhittīnāṃ parikalpayetpādā aṣṭāṃśakā vāpi cocchrāyeṇa ghanena casapañcapañcakoṣṭhaṃ vā navakoṣṭhayutaṃ tu vāśilāmayaṃ tu vā pātraṃ yavārdhenāṅgulāni caratnāni dhātukādīni svalpavistārabhājaneevaṃ jñātvā tu matimān garbhasthāpanamārabhetpañcagavyena saṃprokṣya puṇyāhaṃ vācayettataḥgarbhasthāne hṛhe vāpi grāme garbhādhivāsanamdaśarandhrābdhihastairvā vistṛtaṃ maṇṭapaṃ nayettālamātrasamutsedhaṃ tasyāṃ dikṣu catasṛṣusayonyaśrāṇi kuṇḍāni caikaṃ vā pūrvataḥ sthitampuṣpamālāsamāyuktaṃ dvāratoraṇasaṃyutammaṇḍapaṃ bhūṣayitvaivaṃ punaḥ puṇyāhamācaretśālibhiśca daśadroṇaiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ taṇḍulaistilaiḥdarbhairapi paristīrya sthaṇḍilaṃ pūjayedguruḥcitrite śālipiṣṭaiśca caturaśrāṃ samantataḥbhūdharairdiggajairyuktāṃ dhātrīṃ nāgaphaṇasthitāmphelāṃ prakṣālya gavyaiśca sthāpya citre tu maṇḍalesakalīkṛtadehastu gandhaiḥ puṣpairvibhūṣitaḥmadhyakoṣṭhe nyasetkūṭaṃ bindunādasamanvitamakārādi visargāntān bāhyakoṇeṣu vinyasetśūlaṭaṅkadharaṃ saumyaṃ jaṭācandravibhūṣitamprāṅmukhodaṅmukho bhūtvā mṛdādīni tu vinyasetnādeyīmatha tāṭākīṃ darbhamūlagatāmapi
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: gajadantagatāṃ cāpi kramādetā mṛdo nyasetsaṃyojya tā mṛdaścāṣṭau sarvā brāhmapade nyasetvṛṣaśṛṅge hastidante darbhamūle jalāntarepaṅkajotpalakalhārakandāśca kumudasya vaitathā kuvalayasyāpi tatraivāvaraṇe punaḥvinyasedānupūrvyeṇa tadvāhye cāṣṭamaṅgalammatsyayugmāṅkuśau caiva śaṅkhakesariṇau tathāvajrapravālanīlendranīlamauktikapuṣyakānathavā pañcaratnāni vinyasedānupūrvaśaḥmuktāṃ madhye caturdikṣu pañcabrahmāṇyanusmarandhātūn sugandhaśṛṅgākhyān dhṛtivīryātmakānnyasetprokteṃ madhye'khilānyeva dehaśaktiṃ smaran nyasetbījāni vrīhigodhūmatilamāṣān pradakṣiṇamnyasettṛptyātmakānetān mantrairlokeśavācakaiḥtrapuṇā kaṅkusīsena māṃsapuṣpāyasāṃstilānviṣṇukrāntitriśūlīśrīḥ sahāpūrvāṃ ca bhṛṅgakamcandanāgarukarpūralavaṅgailālatāphalamsarveṣāmāpi sāmānyaṃ tattaccihnaistu vakṣyatepinākaṃ hariṇaṃ pāśaṃ haimaṃ śaive tu vinyasetbhūsurāṇāṃ hitārthāya yajñasūtraṃ kamaṇḍalumrathaṃ gajaṃ hayaṃ caiva śārdūlaṃ cāpameva catulāṃ ca mānapātraṃ ca mahiṣaṃ govṛṣadvayamvṛṣaṃ halayugaṃ caiva yugmamatsyaṃ tu śālikamsthālīṃ tadupadhānaṃ ca darvīkaṃ taṇḍulaṃ ghaṭamdakṣiṇe bhavane kumbhaṃ suśālyudakapūritam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: paryaṅkadīpaśayane garbhaṃ vidyātsukhālayecatuṣpadāśca devāśca saṃsthāpyābhyantarānanāḥaṣṭāṅgulapramāṇena bimbotsedhāḥ prakīrtitāḥevaṃ dravyāṇi vinyasya pidhāyaiśānamantrataḥgandhapuṣpākṣatairdhūpairdīpanaivedyakādibhiḥācāryo mūrtipaiḥ sārdhaṃ homakarma samācaretvidhināgnimukhaṃ kṛtvā tato dravyāṇi homayetsamidājyacarūn lājān sarṣapāṃśca yavāṃstilānśivāddaśāṃśato'ṅgāni tarpayitvā yathāvidhiseśvarāṇi tritatvāni mūrtimūrtīśvarānnyasetsaṃpadā saṃskṛtaṃ kṛtvā daśadhā mūlamantrataḥṛgādyadhyayanaṃ kāryaṃ koṇeṣvastrajapo bhavetbrahmaṇyaryamabhāge tu vivasvati yame tathāpuṣpadante ca bhallāṭe mahendre ca gṛhakṣatekṛtvāvaṭaṃ tu tatraiva nayedañjalimātrataḥṣaḍaṅgulapramāṇaṃ tu caturviṃśāṅgulāntakamtathāśmanā ceṣṭakayā phelākāraṃ tu gartakampañcagavyena saṃprokṣya tanmadhye'ṣṭamṛdo nyasetdiggajairbhūdharairyuktāṃ gandhapuṣpādibhiryajetadhamā pañcaniṣkaṃ tu dviguṇā madhyamā bhavetgobhūmidāsadhānyādigṛhopakaraṇāni caadhyetṛmūrtipāṃścaiva daivajñaṃ pūjayettataḥdhyātvā sadāśivaṃ rūpaṃ mūlamantraṃ samuccaretpāṃsunā pūrayedgartaṃ susnigdhaṃ sudṛḍhaṃ nayetśivādīnāṃ ca devānāṃ devīnāṃ dvāradakṣiṇe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: homastambhavati stambhe pādakūrcāvṛteradhaḥathavā brahmagarbhaṃ tu brahmasthāne nidhāpayetdvitīyastambhake dvāradakṣiṇāṅghrau tu vinyasetmaṇḍitastambhamūle tu garbhaṃ saṃsthāpayetsudhīḥcūlikākārapāde vā tasyā garbho vidhīyatesarveṣāṃ maṇḍapānāṃ ca garbhasthānaṃ prakathyatepūrvoktakarṇapāde vā dvāradakṣiṇayogakepādabandhavimāne tu gehagarbhopari nyasetvṛterupari viprāṇāṃ kumudopari bhūbhṛtāmsarveṣāṃ bhūgataṃ kāryaṃ sarvasiddhikarāya cadakṣiṇe netrabhitau tu saumyādau tu caturgṛheparivārālayānāṃ tu mūlavatkarma cācaretmālikāyuktaśālaṃ cetkoṇastambhe dvitīyakesthitvā bahirbahiḥ prekṣya vāmāvāme vikalpya caālaye maṇḍape caiva nirgamasya pradakṣiṇesvāmyākhyaraṅgahīnānāṃ śālānāṃ netrabhittikeathavā madhyabhittau syāddvārasavye'tha madhyamevāpīkūpataṭākādau dīrghikāsetubandhanevāstupūjā ca homañca garbhanyāse vidhīyatemaṇḍapānāṃ mukhaṃ śāstre sarvasmin parikīrtitamantastrīnantare nītvā garbhaṃ samyagvinikṣepetbālasthānaṃ vinā vidvān mūlasthānaṃ na kārayetayaṃ vibhāgo grāmasya prārambhe'nyatra cānyathāmūlasthānasya caiśānyāmuttare pūrvayāmyayoḥnavadaṇḍaṃ vyapohyaiva kuryāddhāma mahāntaram
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: yadvā karadvayenaiva mūlasthānaṃ prakalpayetmūlabhāgaviśālena bhittirdvitriguṇā matātasya garbhagṛhārdhaṃ tu hīnamadhyārdhakaṃ tu yatliṅgāyāmaṃ suvṛttaṃ syānnāhāyāmau samau mataunavāṅgulaṃ samārabhya dvidvyaṅgulavivardhanāttalliṅgaṃ tricaturbhāgamānena tu niveśayetvasudhā bhājite tatra navaliṅgocchrayā matāḥtaruṇapratimānāṃ tu navadhā mānamīritammūlabimbārdhamānaṃ tu śreṣṭhaṃ vedāṃśamānataḥniṣkalasya viśālena cāsanaṃ cottamaṃ bhavetliṅgamānavaśenāpi pīṭhaṃ tu parikalpayetkṣīravṛkṣaiḥ palāśairvā vaṭodumbarapippalaiḥsaralāmaravṛkṣābhyāṃ liṅgaberaṃ samācaretsphoṭanādiṣu doṣeṣu bālasthānaṃ tu kārayettadūrdhvaṃ neṣṭamanyatra tatraiva sthāpayetsudhīḥtatsamaṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tripādaṃ vāgramaṇḍapamvistārasamatuṅgāḍhyaṃ daṇḍikācūlikānvitamturyāśramaṣṭavṛttaṃ vā tridhā pīṭhākṛtirmatāiṣṭakābhiḥ supakvābhiḥ liṅgaṃ syātsudhayā mṛdāprāgeva kuryāttaddhīmān vidhinā cāṅkurārpaṇamdaśarandhrāṣṭahastairvā maṇḍapaḥ saptahastataḥpaṅktitrayasamāyuktaṃ caturaśraṃ satoraṇammadhyāṃśe vedikāṃ kuryāttaccaturthāṃśakonnatamtasyāśca paritaścāṣṭadikṣu kuṇḍāni kalpayetīśānaśakrayormadhye pradhānaṃ vṛttakuṇḍakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: maṇḍapasyottare pārśve snānaśvabhraṃ prakalpayetjalamadhye prapāṃ kuryātsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyutāmśuddhatoyena gandhādyaiḥ saṃsnāpya ca hṛdārcayetjale tu śāyayelliṅgaṃ sadyenaiva kuśopariprabhūtapañcagavyena snapanaṃ vā samācaretsavastrānsahiraṇyāṃśca sasūtrān sāpidhānakānvāstuhomaṃ tataḥ kuryātprāsāde maṇḍape'pi vājalādānīya liṅgaṃ tu snānaśvabhropari nyasetkautukaṃ bandhayeddhīmān hṛdayena tu mantrataḥśālibhirvedikāmadhye aṣṭadroṇārdhanirmitaiḥśayanaṃ kalpayenmadhye carmajādyairanukramātsarvalakṣaṇasaṃyuktastvādiśaivaḥ saśiṣyakaḥśuklavastraśca soṣṇīṣaḥ śuklavastrottarīyakaḥīdṛśairlakṣaṇairyuktastvācāryaścottarānanaḥabhyarcya hṛdayenaiva gandhādyairupacārakaiḥpañcaratnasamāyuktaṃ sāpidhānaṃ savastrakamvardhanīṃ vāmataḥ sthāpya sūtrakādibhiranvitāmaṣṭatriṃśatkalopetaṃ pūjayenmūlamantrataḥmukulīṃ padmamudrāṃ ca liṅgamudrāṃ pradarśayetsūtrādibhiḥ samopetān hemaṭaṅkasamāyutānanantādiśikhaṇḍyantān svasvamantrairghaṭeṣu caparivāraghaṭānaṣṭau copavedyupari nyaseteko vā sarvavedāṃśca paṭhetsvasvadiśi sthitaḥsadyojātastu ṛgvedo vāmadevo yajuḥ smṛtaḥaṣṭottarasahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā tadardhakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: mūrtidhārādyalābhe tu deśikaḥ sarvamācaretkhādirāśvatthabilvāśca udumbaravaṭau tathāpalāśastu pradhānaṃ ca sarveṣāmidhmamucyatesahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vāśivāddaśāṃśato'nyeṣāṃ dikṣu brahmāṇi kalpayetpūrṇāhutiṃ tataḥ kuryādvauṣaḍantena mūlataḥsarvān liṅge tu vinyasya vahnāvāvāhya homayetapare divase dhīmān susnāto mūrtipaiḥ sahasaṃpūjya devakumbhāgnīn kuṇḍamastreṇa cārcayetpūrṇāhutiṃ tato datvā mantrānāvāhya tarpayetaghoreṇa śataṃ hutvā jayādyairduritakṣayeācāryaṃ pūjayettatra vastrahemāṅgulīyakaiḥtriguṇā cottamā proktā tvadhamatrayakalpanedaśabhāgaikabhāgaṃ tu mūrtidhārakadakṣiṇādaivajñe tatsamaṃ vidyāddviguṇaṃ vāstuhominaḥmuhūrtanāḍikāpūrvaṃ liṅgasthāpanamārametsthāpayetpīṭhamadhye tu śivamantramudīrayanmuhūrte samanuprāpte gurave sannivedayetbrahmaghoṣasamāyuktaṃ nānābhaktajanairyutamvardhanyāḥ srāvasahitaṃ maṅgalāṅkuraśobhitamkṛtvā garbhagṛhe caiva sthāpayetsthaṇḍiloparimūrdhni nyasya pavitrāṇi netramantraṃ ca vinyasetdhyātvā sadāśivaṃ tatra vidyādehena pūjayetpiṇḍikāyāṃ nasedbījaṃ śakterliṅgasya saumyakeaṣṭavidyeśvarāṃstara pīṭhe pūrvādiṣu nyaset
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: parivārasya bījāni svasvasthāneṣu vinyasetnityotsavādikān sarvān bālasthāne'pi kārayetberamānaṃ ca harmyādyaṃ kuryāddvāreṇa vartmanākumbhasaṃsthāpanaṃ pūjā homaṃ ca sthāpanādikamtattaddevapratiṣṭhoktamārgeṇaiva samācaretdvitīye sthāpanārhastu pūrvarātrau munīśvarāḥkumbhaṃ tu sthāpya pūrvoktavidhinā deśikādhipaḥpraṇamya devadeveśaṃ kartā karmavicakṣaṇaḥteṣvantare navīkṛtya punaḥ saṃsthāpayāmyahamliṅgādevaṃ samāvāhya kumbhamadhye nyasedguruḥtadagre sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā prāgvadagnimukhaṃ nayetmūlena homayedvidvānaṅgānāṃ ca daśāṃśataḥsahasraṃ vā tadardhaṃ vā śatamaṣṭottaraṃ tu vāvāraiśca ravipūrvaiśca nakṣatraisturagādibhiḥjuhuyādekayāhutyā prativatsaramācaretpūrṇāhutiṃ tato datvā deve sarvaṃ samarpayetsakalānāṃ tu sarveṣāṃ kartavyaṃ bālabimbakamparivāre'pi caivaṃ syādbālabimbaṃ prakalpayetādau kālaparīkṣā syāddvitīyaṃ deśanirṇayamsvīkāraḥ pañcamo bhūmeḥ ṣaṣṭhaḥ karṣaṇamucyatenavamaḥ sūtravinyāso daśamo devatābaliḥdvādaśo garbhavinyāsaḥ tato devaniveśanamtadante bhūsurāṇāṃ tu nirīkṣaṇamudāhṛtamgṛhārambhātpuraivaṃ syādamarāvāsanirṇayaḥmūlabālālayoktena vidhinālayanirṇayaḥ
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: utkṛṣṭe madhyame hīne devaveśma tathā matamhīnabhāvaṃ tu yatnena samaṃ votkṛṣṭamācaretgrāmādīnāṃ gṛhādīnāṃ mālikānāṃ viśeṣataḥanyeṣāmapi vastūnāṃ yajamānaprevaśanampatnīputrasamāyuktān sarvopaskarasaṃyutānvedavedāṅgatattvajñān śrotriyān priyadarśanānutkṛṣṭakarmaniratānanuṣṭhānaparāyaṇānrāṣṭragrāmau gotrasūtre savyadakṣiṇalāñcchanemulakośe likhitvaivaṃ tāmrapātre vinirmitepradadyādbhūmipūrvāṇi gṛhopakaraṇāni tudāsīdāsaṃ ca viprebhyo dadyācchraddhānvito nṛpaḥanyeṣāmiṣṭakāle tu dadyātkevalayā girānāstikān piśunān krūrān devāgnigurunindakānvarjayedīdṛśān viprān nṛpastaddānakarmaṇisvastivācanasaṃyuktaṃ veśayedbrāhmaṇān varānalpe caikaṃ dvayaṃ vāpi trayaṃ vā sanniveśayetpatnīputrasamāyuktān devāgnisahitāṃstathāakaṭavāṭamanācchādyamadattabalibhojanamsvaśaktito'pi viprāṃstu sve sve gehe niveśayetyajamānānukūlarkṣe rāśau vā tanniveśayetanenaiva prakāreṇa tatkartāraṃ niveśayetathavā kevalāṃ devīṃ deveśaṃ cātha maṇḍapamrājānaṃ mālikādau tu pradhānamahiṣīyutamaṅkurārpaṇapūrvaṃ vā rahitaṃ vā niveśayetbrāhmaṇādicaturvarṇān mārgeṇānena veśayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: vāstūpaśamanaṃ nāma sarvadoṣavināśanamvāyvagnijalasaṃbādhe nṛpacorādibādhakenyūnātireke mānasya dvāranirgamabhedaneyajamānāntare caiva hīnalakṣaṇavāstukeābhicārakṛte doṣe vyādhimārībhaye'pi cavāstūpaśamanaṃ kuryātsadya eva vicakṣaṇaḥanyeṣvaśubhayukteṣu gṛhadevālayeṣu caprāyaścittaṃ viśeṣeṇa vakṣyamāṇamidaṃ nayetahatābhyāṃ suvāsobhyāṃ saṃyuktaḥ sottarīyakaḥpūjayitvā vidhānena devānanyāt tathaiva cadarbhamālādibhiryuktāṃ sarvālaṅkārasaṃyutāmtanmadhye daṇḍamātreṇa vedīṃ pañcāṅgulocchritāmcaturṇavavikārāṃśca pañcaviṃśatpadaṃ tu vāaṣṭāṣṭakapadaṃ vāpi sūtravargapadaṃ tu vāśālibhiḥ sthaṇḍilaṃ kṛtvā taṇḍulaistilamiśrakaiḥcaruṃ ca tatra saṃsthāpya ghṛtenaivābhidhārya cavedyāstu paścime deśe kuṇḍaṃ kṛtvā trimekhalamtatra vahniṃ samādhāya vahnikāryoktamārgataḥmadhvājyakṣīrasaṃyuktadūrvayā homamācaretaghoreṇa śataṃ vārdhaṃ dravyaiḥ pūrvaistu pañcabhiḥpūrṇāhutiṃ tato hutvā vāstudevān samarcayetbrahmāṇaṃ prathamaṃ ceṣṭvā tataḥ sarvāṃśca pūjayetsarvalakṣaṇasaṃpūrṇāṃ nānābharaṇabhūṣitāmśuklavastrottarīyāṃ tāṃ saṃpūjyānnādibhiḥ sukhamdadyāttasyāśca haste tu balipātraṃ gurustadā
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: navavastradharaḥ śaivavipro dadyādbaliṃ puresarvadravyasamāyuktamathavainaṃ samācaretcatuṣkuṇḍe tu vā vāstudevānāṃ tarpaṇaṃ bhavetadhamā pañcaniṣkaṃ syāddviguṇā madhyamā bhavetagrahārādike devāgāre rājñāṃ dvijanmanāmcaṇḍālādyuṣite caiva tajjanmamaraṇe'pi cakūpe vā puṣkariṇyādau jalaṃ sarvaṃ bahiḥ kṣipetpañcagavyaṃ tu nikṣipya śāntihomaṃ tu kārayetdevānāṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ ca kṣatriyāṇāṃ viśeṣataḥekadvitricatuḥ saptadaśaśālāḥ prakīrtitāḥtā eva mālikāḥ proktā mālāvatkriyate yataḥsārdhahastaṃ samārabhya tritryaṅgulavivardhanātvistārādardhahastaṃ syāttriguṇāntaṃ samāyatiḥekahastaṃ samārabhya tritryaṅgulavivardhanātekabhaktiviśālāttu cārdhabhaktivivardhanātvistāre cāyate caiva vinyastā bhaktayaśca tāḥvistāre cāyate caiva yugmā ojāśca bhaktayaḥbhaktimadhyapramāṇaṃ vā tatsthapādāttathāpi vākṣatriyāṇāṃ tathā proktamanyayorāyatāśrakamvistārasama utsedhaḥ sapādo vātha sārdhakaḥpādāyāmaistu vā kuryādvakṣyamāṇairyathākramamutsedhe caiva hastānāṃ samyaksampūrṇatāṃ nayetvistārāyāmasaṃsargādāyādyaṃ parigṛhyatāmāyo vyayaśca yoniśca nakṣatraṃ śeṣato bhavetathavānyaprakāreṇa cāyādyaṃ parigṛhyatām
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: aṣṭanandāgnivasubhirgaṇayennandanandanāḥāyādyaṃ pūrvavatproktamāyādhikyaṃ śubhapradamtathā parīkṣya kartavyaṃ nāmanakṣatrakaṃ tu vāsarvānukūlyaṃ sarvatra vāstu yasmānna labhyateadhiṣṭhānaṃ ca pādaṃ ca prastaraṃ kaṇṭha eva cayajamānasya jānvantaṃ nābhyantaṃ hṛdayāvadhitryādiṣoḍaśabhāgānāmadhikaṃ voktamānataḥsārdhahastaṃ samārabhya tritryaṅgulavivardhanātaṅgulatrayamārabhya cārdhāṅgulavivardhanātcaturaṃśaṃ samārabhya ṣoḍaśāṃśaṃ yathāvidhievamūrdhvordhvapādānāṃ tārāyāmau prakalpayettanmānaṃ navadhā kṛtvā caikādyācaturaṃśakaiḥprastaroktapramāṇaṃ tu sarvaṃ kaṇṭhe vidhīyatedhruvāvidhānarītyā vā śikharaṃ parikalpayetpādaviṣkambhamānena dviguṇādinavāntakamaṣṭāṅgulaṃ samārabhya dvidvyaṅgulavivardhanātmūlabhitteridaṃ mānamūrdhve pādārdhahīnakamśālaikā daṇḍakhaṇḍābhā dviśālā taddvayena tusaptabhiḥ saptaśālā syādevamanyāstu kīrtitāḥāyāme'pi tathā vṛddhyā śatāntaṃ parikalpayetekadvitricatuṣpañcaṣaṭsaptālindasaṃyutāḥpṛthudvāraṃ ca dvārāṃ?śca evameva prakalpayetardhapaṅktivivṛddhyā tu triṃśatpaṅkyantamiṣyateevaṃ brahmāṅkaṇaṃ kāryaṃ jalapātayutaṃ na vābāhyavāriyutaṃ vāpi vivaraṃ vā prakalpayet
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pañcabhāgāvasānāntaṃ śālāvistāra iṣyatealindaḥ pṛthudvāreṇa samo vā cārdhamānataḥgarbhādhānakramaṇakaṃ kabhittirmukhyadhāmaniathavā brahmabhittau vā garbhādhānaṃ vidhīyateuttare raṅmityuktaṃ tadgṛhiṇyā gṛhaṃ bhavetnavabhāge gṛhe tatra dakṣiṇe pañcabhāgakamalinde dvāramevaṃ syādanyatrāpyevameva tubhittivyāse'rkabhāgaṃ tu bāhye bāhyaśarāṃśakambhittimadhyaṃ tayormadhyaṃ pādamadhyaṃ tu vā samamkoṇāttṛtīyabhāge tu jalanirgama iṣyatebhallāṭe caiva madhye ca dvāramāsu vidhīyatedevānāmubhayaṃ grāhyaṃ madhyadvāraṃ tu vai taleādityān nandapādānte pañcāṅgulagatikramātdharmanandāṣṭadhātvaṃśāḥ pūrvabhāgādipādakāḥgṛhāṅghrimadhyayormadhyaṃ bhittimadhyamiti smṛtametatsarvaṃ tu śālānāṃ sāmānyamiti kīrtyatehastyaśvarathayodhānāṃ yāgahomādikarmasuekaśālā praśastā syātstrīṇā raṅgopajīvināmśālāvirahitasthāne kuḍye dvāraṃ prayojayetpradhānaśālā yatraiva raṅgasthānaṃ vidhīyatecūlīharmyayutaṃ cordhve cāgradvārasamanvitamsarvataḥ kuṇḍasaṃyuktaṃ gṛhadvārasanvitamsordhvavāstavyasaṃyuktaṃ cūlīharmyayutaṃ tu vākarṇakūṭavihīnaṃ vā cānyatsarvaṃ tu vāstuṣusabhākārayutaṃ vāpi kevalaṃ vā jalasthalam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: pradhānamaṇḍapāgāraṃ cūlīharmyavivarjitamlūpārohakriyāyuktamanyatpūrvoktavartmanāūrdhvabhūmiriti khyātā dvitīyāṃ śṛṇuta dvijāḥsā bhūmirmaṇḍapāgāracūlīharmyavibhūṣitābhāgadvayena tasyaiva vinyāsaḥ paripaṭhyatecaturbhāgadvibhāgena pṛṣṭhāvāsasabhāṃ nayetpārśvayorubhayoścaiva caturbhāgāntavistarampradhānāvāsanetrasthanetrakūṭadvayaṃ nayetpṛṣṭhāvāsasabhā tadvadanyatsarvamadhaḥ sthalealindasya samantāttu bhāgenaikena vārakamtathā pradhānaśālāyāstvanusāreṇa pārśvayoḥbhāgadvayaviniṣkrāmo bhāgadvayaviśālataḥcatuḥ śālāvasānāntāmūrdhvādhaḥ parikalpayetṣaṇṇāṃ vai netraśālānāṃ antarāle ca vāssthalamdakṣiṇe cottare caiva pūrve caiva viśeṣataḥathavā nairṛte vāyau devabhāgasamanvitamtadadho bhūdvayaṃ yattu rajjusūtrakapotayuktadadhastātsamantāttu bhāgenaikena vārakamtadadhastāttalaṃ caikādaśadvādaśabhūmikamādyaṃ tu sarvatobhadraṃ dvitīyaṃ vardhamānakamcarukaṃ pañcamaṃ vidyācchālānāmapidhānakamdakṣiṇe cottare caiva ṣaṇṇetraṃ svastikaṃ matamnandyāvartaṃ smṛtaṃ pūrve dakṣiṇe paścime tathāniṣpaṭaṃ carukaṃ vidyātsarvatraiva viśeṣataḥviśeṣādbhūbhṛtāṃ śastaṃ carukaṃ devayogyakam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: śālābhāge tvalinde vā pṛthuvārāṃśake apietāsāṃ mālikānāṃ tu kuryādagre tu maṇḍapamāyāmastvaṃśavṛddhyā tu vistāro vāsataḥ samaḥekadvitritalopetaṃ catuṣpañcatalaṃ tu vāevaṃbhūtasya vāsasya samantānmaṇḍapaṃ nayetpañcabhāgāvasānāntaṃ kuryādāvṛtamaṇḍapampañcadaśakarāntaṃ tu kuryādāvṛtamaṇḍapamvibhadrā vā sabhadrā vā kartavyā mālikā budhaiḥpādabhāgavivṛddhyā tu cāṣṭabhāgāvasānakamdviguṇānto vidheyaḥ syādevaṃ syānmadhyavāraṇamevaṃbhūtasya vāsasya samantātsyātkhalūrikāvṛdhyāṃ vāsasya bāhye tu ṣoḍaśāvadhibhāgakānkhalūrikāstu caikādisaptabhāgāvasānakāḥojoyugmapramāṇena nyūnā vāpyadhikā tu vāetāsāmantarālaṃ tu samaṃ vā viṣamaṃ tu vāantarāle bahirvāpi adhikaṃ nyūnameva vāmukhāyāmamukhe vāpi pārśvayoḥ pṛṣṭhatastathātatsarvamatra saṃgrāhyaṃ śālāmātraṃ tu vā bhavetkhalūrikāvidhau proktaṃ sālaṃ tatrobhayatra tuṣaṭsaptabhāgaṃ vā kṛtvā bahirekaṃ vyapohya caekānekatalopetamūlāyāmena bhūmikāmathavā maṇṭapordhve tu cūlīharmyavibhūṣitāmtadvardhitopapīṭhāṃ vā tadvardhitamasūrakāmmūladhāmatalot?tuṅgādhisṭhānatalasaṃyutāmetāṃ khalūrikāṃ kuryātprāsādādiṣu buddhimān

sanskrit: puṣpadante ca bhallāṭe mahendre ca gṛhakṣatekhalūrikāyutaṃ caiva gopuraṃ vidhinācaretgarbhāgārayutaṃ vāpi madhye bhaktiyutaṃ tu vācaturaṃśādibhānvantabhāgān kṛtvaikabhāgakamadhiṣṭhānādiṣaḍvargaṃ tanmānamupapīṭhakekhalūrikātalaṃ yadvattadvadatra vidhīyatesālagopurayostuṅgastvadhikaścāpi mūlataḥsabhākāraśiroyuktaṃ śālākāraśiraḥkriyamagrato'lindakopetamaṭṭālaṃ sālakāntarecaturbhāgaikabhāgastu pañcabhāgaikabhāgikaḥgopuraṃ ca khalūrī ca mūlavāstunirīkṣitampradhānamahiṣīgehaṃ vāmabhāge samācaretanyeṣāmapi tadbāhye karturicchāvaśena tudakṣiṇe jayadaṃ rājñāṃ nairṛte ripuvardhanamudīcyāṃ kośavṛddhiḥ syādīśāne maraṇaṃ dhruvamdevānāmanyajātīnāmapi yogyaṃ sanātanamkumbhasthe makarasthe'rke pūrvagehamathārabhettulāyāṃ vṛścike saumyaṃ neṣṭamanyaccatuṣṭayamyadi kuryādgṛhaṃ tattu vatsare tu vinaśyatibhaumasthe tu gṛhakṣetraṃ sthāpitaṃ nāśitaṃ bhavetjīvasthāne gṛhakṣetraṃ sarvasampatkaraṃ bhavetbudhasya paramaṃ saukhyaṃ candraḥ puruṣadainyakṛtaṃśakādiṣu vijñeyamevaṃ jñātvā samācaretchāyāyāṃ vihitaṃ veśma girerdevālayasya vāchinne bhinne tathā naṣṭe namite'bhimate gṛhe
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: arkaḥ kārpāsakaścaiva ṣaḍete gṛhanāśanāḥgṛhe na vardhanīyāḥ syurgrāmādau śubhadā matāḥyuktavyayādhikaṃ tasmāttadā gṛhamaśobhanamdvāre pādaṃ tu neṣṭaṃ syāt nodak pratyakchiro bhavetanuvaṃśagṛhadvāraṃ naiva kāryaṃ śubhārthibhiḥdve dve vāruṇayāmye te śāle kārye tvatandritaḥdvijagehasya vaṃśaṃ tu pūrvāgraṃ parikalpayetśūdrāṇāmuttarasyāṃ syādeṣa vaṃśāgrako vidhiḥśūdrāṇāmanyajātīnāmayugmastambha iṣyatesilindhraḥ piśitaṃ caiva madhūko vaiśyapādapaḥśūdrāṇāṃ stambhayogyaṃ syāt tvaksārāḥ sarvayogyakāḥpādavyāsa iti prokto gehavyāsakarāttu vāsarveṣāmapi gehānāṃ stambhavistāra iṣyatedakṣiṇe vaiśyagehaṃ syātpaścime śūdrajātayetāmāśritya tu kulyābhaṃ dvāradvayamiheṣyatedevatāsthāpanaṃ piṇḍaṃ śālāsu na vidhīyateanyāgārādiṣu dvau dvau pañca vā syuryathecchayātricūlī vaiśyaśūdrāṇāṃ pañca sapta mahībhṛtāmpāṣaṇḍāśramiṇāṃ yugmasaṃkhyā cūlī vidhīyatetṛṇādyairmṛṇmayācchādyaṃ loṣṭācchādyaṃ ca mṛṇmayamadhiṣṭhānaṃ ca yāmyādicaturgṛhavidhau bhavetunnatiśca bahirjñeyā dvārasya ripuvardhanīmāhendraṃ bhūbhujāṃ vidyādvaṇijāmapi rākṣasamtaddigīśān samāśritya dvāraṃ vidhivadācaretjaladvāraṃ punasteṣāṃ pravakṣyāmi niveśanam

sanskrit: puṣpadante ca sugrīve bhallāṭe gṛhamukhyakeekatripañcasaptāṃśe dhvajasiṃhavṛṣadvipāḥdvicatuḥ ṣaḍvasusthānāṃ dhūmaśvakharavāyasāḥdhvajaḥ siṃho vṛṣo hastī yasya tadveśmano mukhamdhvajo yāti haristhānaṃ gajasthānaṃ ca kesarīukṣe dvāraṃ na kartavyamupamadhye'thavā bhavetvaiśyasya dakṣiṇadvāraṃ śreṣṭhaṃ śūdrasya paścimamyāmyālayabahirdvāraṃ bhallāṭe parikalpayetpuṣpadantapadadvāraṃ pūrvagehe vidhīyateāgneyyāṃ pacanasthānaṃ kṣatriyāṇāṃ praśasyatevāyavyāṃ pacanasthānaṃ śūdrāṇāṃ saṃpraśasyateyāmyāyāṃ śayanasthānaṃ nairṛtyāmāyudhālayaḥgoṣṭhāgāraṃ ca vāyavyāmuttarasyāṃ dhanālayaḥkāñjīlavaṇayoḥ pātraṃ prāgudagdiśi vinyasetannaprāśanamāryāṃśe cendrāṇyāṃ ca savitrakekṣaudramindrajaye vidyādvāyau some ca vā bhavetsugrīve puṣpadante ca prasūtigṛhamiṣyateaṅkaṇaṃ tu mahendrāṃśe peṣaṇī ca mahīdhareariṣṭāgāramiṣṭaṃ syāttatropaskārabhūmikamasure dhānye?vāsaḥ syādāyudhādīndrarājakebhūdhare kośagehaṃ syānnāgāṃśe ghṛtamauṣadhamviṣapratyauṣadhaṃ caiva kūpe devagṛhaṃ bhavetvitathe pūṣṇi sāvitre bhojanāgāra eva vāmukhe volūkhalaṃ kuryādgaṇikāśca praśaṃsitāḥmadhyamaṇḍapasaṃyuktaṃ caturgṛhamudāhṛtam
source_edition: Muktabodha M00124 (IAST, CC BY-NC 4.0) [concat of non-contiguous segment slices]

sanskrit: tīvrasaṅkramaṇaṃ tasmin gṛhasyāsya na śobhanamtricaturhastamārabhya dvidvihastavivardhanātekaśālā dviśālā syātkathyate dvitriśālakeekonaviṃśadratnyantāḥ saptadhā dvitriśālakepādādhikamathādhyardhaṃ pādonadviguṇaṃ tathātriguṇāntapramāṇena āyāmasvaṣṭadhā mataḥdviguṇādyāyatāḥ sarve vihārāśramavāsināmvistārasama utsedhaḥ sāṅghriḥ sārdhastripādayukśāntidaḥ puṣṭidaḥ paścājjayado dhanado bhavetdakṣiṇe paścime caiva śālā vaiśeṣikī nṛṇāmtadyukte lāṅgale gehe śrīḥ puṣṭiśca prakīrtitāekā vā sadviśālā vā triśālā vā dvisandhikāvaiśyānāmapi śūdrāṇāmanyaddvyantarajanmanāmtathaiva dvitriśāle ca sarvagrāmādike mateṣaṭsaptaṣaṣṭihastāśca catuḥ śālāviśālatāaṣṭāviṃśatimānāni catuḥ śālāviśālaketasmāttasmāddvihastābhyāṃ ṣaṭsaptakarapūrvakātata ārabhya hastābhyāṃ bandhayecchataratnikamsarvatra citramityuktaṃ saṃkhyayā tvaṣṭaṣaḍ bhavetmadhyamaṃ syādvikalpaṃ tu śreṣṭhamābhāsanāmabhākturaṅgāvadhimedhākhyā labhate dīrghahīnakamsamaṃ tu caturaśraṃ tu daivamānuṣamīritamdaṇḍakaṃ maulikaṃ svastibhadraṃ caiva caturmukhamvinyāsaṃ daṇḍakādīnāṃ pravakṣyāmi yathākramamdvibhāgo gehavistāra agre vārastvathaikataḥ
